name: cospowers-integration-verification
description: AI 驱动的集成验证插件：执行集成测试、回归验证、契约验证、发布前检查和分支收尾。

red_flags: 代码合规检查可读取项目源代码文件进行差异分析
提交流程中引用外部 KB 服务（DAEDALUS_URL）进行合规检查
提交流程可读取 GitLab token（~/.qianliu/config.json）用于创建 MR
流程中执行多种 shell 命令（git、lint 工具、python 检测等）
向外部 KB 端点发送差异内容和代码进行合规分析

network: DAEDALUS_URL（远程知识库 API，用户提供）
GitLab API（创建 MR，用户提供 token）

security.summary: 插件为集成验证工具包，功能覆盖编码合规检查、lint 自动修复、git 提交及 MR 创建。会读取项目源码、执行 shell 命令、可选连接远程 KB 和 GitLab API，风险点在于外部通信和 token 读取，但用途合理且需用户配置。
recommendations: 使用前确认 cospowers.config.json 中的 DAEDALUS_URL 和 token 配置均为可信端点
建议仅在信任的项目仓库中启用此插件，避免在含敏感数据的仓库中运行
确保 GitLab token 权限范围最小化，仅授予创建 MR 所需权限
远程 KB 模式下，了解发送的代码差异内容范围，避免在机密代码仓库中使用

recommendations: 确认 cospowers.config.json 中 SPEC_DEVELOPER_SERVER_URL 指向可信服务器

description: Claude Code plugin bundling workflow skills that guide AI agents through brainstorming, planning, TDD, review-driven implementation, and completion.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供技能库的插件，引导 AI 代理按头脑风暴、规划、TDD 与代码审查流程完成开发。
description_original:
It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.

Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest.

After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.

Next up, once you say "go", it launches a subagent-driven-development process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward. It's not uncommon for Claude to be able to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.

There's a bunch more to it, but that's the core of the system. And because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special. Your coding agent just has Superpowers.
highlights: 自动触发头脑风暴、规划与 TDD 等技能
子代理驱动开发，逐任务独立审查
证据优先，先验证再宣称完成

name: caveman
description:
Auto-activation works differently per agent: Claude Code uses SessionStart hooks, this repo's Codex dogfood setup uses .codex/hooks.json, Gemini uses context files. Cursor/Windsurf/Cline/Copilot can be made always-on, but npx skills add installs only the skill, not the repo rule/instruction files.

¹ Codex uses $caveman syntax, not /caveman. This repo ships .codex/hooks.json, so caveman auto-starts when you run Codex inside this repo. The installed plugin itself gives you $caveman; copy the same hook into another repo if you want always-on behavior there too. caveman-commit and caveman-review are not in the Codex plugin bundle — use the SKILL.md files directly. ² Add the "Want it always on?" snippet below to those agents' system prompt or rule file if you want session-start activation. ³ Cursor and Windsurf receive the full SKILL.md with all intensity levels. Mode switching works on-demand via the skill; no slash command. ⁴ Available in Claude Code, but plugin install only nudges setup. Standalone install.sh / install.ps1 configures it automatically when no custom statusLine exists.

description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，提供 /solo 和 /siege 两个技能求解高难度数学问题，最终生成自包含的 proof.md 证明文件。
description_original: Two skills for hard mathematics problems, each ending in a self-contained proof.md: /math-proof:solo has the session work the problem itself in stages with a notes file; /math-proof:siege works on it for hours in rounds of judge and worker sub-agents and says plainly what is and is not proved.
highlights: solo 单会话分阶段推理并记录笔记
siege 多轮 judge/worker 子代理协作数小时
最终输出可独立阅读的 proof.md

name: mcp-server-dev
description: Comprehensive guide for building MCP servers and interactive UI widgets for Claude, covering deployment models, tool design, and testing.

security.summary: 纯教学型插件，内容为 MCP 服务器开发指南与文档，不包含可执行命令、远端 endpoint 或敏感权限请求，无安全风险。

description_zh: 为Claude构建MCP服务器和交互式UI组件的完整指南，涵盖部署模型、工具设计和测试。
description_original: Skills for designing and building MCP servers that work seamlessly with Claude. Guides you through deployment models (remote HTTP, MCPB, local), tool design patterns, auth, and interactive MCP apps.
highlights: 支持远程HTTP、MCPB和本地stdio三种部署模型
提供交互式UI组件（MCP Apps）开发指南
包含完整的代码示例和测试流程

name: mcp-tunnels
description: A Claude plugin for connecting to private MCP servers via Anthropic tunnels with Docker Compose quickstart.

red_flags: 生成并写入TLS私钥和CA私钥到本地data目录
创建并写入.env文件包含隧道token占位符
执行openssl生成证书命令
执行docker compose命令启动服务
访问外部Docker镜像仓库拉取镜像
security.summary: 官方插件用于通过Docker Compose搭建Anthropic MCP隧道，涉及生成TLS证书、写入凭证文件、拉取远程Docker镜像并启动服务，操作范围明确且需用户手动填入token，属中等风险。
recommendations: 确保TUNNEL_TOKEN仅由用户手动填入.env，不要在对话中暴露
审查docker-compose.yaml中引用的镜像digest是否与官方文档一致
建议生产部署时参考官方加固指南添加安全配置
定期轮换隧道token并监控证书有效期

description_zh: Claude插件，通过Anthropic隧道连接私有MCP服务器，提供Docker Compose快速启动。
description_original: Connect Claude to a private MCP server through an Anthropic MCP tunnel. The /create-docker-mcp-tunnel command drives the Docker Compose quickstart end to end: certificates, proxy config, cloudflared, and a verifiable sample server.
highlights: 一键Docker部署，快速连接私有MCP服务器
支持自定义CA证书和安全配置
提供完整快速启动指南和示例代码

审查 .env 文件权限（600）是否正确设置，防止凭据泄露

name: agent-memory

description_zh: 为 Claude Code 设计的四级记忆分层插件，依据重复出现而非单一置信度晋升记忆，需人工确认后写入。
description_original: A four-tier memory ladder for Claude Code where promotion is earned by recurrence, not asserted by confidence. L0 raw transcripts are never injected; L1 candidate atoms are gitignored and recalled on lexical relevance per prompt; L2 project context loads each session start; L3 stable persona is always loaded. L1 to L2 needs three distinct sessions spanning two distinct calendar days (a stated claim needs two; a verified claim is the only single-observation path); L2 to L3 needs two projects and thirty days. Two gates refuse rather than guess: a claim altered by the redaction pass never promotes on evidence alone, and a contradicted claim freezes until a human resolves it. Three hooks run the loop unattended and every one fails open. Nothing reaches a committed CLAUDE.md without an explicit human adopt. Ships 5 stdlib scripts, 3 hooks, a cs-memory-curator agent, /cs:memory, a JSON schema, and a 69-check validator. Concept from TencentCloud/TencentDB-Agent-Memory (MIT); no upstream code included.
highlights: 四级记忆阶梯，凭重复出现晋升而非置信度

A companion, not a compilation: the book is copyrighted, so nothing here reproduces its text.

The schema is the API documentation. Design it carefully.

识别文档与代码缺失
生成优先级推荐下一步

生成变更影响报告

自动分类故事类型（逻辑/集成/视觉/UI）

输出统一格式的设计规格

检测未写回归测试的已修复 Bug

覆盖构建验证到发布准备

Reads all system GDDs simultaneously and checks for contradictions between them, stale references, ownership conflicts, formula incompatibilities, and game design theory violations (dominant strategies, economic imbalance, cognitive overload, pillar drift). Run after all MVP GDDs are written, before architecture begins.

Fragile rules to CUT: CoT orchestrators, format parsers, retry cascades, numeric personality scales, abstract value statements. Requires loadAtStartup and postCompactRestore.fullFiles to stay in sync in settings.json — removing a file from one requires checking the other. NOT FOR general code simplification or refactoring (use simplify skill). NOT FOR attacking logical or strategic flaws in ideas (use RedTeam for that). Standalone mode: present results then ask what to do. Paired mode: execute request informed by found context. NOT FOR incident causal chains (use RootCauseAnalysis). security.summary: 纯技能文档，描述如何使用 Lark CLI 操作飞书 IM，不包含任何自动执行或敏感操作，无风险。

description_zh: 飞书命令行工具技能，用于收发消息和管理群聊。
description_original: 飞书即时通讯：收发消息和管理群聊。发送和回复消息、搜索聊天记录、管理群聊成员、上传下载图片和文件（支持大文件分片下载）、管理表情回复、发送应用内/短信/电话加急、发送和处理交互卡片（Interactive Card）、监听卡片按钮回调（card.action.trigger）。当用户需要发消息、查看或搜索聊天记录、下载聊天中的文件、查看群成员、搜索群、创建群聊或话题群、管理标记数据、管理 Feed 置顶（添加/移除/查询置顶会话）、管理标签数据、处理卡片回调时使用。
highlights: 支持消息收发与群聊管理
支持交互卡片和表情回复
提供Shortcut和原生API两种调用方式

name: lark-mail
description: AI skill for Lark (Feishu) email: drafting, reading, sending, replying, forwarding, and managing folders, labels, and rules via CLI.

security.summary: 该技能为飞书邮箱AI操作指令集，通过本地CLI管理邮件，含安全规则防止执行外部恶意指令，不传输敏感数据，风险较低。
recommendations: 确保lark-cli为官方发布版本

description_zh: 飞书邮箱AI技能：通过CLI快捷指令起草、阅读、发送、回复、转发邮件，管理文件夹、标签、收信规则等。
description_original: 飞书邮箱：Use when user mentions 起草邮件、写邮件、草稿、发送/回复/转发邮件、查阅邮件、看邮件、搜索邮件、邮件文件夹、邮件标签、邮件联系人、监听新邮件、邮件收信规则等；use for mail/email intent only. Do not use for docs/sheets/calendar/auth setup/pure contact lookup/IM chat tasks.
highlights: 支持起草/发送/回复/转发邮件
安全规则防Prompt注入攻击
收信规则自动化管理

name: lark-markdown
description: Skill for Feishu Markdown: create, read, edit, patch, diff, and upload Markdown files in Drive.

files: 本地 .md 文件路径（通过 --file）
任意本地文件路径（通过 --content @file）

security.summary: 该技能使用lark-cli工具操作飞书Drive Markdown文件，需用户自行安装认证，执行外部命令访问本地文件和云端API，功能合理但需注意敏感文件泄露风险。
recommendations: 确保lark-cli从官方GitHub仓库安装
避免使用@file读取包含敏感信息的文件
监控上传至飞书Drive的文件内容
定期检查飞书Drive文件权限设置

description_zh: 飞书 Markdown 文件操作技能：创建、查看、编辑、补丁、比较、上传。
description_original: 飞书 Markdown：查看、创建、上传、编辑和比较 Markdown 文件。当用户需要创建或编辑 Markdown 文件、读取、修改、局部 patch 或比较差异时使用。不负责将 Markdown 导入为飞书在线文档，也不负责文件搜索、权限、评论、移动、删除等云空间管理操作。
highlights: 支持创建、查看、编辑、补丁等操作
明确的操作边界说明
通过 lark-cli 命令行执行

name: lark-minutes
description: A skill for searching, viewing, downloading/uploading audio/video, and editing Feishu Minutes content.

files: 本地音视频文件（上传至飞书云盘）
妙记媒体文件（下载到本地）

security.summary: 指导LLM使用lark-cli工具调用飞书API操作妙记，读取/上传/下载文件均仅限于用户明确意图且依赖官方工具，无窃取凭据或恶意行为。

description_zh: 用于搜索、查看、下载/上传音视频以及编辑飞书妙记内容的技能。
description_original: 飞书妙记：搜索妙记、查看妙记基础信息、下载/上传音视频、读取或编辑妙记的产物内容、改标题、替换说话人/关键词。当给出minute_token、本地音视频文件，要查/改/转妙记产物时使用；本地音视频转纪要/逐字稿优先走本 skill，不要用 ffmpeg/whisper 本地转写。不负责：获取会议关联妙记，或仅按自然语言标题定位纪要
highlights: 搜索、查看妙记基础信息
下载/上传音视频文件
编辑AI总结、待办、说话人

name: lark-note
description: Query Lark meeting notes details and transcripts by note_id in a CLI skill.

security.summary: 该 skill 为官方飞书 CLI 的纪要查询子命令，仅指导 AI 使用 lark-cli 和读取仓库内 reference 文件，无恶意行为，风险低。

description_zh: 基于 note_id 查询飞书会议纪要详情与逐字记录的 CLI 技能。
description_original: 飞书会议纪要（Note）直查：已知 note_id 时查询纪要详情、展示类型、关联文档 token，并读取 unified 原始逐字记录。当用户已持有 note_id，或从文档显式 vc-node-id 获得 note_id 时使用。不负责会议/日程/妙记定位、文档标题搜索或 Docx 正文读取。
highlights: 通过 note_id 直接查询纪要详情
支持 unified 逐字记录读取
明确职责边界，不越权处理

name: lark-okr
description: Manage Feishu OKRs via CLI: view/edit cycles, objectives, key results, progress.

security.summary: 该技能为飞书OKR管理CLI指令集，仅调用本地lark-cli工具，操作清晰透明，无恶意行为。

description_zh: 通过命令行管理飞书 OKR 目标与关键结果
description_original: 飞书 OKR：管理目标与关键结果。查看和编辑 OKR 周期、目标、关键结果、对齐关系、量化指标和进展记录。当用户需要查看或创建 OKR、管理目标和关键结果、查看对齐关系时使用。不负责：待办任务管理（lark-task）、日程/会议安排（lark-calendar）、绩效评估
highlights: 管理目标与关键结果
支持批量操作
查看对齐关系

name: lark-openapi-explorer
description: Explore undocumented Feishu/Lark OpenAPI endpoints via lark-cli.

security.summary: 该 skill 指导 LLM 通过 WebFetch 获取公共文档并调用 lark-cli 执行飞书 OpenAPI，不窃取数据或执行危险操作，风险低。

description_zh: 从官方文档库挖掘飞书/Lark原生OpenAPI接口，通过lark-cli调用未被封装的API。
description_original: 飞书/Lark 原生 OpenAPI 探索：从官方文档库中挖掘未经 CLI 封装的原生 OpenAPI 接口。当用户的需求无法被现有 lark-* skill 或 lark-cli 已注册命令满足，需要查找并调用原生飞书 OpenAPI 时使用。
highlights: 从官方文档逐层挖掘原生OpenAPI
支持飞书/Lark双品牌
安全确认后调用写入/删除API

name: lark-shared
description: AI agent skill for lark-cli authentication, scopes, identity management, and authorization workflows.

files: 项目目录 (cwd) 下的相对路径（读写）
network: 飞书/ Lark OAuth 及 API 端点 (open.feishu.cn, open.larksuite.com 等)
commands: lark-cli (config init, auth login, auth logout, auth status, auth qrcode, update 等)

security.summary: 该技能指导 AI agent 通过官方 lark-cli 执行认证与权限管理操作，所有命令固定且用途合理，安全规则明确，无恶意行为。

description_zh: 飞书CLI认证、权限与身份管理的AI技能规则。
description_original: Use for lark-cli setup/auth tasks: auth login/status/logout, user vs bot identity, business-domain permissions (--domain, including all/docs/drive), missing scopes, revoking authorization, or handling _notice JSON.
highlights: 认证、Scope与身份管理速查表
Bot与User身份区别及权限处理
Split-Flow代理认证流程

name: lark-sheets
description: CLI skill for operating Feishu/Lark spreadsheets: create, edit, read/write, chart, pivot table, conditional formatting, and more.

security.summary: 低风险，该skill通过固定的lark-cli命令操作飞书表格，需用户配置认证，不窃取数据或执行高危操作。

description_zh: 飞书电子表格操作CLI技能：创建、编辑、读写、图表、透视表、条件格式等。
description_original: 飞书电子表格：创建和操作电子表格。支持创建表格、管理工作表与行列结构（增删/合并/调整尺寸/隐藏/冻结）、读写单元格（值/公式/样式/批注/单元格图片）、查找替换、多操作原子批量更新，以及图表、透视表、条件格式、筛选器、迷你图、浮动图片等对象的创建与维护。当用户需要创建电子表格、管理工作表、批量读写或编辑数据、统计汇总与可视化、表格美化、公式计算（含 Excel 公式迁移）、金融/财务建模（DCF、三张表、预算、Sensitivity 等）等任务时使用。若用户是想按名称或关键词搜索云空间（云盘/云存储）里的表格文件，请改用 lark-drive 的 drive +search 先定位资源。当用户给出 doubao.com 的 /sheets/ URL/token 时，也应直接使用本 skill，不要因为域名不是飞书而回退到 WebFetch；路由依据是 URL 路径模式和 token，而不是域名。
highlights: 支持创建和操作电子表格
管理工作表与行列结构
读写单元格值/公式/样式/批注

name: lark-skill-maker
description: Guide to create reusable skill definitions for lark-cli to automate Feishu API operations.

security.summary: 内容为 lark-cli skill 创建指南和模板，不包含可执行代码或敏感权限请求，属于纯文档型 skill，安全无风险。

description_zh: 创建 lark-cli 自定义 Skill 的指南，用于封装飞书 API 操作。
description_original: 创建 lark-cli 的自定义 Skill。当用户需要把飞书 API 操作封装成可复用的 Skill（包装原子 API 或编排多步流程）时使用。
highlights: 提供 SKILL.md 模板和关键原则
支持多步编排和权限说明
指导如何调研飞书 API

name: lark-slides
description: AI skill for creating and editing Lark (Feishu) slides via CLI and XML.

files: 读写项目目录下的 .lark-slides/plan/ 文件
读取用户指定的本地图片文件（通过 @ 占位符或上传流程）
读取技能自带的参考文档和脚本

security.summary: 技能旨在通过飞书官方 CLI 安全创建和编辑幻灯片，所有命令执行和文件访问均基于用户授权，无恶意行为或敏感信息外传，风险低。

description_zh: 飞书幻灯片技能：使用CLI和XML创建、编辑和管理演示文稿。
description_original: 飞书幻灯片：创建和编辑幻灯片。创建演示文稿、读取幻灯片内容、管理幻灯片页面（创建、删除、读取、局部替换）。当用户需要创建或编辑幻灯片、读取或修改单个页面时使用。当用户给出 doubao.com 的 /slides/ URL/token 时，也应直接使用本 skill，不要因为域名不是飞书而回退到 WebFetch；路由依据是 URL 路径模式和 token，而不是域名。不负责：云文档内容编辑（走 lark-doc）、云文档里的独立画板对象（走 lark-whiteboard，注意 slide 内嵌的流程图/架构图仍属本 skill）、上传或下载普通文件（走 lark-drive）。
highlights: 支持 CLI 和 XML 创建多页幻灯片
提供模板检索、视觉规划和验证流程
编辑已有页面的块级替换和批量重建功能

name: lark-task
description: Feishu/Lark task management skill: create, update, search tasks and tasklists, manage agents.

security.summary: 纯指令型 skill，仅指导 LLM 使用 lark-cli 管理飞书任务，无恶意文件读写、网络传输或命令执行风险。

description_zh: 飞书任务管理技能：创建、更新、搜索任务和任务清单，管理智能体。
description_original: 飞书任务：管理任务、清单和任务智能体。创建待办任务、查看和更新任务状态、拆分子任务、组织任务清单、分配协作成员、上传任务附件、注册或注销任务智能体、更新任务智能体的主页数据、写入智能体任务记录。当用户需要创建待办事项、查看任务列表、跟踪任务进度、管理项目清单或给他人分配任务、为任务上传附件文件、注册注销任务智能体、更新智能体主页数据、写入任务记录时使用。
highlights: 创建、更新、搜索任务
管理任务智能体
支持子任务和清单

name: lark-vc-agent
description: Skill for Lark meeting agent: join/leave active meetings, read real-time events (participants, speech, chat, screen share).

security.summary: 技能通过固定命令 lark-cli 操作飞书视频会议，命令明确且文档完整，仅调用官方API，无敏感数据泄露或恶意行为。

description_zh: 飞书视频会议会中技能：支持机器人入会/离会、读取实时事件（参会人、发言、聊天、屏幕共享）。
description_original: 飞书视频会议会中能力：用于让应用机器人真实加入或离开正在进行的会议，并读取当前身份可见的会中事件，如参会人加入/离开、发言、聊天、屏幕共享。适用于用户询问正在开的会议发生了什么、谁在发言、是否共享内容，或需要发现当前可读的进行中会议 ID。不负责已结束会议搜索、参会人快照、纪要、逐字稿或录制查询，这些使用 lark-vc 技能。
highlights: 真实机器人入会/离会
读取会中实时事件
支持用户/应用双身份

name: lark-vc
description: Lark VC skill for searching past meeting records, querying meeting notes (summary, todos, chapters, transcripts), and retrieving participant snapshots

security.summary: 该技能通过固定命令调用飞书官方CLI操作视频会议和文档，需外部API访问并写入工作目录，用途清晰合理，风险中等。
recommendations: 使用前确保已安装 lark-cli 并完成飞书认证
lark-cli 会联网请求飞书服务器，勿在无网络或敏感环境滥用
确认产物下载路径仅限于项目目录，避免覆盖其他文件

description_zh: 飞书视频会议技能，用于搜索历史会议记录、查询会议纪要（总结/待办/章节/逐字稿）和参会人快照。
description_original: 飞书视频会议：搜索历史会议记录、查询会议纪要（总结/待办/章节/逐字稿）、查询参会人快照。当用户查询已结束的会议、获取会议产物（纪要/妙记）、查看参会人时使用；查询未来日程走 lark-calendar。不负责：Agent 真实入会/离会、会中实时事件（走 lark-vc-agent）。
highlights: 搜索历史会议记录，支持关键词/时间/参会人筛选
查询会议纪要（总结/待办/章节/逐字稿）
查询参会人快照，已结束会议可查

name: lark-whiteboard
description: Skill for querying and editing Lark whiteboards, with export to image, SVG, code, and multi-format update.

red_flags: 执行外部 npx 命令动态下载并运行 whiteboard-cli 包
需用户配置 Lark 认证凭据，凭据可能被 skill 读取并用于 API 调用
依赖共享认证配置文件 (../lark-shared/SKILL.md)，可能读取敏感信息

files: 当前工作目录内 (读写，用于导出图片/SVG/代码)
network: Lark 白板 API (域名: open.feishu.cn 或 *.larksuite.com)

security.summary: 该 skill 通过 lark-cli 和 whiteboard-cli 工具调用 Lark 白板 API，需用户主动配置认证，命令和网络请求均指向官方渠道，风险可控但涉及凭据和动态代码执行，建议谨慎使用
recommendations: 使用前确保 lark-cli 和 @larksuite/whiteboard-cli 来自官方来源
npx 已锁定版本 ^0.2.12，避免自动更新引入未知风险
仅对信任的 Lark 白板文档授予该 skill 访问权限
定期检查认证凭据文件 (../lark-shared/SKILL.md) 的权限
若不需要导出功能，可限制文件写入权限

description_zh: 飞书画板查询和编辑技能，支持导出图片、SVG、代码及多种格式更新。
description_original: 飞书画板：查询和编辑飞书云文档中的画板。支持导出画板为预览图片、导出原始节点结构、使用多种格式更新画板内容。
highlights: 支持导出预览图片、SVG 矢量图
支持 Mermaid/PlantUML 代码
多格式更新画板内容

security.summary: 该技能通过 lark-cli 管理飞书知识库，涉及文件读取、命令执行和API调用，但文档清晰且包含安全约束，风险中等。

description_zh: 飞书知识库管理技能，用于管理知识空间、成员和文档节点，集成于lark-cli工具。
description_original: 飞书知识库：管理知识空间、空间成员和文档节点。创建和查询知识空间、查看和管理空间成员、管理节点层级结构、在知识库中组织文档和快捷方式。当用户需要在知识库中查找或创建文档、浏览知识空间结构、查看或管理空间成员、移动或复制节点时使用。当用户给出 doubao.com 的 /wiki/ URL/token 时，也应直接使用本 skill，不要因为域名不是飞书而回退到 WebFetch；路由依据是 URL 路径模式和 token，而不是域名。不负责：上传文件到知识库节点下（走 lark-drive）、编辑文档/表格/Base 内容（走 lark-doc / lark-sheets / lark-base）。
highlights: 管理知识空间和文档节点
支持成员添加/删除/列表
快捷操作：移动、复制、删除节点

name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
description: Workflow to aggregate meeting minutes from Lark/Feishu and generate structured reports within a time range.

red_flags: 需执行外部命令 lark-cli 访问飞书 API，可能泄漏会议纪要内容

network: 飞书开放平台 API（open.feishu.cn 或 open.larksuite.com）

recommendations: 使用前确认 lark-cli 已安装并仅授权必要域名 (vc,drive)
授权时注意最小权限原则，避免使用超期 token
避免在不信任的环境中执行，以防通过 date 命令注入

Trigger whenever the user is building or debugging any pipeline that turns an HTML/CSS/JS page (single-file, multi-composition, GSAP-driven, or `@keyframes`-driven) into a video file, including headless recording, screen capture of a web page, deterministic frame-by-frame capture, multi-scene concatenation, or engine-mixed video output. Also trigger when the symptom sounds like: font swap flashing in the opening frames (FOUT), the first few seconds of the video are frozen/dead, animations play during page load and get truncated, concatenated segments produce a video whose duration is wildly wrong (e.g., 8s becomes 35s), `file://` loaded HTML fails to fetch its sub-scenes, the exported video is soft/blurry compared to the browser, or playback stutters/looks choppy despite passing a high `-r` fps to ffmpeg. security.summary: 纯项目管理流程技能，所有脚本均限定在项目内读取和执行，仅用于状态查询与GitHub同步，未见敏感数据外传或高危操作。

description_zh: 规范驱动的项目管理技能，将PRD转化为GitHub问题并协调并行代理执行以交付代码。
description_original: CCPM - spec-driven project management: PRD → Epic → GitHub Issues → parallel agents → shipped code. Use this skill for anything in the software delivery lifecycle: writing a PRD ('write a PRD for X', 'let's plan X', 'scope this out'), parsing a PRD into an epic, decomposing an epic into tasks, syncing to GitHub ('sync the X epic', 'push tasks to github'), starting work on an issue ('start working on issue N', 'let's work on issue N'), analyzing parallel work streams, running standups ('standup', 'run the standup'), checking status ('what's next', 'what's blocked', 'what are we working on'), closing issues, or merging an epic. Use ccpm any time the user is talking about shipping a feature, managing work, or tracking progress — even if they don't say 'ccpm' or 'PRD'. Do NOT use for: debugging code, writing tests, reviewing PRs, or raw GitHub issue/PR operations with no delivery context.
highlights: 五阶段规范驱动工作流
GitHub 问题自动同步

name: branch-and-checkpoint
description: Saves a running smolvm machine as checkpoints on a schedule, keeps a bounded history, restores any generation in it, pauses and resumes machines without losing running processes, and branches a warm machine into children with a checkpoint of the exact point they started from. Use when a machine's state has to survive the machine; when an agent or a job needs to roll back; when checkpoints must be taken periodically, since smolvm has no scheduler or retention of its own; when fanning a prepared machine out into workers; or when a checkpoint, a pause or a branch fails with an error that names none of its preconditions. Do not use it to ship an environment to another host as a file, which is the pack packet, or for state that only has to survive a stop and start, which is the dev-env packet.

name: credentials
description: Gives a workload in a smolvm machine an API key or token it can use but never read, by binding the credential to named HTTPS hosts so the guest holds only a placeholder and the host substitutes the value on the way out, then proves on the host that the value never entered the machine. Use when an agent or untrusted code inside a machine has to call an API with your key; when deciding between a credential binding and --secret-env; when a request from a credentialed machine comes back 403 or 502 from smolvm itself; or when you need evidence that a key stayed out of a machine. Do not use it for a value the program must read and parse, such as a database URL, which is --secret-env, or for git and ssh keys, which is SSH agent forwarding.

name: dev-env
description: Keeps a persistent smolvm machine with its dependencies already installed and re-enters it cheaply across sessions. Use when a project needs an isolated development environment that survives stop and start; when deciding what belongs in a Smolfile's init versus what has to run on every boot; when a package installed in a machine has vanished after a restart; or when exec answers

name: docker-in-machine
description: Runs a Docker daemon inside a smolvm machine and shows it working there, which is what tools that call Docker themselves need, such as a test suite that starts containers, an image build, or a coding agent that launches containers. Use when dockerd will not start inside a machine; when Docker worked on the first boot and broke after a stop and start; when deciding where Docker's data directory has to live; or when checking whether this is possible on a given platform at all. Do not use it to run OCI images, which smolvm boots natively without Docker, and do not attempt it on Windows, where the bundled guest kernel cannot support it.

name: gpu-cuda
description: Runs CUDA compute workloads inside a smolvm microVM against a real host NVIDIA GPU, using smolvm's --cuda API remoting. Use when a workload in a machine needs a GPU; when nvidia-smi or /dev/nvidia* is missing inside a --cuda guest; when a CUDA program in a machine exits zero but seems not to touch the device; when the shim will not load in an Alpine image; or when checking whether CUDA is available on a given platform, including Windows. Do not use it for Vulkan graphics (--gpu), which is a separate feature, in docs/gpu.md, and do not expect it on a Mac, which has no CUDA driver.

name: install
description: Installs smolvm from a published release and proves the host can actually boot a microVM before any other work starts. Use when setting smolvm up on a new machine, a CI runner or an agent's own environment; when a first boot fails with krun_start_enter -22, KVM_DENIED or

name: local-api
description: Drives smolvm programmatically over its local HTTP API (smolvm serve) instead of the CLI: create machines, exec and stream commands, move files in and out, and tear them down. Use when building a client, harness, agent tool or MCP backend over smolvm; when a create call is accepted but the machine behaves as if a field was ignored; when a file uploaded over the API has disappeared; when an exec that failed still returned HTTP 200; or when choosing between the Unix socket and loopback TCP. Do not use it as a substitute for the CLI in a shell script, and do not bind a plain listener beyond loopback: a server started without mutual TLS has no authentication of any kind.

name: pack
description: Turns an image, or a machine already provisioned, into a single self-contained artifact that runs on another compatible host. Use when shipping a prepared environment as one file, when a packed artifact runs but the state installed into it is missing, when pack create fails because the VM it boots to pull or export could not start, when an older release refuses to export a branched machine, or when deciding whether to pack from an image or from a machine. Do not use it to keep a machine you re-enter, which is the dev-env packet, or to run untrusted code, which is the throwaway-machine packet.

name: teardown
description: Stops every smolvm machine a session started, removes smolvm's state, and proves the host is clean. Use after any smolvm session; when a machine seems to have survived a Ctrl-C or a crash; when disk space has disappeared; when uninstalling smolvm; when tearing down the Kubernetes runtime from a node; or when a borrowed or shared host has to be handed back with nothing left behind. Also use it as the cleanup step for other smolvm work, because the obvious assertions here give false results. Do not use it to delete machines another session created: it removes only what a script recorded under its own name prefix.

name: throwaway-machine
description: Runs untrusted code in a throwaway smolvm microVM against a repo it must not modify, with no network unless explicitly granted, and collects artifacts from a writable output directory. Use when executing an agent's generated script, a pull request's test suite, or any code that should not be trusted with the host; when a workload needs egress granted one host at a time; or when a run has to be cancelled, because Ctrl-C on the wrapper script leaves the VM running, and on releases before v1.20.2 so does Ctrl-C on the CLI. Do not use it for a development environment that is re-entered across sessions, for running a Docker daemon inside a machine, or for installing smolvm itself, which is the install packet.

description: Use only when a developer explicitly asks to clean, prune, tidy, or organize DeepChat SDD documentation after implementation and validation. Scans docs/features, docs/issues, and docs/architecture; prefers multi-agent review when available; removes completed issue docs when a linked GitHub issue is closed or implementation and validation evidence proves the bug no longer exists, drops stale plans and legacy task files from completed feature or architecture goals, and deletes obsolete feature or architecture docs.

name: deepchat-sdd
description: Use before substantial DeepChat code, configuration, documentation, test, build, feature, issue, refactor, or architecture changes that need a durable RFC and an explicit execution path. Skip trivial style fixes, small localized logic changes, routine docs edits, and simple bugs unless the developer asks for SDD. Use plan.md as the only separate tracker when needed, default to implementation-first validation, and ask before optional GitHub issue sync unless the developer explicitly requested sync.

Do not use for ordinary one-off reading or research when the project has not activated Material Lifecycle.

name: loopx-performance-diagnosis

name: loopx-pr-merge

name: loopx-pr-program

Use provider-neutral snapshots and one grouped continuous monitor; do not use for deep per-PR code review, approval, commenting, or merge actions.

name: loopx-pr-review
description: Use for `/loopx-pr-review` or evidence-backed PR queue review. Run `loopx pr-review` first, execute the capability-owned review plan for each selected exact head, then publish full bilingual PR reviews (complete Chinese five-block review plus one concise English verdict) that match the verified findings. Use `loopx-pr-merge` for approval or merge actions.

name: loopx-project
description: Use for LoopX project lifecycle work: connect or configure a project/Goal, repair project-local state or stale dashboard status, sync registry entries, or diagnose CLI/PATH/status/history routing. For registering durable project materials, prefer loopx-doc-registry.

description_original: Guide users building apps, scripts, CI pipelines, or automations on top of the Cursor TypeScript SDK (`@cursor/sdk`). Use this skill whenever the user mentions integrating, installing, or writing code against the Cursor SDK; whenever they say `Agent.create`, `Agent.prompt`, `Agent.resume`, `agent.send`, `run.stream`, `CursorAgentError`, or `@cursor/sdk`; whenever they ask to run Cursor agents programmatically from a script, CI/CD pipeline, GitHub Action, backend service, or any other code that isn't the Cursor IDE itself; and whenever they want to pick between local and cloud runtime, configure MCP servers for an SDK agent, or handle streaming, cancellation, or errors from an SDK agent. Also trigger when a user is wiring Cursor into an automation, writing a bot that runs Cursor, or porting REST `/v1/agents` calls to the SDK, even if they don't explicitly name the package. Use this eagerly rather than answering from memory; the SDK surface evolves and this skill plus its references are the source of truth for the external package.
highlights: 三种调用模式快速上手
覆盖认证、错误、流式等常见坑
明确本地与云端运行边界

name: figure-it-out
description: Meta-skill that designs an auditable, rigor-scaled playbook for large multi-part coding changes.
description_zh: 为大型多部分代码变更设计可审计、可扩展严谨度的执行方案（playbook）。
description_original: Design an auditable playbook when no narrower one fits: a large migration, an ambitious multi-part change, or work a human reviews after stepping away. Scales rigor to the task, runs a hypothesis loop, and logs decisions via show-me-your-work. Use for /figure-it-out, 'figure it out', a large migration, or when no narrower playbook applies.
highlights: 为大型迁移设计可审计执行方案
按任务规模动态调整严谨度
全程记录决策与验证痕迹

name: fix-ci
description: A Cursor skill that detects failing PR checks, inspects CI logs, and applies minimal fixes while iterating to green.
description_zh: 排查失败 PR 检查、查看 CI 日志并应用最小修复的 Cursor 技能。
description_original: Find failing PR checks, inspect logs or external check links, and apply focused fixes
highlights: 定位失败 PR 检查项
迭代修复 CI 直至通过
以 gh pr checks 为准监控状态

name: fix-merge-conflicts
description: A skill that resolves git merge conflicts non-interactively, validates build and tests, and finalizes resolution.
description_zh: 非交互式解决 Git 合并冲突，验证构建与测试并完成收尾。
description_original: Resolve merge conflicts non-interactively, validate build and tests, and finalize conflict resolution
highlights: 非交互式自动解决合并冲突
自动验证构建与测试结果
提供明确的安全操作边界

name: get-pr-comments
description: Fetch and summarize review comments from the active pull request.
description_zh: 获取并总结当前拉取请求的评审评论。
description_original: Fetch and summarize review comments from the active pull request
highlights: 自动获取当前 PR 的评审评论
按严重性分组并生成行动清单
汇总待澄清的开放问题

name: loop-on-ci
description: Skill to monitor PR CI checks and iteratively fix failures until all checks pass.
description_zh: 监控 PR 的 CI 检查，迭代修复失败直到全部变绿。
description_original: Monitor PR checks and fix failures until green. Uses gh pr checks as the source of truth for PR-attached checks.
highlights: 以 gh pr checks 为准
失败重试一次并报告 flake
保持修复聚焦不绕行钩子

name: maintain-verification-skill
description: Periodic upkeep loop for a project verification skill: parallel source readers per feature, live session per feature, one PR of proven corrections.
description_zh: 定期维护项目的验证技能和功能地图：逐功能并行阅读源码、实机驱动验证，最多提交一个修正PR。
description_original: Periodic pass that keeps a project's verification skill and feature map honest: parallel source readers per feature, one live session driving every feature, at most one PR of proven corrections. Use for /maintain-verification-skill or \
highlights: 并行源码审读，逐功能核查地图
每个功能至少一次实机驱动验证
最多一个修正 PR，边界清晰

name: make-pr-easy-to-review
description: An AI skill that prepares pull requests for easier review by cleaning history, improving descriptions, and adding reviewer guidance without changing b
description_zh: 通过整理提交历史、优化PR描述和添加审阅指引，让PR更易审阅，且不改变代码行为。
description_original: Prepare PRs for review by cleaning noisy history, improving PR descriptions, and adding reviewer guidance without changing code behavior. Use for
highlights: 整理杂乱的提交历史
自动优化PR描述和审阅指引
不改变代码行为，安全可验证

name: new-branch-and-pr
description: A Cursor skill that creates a fresh branch, completes work, and opens a pull request with verification notes.
description_zh: 创建新分支、完成实现并提交拉取请求的 Cursor 技能。
description_original: Create a fresh branch, complete work, and open a pull request
highlights: 创建新分支并自动完成 PR
内置护栏：聚焦单一变更集
输出 PR 摘要和测试说明

name: no-comments
description: Coding-agent skill that spawns Comment Sicko to audit code comments, fix accepted findings, and encode constraints.
description_zh: 通过 Comment Sicko 子代理审查代码注释、修复认可问题并将约束编码化。
description_original: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.
highlights: 自动审查并清理代码注释
将约束注释编码为规则
生成删除与保留报告

name: orchestrate
description: Cursor skill that decomposes large tasks and spawns parallel cloud agents via /orchestrate.
description_zh: Cursor 技能，通过 /orchestrate 分解大任务并并行调度云代理与验证器协作。
description_original: Use only when the user explicitly types `/orchestrate <goal>` to decompose a large task, spawn a tree of parallel cloud-agent workers/subplanners/verifiers via the Cursor SDK, and collect structured handoffs; do not invoke autonomously.
highlights: 通过 /orchestrate 一键分解大型任务
并行调度 Cursor 云代理和验证器
结构化 handoff 保证任务收敛

name: Poteto Mode
description: A Cursor skill defining poteto's agent style: concise replies, simple code, subagents, and verified work.
description_zh: 定义 poteto 编码风格的 Cursor 技能：简洁回复、精简代码、子代理协作与结果验证。
description_original: poteto's agent style for concise, detailed responses, deliberate subagents, unslopped prose, simple code, and verified work. Use for poteto, /poteto-mode, or requests to work in this style.
highlights: 内置 20+ 编码原则与精细触发规则
支持子代理并行与自动验证工作流
专为 Cursor 智能体打造的技能文件

name: pr-review-canvas
description: Skill that turns GitHub PR data into an interactive HTML code-review walkthrough with annotated diffs.
description_zh: 根据GitHub PR数据生成交互式HTML代码评审走查报告，自动提取Diff并识别核心与机械改动。
description_original: Generate an interactive PR review walkthrough as an HTML page. Fetches PR data via gh API, categorizes files into core vs mechanical changes, adds reviewer annotations, and renders diffs with moved-code detection. Use when the user pastes a GitHub PR URL and asks for a review, walkthrough, or summary, or says
highlights: 自动提取 PR 数据并渲染 Diff
区分核心改动与机械改动
支持移动代码检测与伪代码摘要

name: principle-boundary-discipline
description: A skill guiding AI coding assistants to validate at system boundaries, trust internal types, and keep business logic in pure functions.
description_zh: 指导AI编程助手在系统边界集中校验与错误处理，内部信任类型并用纯函数承载业务逻辑。
description_original: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure functions.
highlights: 系统边界集中校验，内部信任类型
业务逻辑纯函数化，框架解耦
内置自检测试判断验证是否冗余

name: principle-build-the-lever
description: For non-trivial work, build a rerunnable tool (codemod, script, generator, or skill) instead of doing it by hand.
description_zh: 非琐碎工作应构建可重跑工具（脚本/codemod/生成器/技能），而非手工操作，以提升效率与可验证性。
description_original: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead of working by hand. The tool is the artifact a reviewer can rerun.
highlights: 将非平凡工作转为可复跑工具
提升审查置信度与吞吐量
适用于编辑、迁移、分析、检查

name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
description: A skill guiding AI/devs to encode recurring coding lessons as lint rules, checks, or scripts instead of textual instructions.
description_zh: 把重复出现的编码教训落实为 lint 规则、检查或脚本，而非文本指令。
description_original: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.
highlights: 把重复修正固化为自动化机制
提供从 lint 到运行时检查的机制阶梯
明确反模式与反馈闭环

name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
description: A skill guiding AI coding assistants to build 2-3 competing prototypes before committing to novel UI or architecture decisions.
description_zh: 指导AI编程助手在遇到无先例的UI或架构决策时，先构建2-3个竞争性原型再对比选定。
description_original: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.
highlights: 无先例决策时构建2-3个竞争原型
明确适用与不适用场景
提升AI编码方案的探索深度

name: principle-experience-first
description: Skill guiding AI coding assistants to prioritize user delight over implementation convenience in product and UX tradeoffs.
description_zh: 指导AI编程助手在产品与UX取舍中优先考虑用户体验，而非实现便利。
description_original: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.
highlights: 以用户愉悦为最高优先级
少而精：只做精品功能
用于产品与UX权衡决策

name: principle-fix-root-causes
description: A debugging skill that guides AI to trace symptoms to root causes and fix them directly.
description_zh: 调试时先复现、追问根因，修复根本问题而非掩盖症状。
description_original: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom to its root cause and fix it there; reproduce first, ask why until you reach it, resist nil-check guards that silence crashes.
highlights: 先复现再修复，确保修复有效
用“为什么”追问直达根因
拒绝空值保护等表面掩盖

name: principle-foundational-thinking
description: A coding skill: plan data structures and foundational design before writing logic to keep downstream code obvious.
description_zh: 编写代码前先确定数据结构和基础设计，让后续逻辑更清晰。
description_original: Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes obvious.
highlights: 先定数据结构再写逻辑
脚手架优先，按选项价值排序
并发共享前先隔离状态

name: principle-guard-the-context-window
description: A skill that keeps AI coding context efficient by routing large outputs to subagents and keeping only summaries in the main thread.
description_zh: 在AI编程中守护上下文窗口：将大输出路由给子代理，主线程只保留摘要。
description_original: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.
highlights: 上下文窗口守护策略，防止溢出
大输出路由子代理，主线程只留摘要
按需读取，减少无效上下文消耗

name: principle-laziness-protocol
description: A coding-agent skill that minimizes over-engineering by favoring deletion and the smallest change during refactoring.
description_zh: 面向编码代理的懒人协议：重构时偏向删除和最小改动，避免过度工程。
description_original: Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.
highlights: 重构时优先删除，保持最小改动
降低调用层级，简化信号传递
防止 AI 编码代理过度设计

name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
description: A skill guiding AI coding assistants to design state-mutating operations that converge despite crashes, restarts, and retries.
description_zh: 指导 AI 编程助手设计幂等的状态变更操作，确保崩溃、重启和重试后收敛到同一状态。
description_original: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.
highlights: 提供幂等性设计三问测试清单
覆盖收敛启动、内容清理、自愈锁等模式
面向崩溃、重启与重试场景的编码原则

name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
description: A skill that guides AI coding agents to migrate API callers and delete legacy APIs in the same refactor wave instead of keeping compatibility layers.
description_zh: 指导AI在引入新API时同波迁移调用方并删除旧API，避免保留兼容层。
description_original: Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave instead of preserving compatibility layers.
highlights: 同波迁移调用方并删除旧 API
避免保留兼容层增加复杂度
适用于内部 API 重构场景

name: principle-minimize-reader-load
description: A skill for reducing code-reader cognitive load by collapsing unnecessary layers and shrinking mutable state.
description_zh: 通过消除多余抽象层和缩小可变状态，降低代码阅读者认知负担的技能。
description_original: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.
highlights: 专注降低代码阅读者的认知负担
两轴评估：追踪层数与状态持有量
提供 30 秒可读性测试标准

name: principle-model-the-domain
description: A Cursor skill that teaches AI to model domain state in structures instead of scattered conditionals.
description_zh: 一个Cursor技能：指导AI将领域状态建模为结构，而非散布的条件判断。
description_original: Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files. Encode the domain in a structure instead of scattered conditionals.
highlights: 将领域状态建模为数据结构，而非散落的条件判断
涵盖状态机、判别联合、注册表等多种结构
明确提醒不要强行抽象，保持代码简单

name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
description: A skill/principle that tells AI coding agents to proceed with reversible work and only ask humans before irreversible actions.
description_zh: 一个指导AI编码代理的原则：可逆操作直接执行再汇报，不可逆操作才请求人类确认。
description_original: Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work. Proceed, present the result, let the human course-correct after the fact; reserve confirmation for irreversible actions.
highlights: 减少不必要的确认等待，提升 Agent 效率
明确可逆/不可逆操作边界
面向异步监督的工作流程

name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
description: A coding skill principle for AI-assisted rewrites: prioritize end-state integrity over intermediate stability, with planned breakage and final verific
description_zh: 用于计划内重写与迁移的AI编码技能：以目标架构为准，接受可管理的临时破坏并完成最终验证。
description_original: Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states with throwaway compatibility code.
highlights: 面向AI编码的重写与迁移原则
强调目标架构收敛而非过渡兼容
内置守则：声明可接受的临时破坏

name: principle-prove-it-works
description: Skill for AI agents: verify completed coding work against real artifacts (run features, inspect diffs), not proxies or self-reports.
description_zh: AI 智能体技能：完成任务后用真实产物验证（运行功能、读取数值、检查 diff），而非代理信号或自我报告。
description_original: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'
highlights: 核心原则：用真实产物验证，而非代理信号
覆盖端到端数据流与集成测试
可脚本化验证，保留可复查的工件

name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
description: A skill that guides AI assistants to redesign existing code as if a new requirement existed from day one.
description_zh: 指导 AI 助手在集成新需求时，以第一性原理重新设计现有代码。
description_original: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design. Redesign as if the requirement had been a foundational assumption from day one, instead of bolting it on.
highlights: 像需求一开始就存在一样重新设计
不把新需求硬塞进旧架构
从全局传播变更到所有引用

name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
description: A skill that says eliminate shared mutable state before serializing access; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.
description_zh: 并发写共享状态前先消除共享；仅在真正需要单一写入者时使用结构化串行化（锁/顺序/独占）。
description_original: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.
highlights: 先消除共享写入再考虑串行化
强调结构化锁文件/顺序/独占
适合多代理并发写同一状态

name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
description: A skill that sequences multi-step coding work into small verifiable units, checking each before advancing.
description_zh: 将多步编码工作拆分为可验证的小单元，逐项检查后再推进，并以此顺序提交代码。
description_original: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next, and order delivery so the sequence proves itself to a reviewer.
highlights: 将工作拆分为可验证的小单元
先红后绿，逐项验证再推进
按可证明顺序堆叠提交与 PR

name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
description: A coding skill that instructs AI to remove dead weight and complexity before adding or refactoring features.
description_zh: 在新增或重构前先移除冗余，基于更简化的基础构建功能的AI编码技能。
description_original: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead weight, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.
highlights: 先删后建：先移除死代码再开发
减少复杂系统表面积，降低新增脆弱性
避免过度设计和投机校验器

name: principle-type-system-discipline
description: Skill for enforcing type-system discipline in statically typed languages: eliminate illegal states, brand primitives, parse at boundaries.
description_zh: 在静态类型语言中运用类型系统纪律：让非法状态不可表示、语义原语类型化、在边界解析数据、强制穷尽匹配。
description_original: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at boundaries, refuse to lie to the compiler, exhaust variants, derive from authoritative schemas.
highlights: 让非法状态在编译期不可表示
品牌化语义原始类型
边界处显式解析未类型化数据

name: ralph-loop-help
description: A Cursor skill that explains the Ralph Loop iterative AI coding technique, including usage, options, and completion promises.
description_zh: 解释 Ralph Loop 迭代式 AI 编程技法，涵盖用法、选项与完成标记的 Cursor 技能。
description_original: Explain the Ralph Loop plugin, how it works, and available skills. Use when the user asks for help with ralph loop, wants to understand the technique, or needs usage examples.
search_terms: 持续 AI 编程循环
highlights: 解释 Ralph Loop 迭代开发技法
支持最大迭代次数与完成标记
明确划分适用与不适用场景

name: recall
description: Cursor skill that reconstructs recent coding context from chat history and shared records into a tight current-state brief.
description_zh: 从聊天记录和共享记录重建近期编码上下文，输出简洁的当前状态简报的 Cursor 技能。
description_original: Reconstruct your recent working context from your own chat history, live state, and the shared record (user reports, prior fixes, incidents), then hand back a tight current-state brief. Use for 'recall my work on X', 'catch me up', 'what have I been working on', 'where did I leave off', before starting or resuming work.
highlights: 自动重建最近 7 天工作上下文
并行子代理检索聊天与共享记录
输出带状态标签的线程简报

name: reflect
description: Cursor skill that spawns three parallel review subagents to mine transcripts and route learnings into concrete skill edits.
description_zh: 通过三个并行审核子代理挖掘对话经验，并将其整理成技能编辑的 Cursor 技能。
description_original: Spawn three parallel review subagents over the active transcript, surface learnings, and route each to a concrete edit on an existing skill. Use when the user says reflect.
highlights: 并行三个审核子代理挖掘对话经验
经验路由到现有技能的具体修改
应用前需用户批准，保障组织安全

name: reproduce-and-fix-issues
description: Reproduce Slack-reported bugs via a UI control adapter, verify existing fixes, and open a bounded draft PR only after proof.
description_zh: 通过UI控制适配器复现Slack上报的Bug，验证既有修复，并在前后证据齐全后提交受控的草稿PR。
description_original: Reproduce triaged Slack bugs through a configured app-control adapter, verify existing fixes, and open a bounded draft pull request only after before-and-after proof. Use only from the configured Benny repro automation.
highlights: 严格安全护栏：无复现不修代码
真实UI双次复现，前后证据确认
仅在验证完成后提交草稿PR

name: review-and-ship
description: Cursor skill that reviews branch changes for bugs, tests coverage, commits focused work, and opens or updates PRs.
description_zh: 审查当前分支的代码缺陷与测试覆盖，运行测试、提交改动并创建或更新PR的Cursor技能。
description_original: Review the current branch for bugs, intent fit, and test coverage; run or write tests; commit focused work; open or update a PR.
highlights: 审查分支代码缺陷与测试覆盖
运行或编写测试并修复关键问题
提交代码并创建或更新PR

name: review-plugin-submission

search_terms: 规约优先 AI 编码
highlights: 苏格拉底式访谈，模糊度高于 0.2 阻止 Seed 生成

name: talk-pipeline
description: Orchestrates the complete talk preparation pipeline from raw material to revision sheets, running 6 stages in sequence with human-in-the-loop checkpoints for REX or Concept mode talks. Use when starting a new talk pipeline, resuming a pipeline from a specific stage, or running the full end-to-end preparation workflow.

name: talk-stage1-extract
description: Extracts and structures source material (articles, transcripts, notes) into a talk summary with narrative arc, themes, metrics, and gaps. Auto-detects REX vs Concept type. Use when starting a new talk from any source material or auditing existing material before committing to a talk.

name: talk-stage2-research
description: Performs git archaeology, changelog analysis, and builds a verified factual timeline by cross-referencing git history with source material. REX mode only (skipped automatically in Concept mode). Use when building a REX talk and you need verified commit metrics, release timelines, and contributor data from a git repository.

name: talk-stage3-concepts
description: Builds a numbered, categorized concept catalogue from the talk summary and timeline, scoring each concept HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW for talk potential with optional repo enrichment. Use when you need a structured inventory of concepts before choosing a talk angle, or when assessing which ideas have the strongest presentation potential.

name: talk-stage4-position
description: Generates 3-4 strategic talk angles with strength/weakness analysis, title options, CFP descriptions, and a peer feedback draft, then enforces a mandatory CHECKPOINT for user confirmation before scripting. Use when deciding how to frame a talk, preparing a CFP submission, or choosing between multiple narrative angles.

name: talk-stage5-script
description: Produces a complete 5-act pitch with speaker notes, a slide-by-slide specification, and a ready-to-paste Kimi prompt for AI slide generation. Requires validated angle and title from Stage 4. Use when you have a confirmed talk angle and need the full script, slide spec, and AI-generated presentation prompt.

name: talk-stage6-revision
description: Produces revision sheets with quick navigation by act, a master concept-to-URL table, Q&A cheat-sheet with 6-10 anticipated questions, glossary, and external resources list. Use when preparing for a talk with Q&A, creating shareable reference material for attendees, or building a safety-net glossary for live delivery.

name: token-audit
description: Audit Claude Code configuration to measure fixed-context token overhead and produce a prioritized action plan. Use when hitting rate limits, experiencing early context compression, or after adding significant config files.

name: update-threat-db
description: Update the guide's threat intelligence through AgentSec Triage, research new coding-agent and MCP security advisories, and synchronize the security feed. Use for threat database refreshes or mise a jour de la base de menaces, not repository security scans or Claude Code release tracking.

name: validate-changes

name: voice-refine

An interview scores how vague your request is, and a score above the bar blocks spec generation until you pass force explicitly. Redaction of those values elsewhere is literal over five encodings, so a reshaped copy can still get through; that gap is tracked in a public issue.

name: argus
description: Argus is an automated web security scanner suite covering CORS, CRLF, NoSQLi, JWT, OOB, and LLM red-team attacks.
description_zh: Argus 是一套自动化的 Web 与 LLM 安全扫描器，覆盖 CORS、CRLF、NoSQL 注入、JWT 攻击、OOB 盲注确认和 LLM 红队测试。
description_original: Argus — the all-seeing scanner suite. Six automated scanners for high-value web + LLM bug classes — CORS misconfiguration (origin reflection / null / credentialed read), CRLF & host-header injection, NoSQL injection (operator auth-bypass / $where blind), JWT attacks (alg:none / RS256→HS256 confusion / secret crack), out-of-band confirmation of blind SSRF/XXE/SQLi/RCE/Log4Shell via interactsh, and an LLM red-team corpus (prompt-injection / jailbreak / system-prompt leak / exfil / indirect injection). Use when a target exposes a JSON API, a login endpoint, JWT auth, a parameter that might reach the server, a chatbot/agent, or any endpoint suspected of a blind/out-of-band bug.
highlights: 六大扫描器覆盖 CORS/CRLF/NoSQLi/JWT/OOB/LLM
OOB 盲漏洞确认支持 interactsh 回调关联
纯 Python 实现，无额外依赖，可离线测试核心逻辑

name: client-reverse
description: Skill for reversing client-side request signing and anti-bot tokens in bug-bounty workflows, enabling replay and fuzzing of protected APIs.
description_zh: 用于漏洞赏金的客户端请求签名与反爬令牌逆向技能，可在客户端外复现请求并模糊测试受保护API。
description_original: 'Client-side request-signing and anti-bot token reversal for bug bounty — when a request carries a sign/sig/hmac/token/nonce/timestamp/X-Sensor header that Burp Repeater cannot replay, recover the signer just enough to reproduce the request outside the client. Packet-first staging (capture real request → prove replay works → only reverse if replay fails) across the locate→recover→runtime→validation→replay spine. Covers tracing backward from the signature field (writer→builder→entry→source), isolating user-mutable sign inputs (timestamp/nonce/deviceId/body) vs constants (secret key), hooking fetch/XHR in DevTools, JS deobfuscation basics (webpack/wasm/JSVMP), and the bounty payoff: reach the protected API to then hunt IDOR/auth/business-logic. Use when Burp/mitmproxy replay of a signed or anti-bot-gated request fails and you suspect a client-computed field is blocking you.'
highlights: Packet-first 判定：先重放、后逆向
覆盖 locate→recover→runtime→validation→replay 全流程
附可运行 Python 签名与 IDOR 扫描模板

name: consolidate-notes
description: Promote existing research into a stable-status canonical article under `articles/` in a Knowledge Base project (the `knowledge-base` starter pack). Read when a decision has actually been made and the team wants the source-of-truth written down, or when asked to consolidate, canonicalize, promote research, or supersede an older article. Carries the decision-confirmation gate, the `supersedes:` chain that keeps the evidence trail intact, and the canonical voice. Does not conduct new research — that is the sibling `research-with-sources` skill.

name: frame-a-proposal
description: Frame a new design proposal (RFC-shape) under proposals/ — problem before solution, named beneficiary and observable change, real alternatives, honest drawbacks, and a live open-questions backlog. Read when asked to frame a proposal, write an RFC, propose a design, pitch a change, draft a PRD-style design doc, or open a design proposal for review. Do NOT read to record a decision after it is accepted (use record-a-decision), to write an implementation spec (use write-a-spec), to write a postmortem (use write-a-postmortem), or to review or critique an existing design (use review-a-design).

name: record-a-decision
description: Records an architecture decision as a Nygard/MADR-shaped ADR under decisions/ — capturing the context that forced the choice, the options weighed, the decision itself, and its consequences in both directions, plus the supersedes chain that keeps a decision log honest. Read when asked to record an architecture decision, write an ADR, log the decision we made, document why we chose X over Y, capture this decision for the record, or supersede an old decision with a new one. Do NOT read to frame a proposal or explore an idea not yet decided (frame-a-proposal), to write a spec or implementation plan (write-a-spec), to write an incident postmortem (write-a-postmortem), or to judge whether a design is sound (review-a-design). This skill records a decision already made; it does not make one.

name: research-with-sources
description: Investigate a topic against preserved sources and write a draft-status research article under `research/` in a Knowledge Base project (the `knowledge-base` starter pack). Read when asked to research a topic, compare options, synthesize sources, gather evidence, or extend an existing research doc. Carries the full procedure: scan existing coverage, agree a research rubric, capture every source verbatim before analyzing, write the article incrementally so a crash never loses work, cite every claim, and link it back into the graph. Does not promote findings to canonical knowledge — that is the sibling `consolidate-notes` skill, after a decision lands.

name: review-a-design
description: Reviews whether a design is SOUND — solving the right problem, derived from its stated goals and constraints — and emits ranked, evidence-backed findings, not edits. Read when asked to 'review this design', 'is this design sound', 'pressure-test this proposal', 'do a design review', 'does this solve the right problem', 'poke holes in this spec', 'should we build this', or to critique a proposal / spec / ADR / architecture or product decision. Do NOT read when the user wants to AUTHOR one of these — routing a new proposal is frame-a-proposal, a spec is write-a-spec, a decision record is record-a-decision, a postmortem is write-a-postmortem. Do NOT read for code review of a diff, or to fact-check individual claims (that is a correctness pass, a different job).

name: write-a-postmortem
description: Write a blameless incident postmortem under postmortems/ following the Google SRE shape — evidence-based timeline, trigger vs root cause vs symptom, contributing factors, what went well, and owned+dated+verifiable action items. Read when asked to write a postmortem, do an incident review, run a root cause analysis, write up the outage, retro on the outage, or when the user says we had an incident and wants it documented. Do NOT read to frame a proposal (use frame-a-proposal), write a spec (use write-a-spec), record a decision (use record-a-decision), or review a design (use review-a-design) — a postmortem documents an incident that already happened, it does not propose, specify, decide, or critique future work.

name: write-a-spec
description: Scope a feature end to end and write an implementation spec under specs/ from an accepted proposal — current-system mapping, goals/non-goals, a Decision Log for one-way-door choices, a live Open Questions backlog, and a real migration + test plan. Read when asked to write a spec, scope this feature, turn this proposal into a spec, plan the implementation, or break this into tasks. Do NOT fire on frame a proposal or write the PRD (sibling frame-a-proposal — a PRD frames a change before it is accepted; this skill starts once one is), record a decision or write the ADR (record-a-decision), write a postmortem (write-a-postmortem), or review this design (review-a-design) — those are separate skills. Complements the platform open-knowledge skill; does not replace it.

name: x-article-draft-uploader
description: A Playwright skill that uploads local/Obsidian Markdown into X/Twitter Articles drafts with native tables and 5:2 cover handling.
description_zh: 使用 Playwright 将 Markdown 文章上传到 X Article 草稿，支持原生表格与 5:2 封面图处理。
description_original: 将 Obsidian 或本地 Markdown 文章上传到 X/Twitter Articles 草稿；支持 Markdown pipe 表格转成 X 原生表格块；如果文章最上方有图片，则按当前 X 界面提示的 5:2 封面图上传；如果没有封面图，则跳过封面区域，直接上传标题、正文、表格和正文图片，完成后提醒用户补一张 5:2 封面。X Article 当前实测正文最多 25 个媒体项，封面单独上传且不占正文名额；表格尺寸选择器当前最大 10 x 10。适用于用户要求上传、发布、保存 Markdown 到 X Article，尤其是需要复用 Chrome 登录态、使用独立 Playwright 浏览器、不接管用户当前浏览器，或旧脚本出现缺图、错位、MPH_MARKER、表格变纯文本等问题时。
highlights: 复用 Chrome 登录态，独立 Playwright 会话不抢浏览器
Markdown 管道表格转为 X 原生表格块
支持 25 张正文图 + 5:2 独立封面

search_terms: Agent Memory Vault 共享记忆
highlights: 支持 Claude Code 与 Codex 共享记忆
Markdown 为唯一事实源，SQLite 为派生状态
提供安装、检索、审计与维护操作手册

name: yichen-asr
description: A unified ASR routing skill that picks between StepFun Step ASR and Volcengine Doubao ASR for local audio/video transcription.
description_zh: 统一路由音视频转写技能，按输出需求在 Step ASR 与豆包 ASR 间选择后端并做体检与失败回退。
description_original: 逸尘自用的统一音视频转写入口，在 StepFun Step ASR 与火山引擎豆包 ASR 之间按输出需求、安全边界和可用状态路由。用于本地音频或视频的纯文本转写、时间戳、SRT 字幕、口播粗剪，以及转写前体检；用户明确指定服务商时不得静默切换。Use when a local audio or video file needs transcription and the correct ASR backend is unclear, or when the user explicitly invokes $yichen-asr.
highlights: Step 与豆包双后端智能路由
支持时间戳、SRT 字幕与口播粗剪
执行前只读体检，密钥与费用安全

name: yichen-bookmarks-export
description: Read-only Claude skill that exports private Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and X/Twitter bookmarks to local link files via Chrome automation and GraphQL.
description_zh: 只读导出小红书、抖音、X/Twitter 私人收藏与书签为本地链接文件的 Claude Skill。
description_original: 在用户当轮明确授权后，只读导出其小红书收藏、抖音收藏或 X/Twitter 书签为本地链接文件；本 Skill 直接完成收藏页滚动、链接提取、去重、数量核验、Field Theory GraphQL-only 导出和抽样验证。用于“导出/备份/同步我的收藏或书签链接”等私人数据导出任务；不得用于公开搜索、收藏内容分析、媒体下载、正文归档、推荐发现或未获当轮授权的私人读取。
highlights: 只读导出小红书/抖音/X 私人收藏链接
全流程当轮授权校验，保护私人数据
支持去重、数量核验与链接抽样验证

name: yichen-chatgpt-web-research
description: Agent skill that uses a signed-in ChatGPT web account via Chrome plugin or Computer Use for product and market research, avoiding API cost.
description_zh: 通过 Chrome 插件或电脑操作，使用已登录 ChatGPT 网页账号进行产品/市场调研，避免 API 费用。
description_original: Use the user's already signed-in official ChatGPT website account, especially GPT-5.5 Pro / ChatGPT Pro, to perform product research, market research, competitor research, second-opinion analysis, or any request that says ChatGPT 官网, ChatGPT 网页版, GPT-5.5 Pro, 5.5 Pro, 用官网调研, 产品调研, 市场调研, or avoid API cost. Prefer the Chrome plugin/extension route; if it is unavailable or cannot attach, fall back to Computer Use on the real visible Chrome window/profile. This skill must control the real ChatGPT web page in the intended Chrome account/profile; it must not open a different free-account window, use OpenAI API, use web search alone, use generic Playwright, or use the deprecated chatgpt-web MCP.
highlights: 使用已登录 ChatGPT 网页账号调研
Chrome 插件优先，Computer Use 兜底
强制验证 Pro 账号与完成标记

name: yichen-codex-chatgpt
description: A Codex skill for using ChatGPT Pro website as architect and reviewer while Codex edits and tests local code via a secure read-only tunnel.
description_zh: 一个 Codex 技能：通过安全隧道和只读 MCP，让 ChatGPT Pro 网站负责架构与审查，Codex 只在本地编辑和测试代码。
description_original: Use the signed-in ChatGPT website in Chat UI Pro mode, never Work mode, to research, architect, and review one local project through a configured Secure Tunnel and read-only MCP, while Codex alone edits and tests locally. Trigger on explicit $yichen-codex-chatgpt, 让 ChatGPT 设计后由 Codex 写代码, ChatGPT 架构并审查 Codex, or requests for a Codex and ChatGPT collaboration loop. Pure research stays on the official ChatGPT website; code and hybrid work follow ChatGPT PLAN to Codex execution to ChatGPT REVIEW. Website control defaults to in-app browser, then Chrome, then bounded Computer Use. Use a compatible local-only MCP only when the user explicitly requests local-only mode and that optional dependency is configured, never as an automatic fallback.
search_terms: 只读 MCP 安全隧道
highlights: ChatGPT Pro 规划审查，Codex 本地改测
只读 MCP + 安全隧道，代码不外贴
支持 research/code/hybrid/review 四种路由

多级回退的 X/Twitter 只读搜索
解码 Snowflake ID 内嵌时间戳

description_original: 在装有匹配版本剪映的 Apple Silicon Mac 上，无界面生成可编辑草稿、修改已有多轨草稿的独立副本，或按明确要求导出原生 MP4。需要另行检出 Jianying Headless 核心项目；纯转写不使用本 Skill。

highlights: 无界面生成可编辑剪映草稿
保留原项目修改多轨草稿副本
严格版本与哈希校验，拒绝旧快照

name: yichen-mac-wechat-dual-open
description: A macOS agent skill that creates a second WeChat app via bundle-id change, ad-hoc code signing, and blue icon recoloring without launching it.
description_zh: macOS 微信双开技能：复制微信、改 bundle id、重签名并把图标改为蓝色，仅准备由用户手动打开。

Never launch or control WeChat.

highlights: 复制微信生成第二个 App，改 bundle id 并重签名
仅替换副本图标，绿改蓝，保留白色气泡
内置安全约束：绝不启动或控制微信

name: yichen-web-research
description: A routing-layer skill that orchestrates multi-stage, evidence-gated internet research across search, archive, bookmark-export and ASR sub-skills.
description_zh: 逸尘自用的互联网研究总入口，负责多阶段、跨平台、有证据门禁的深度研究路由与调度。
description_original: 逸尘自用的互联网研究总入口。用于跨平台且跨阶段、用户尚未确定工具，或明确要求对公司、产品、人物、技术、行业和领域做横纵分析、发展史加现状对比或有来源约束的系统深度研究；先生成有截止日期和证据闸门的计划，再把搜索发现、候选核验、有限归档、按需转写和证据综合路由到 yichen-unified-search、yichen-content-archive、yichen-bookmarks-export 与 yichen-asr。若用户只要求搜索、只处理已知链接、只导出私人收藏或只转写已有音视频，应直接使用对应子 Skill。Use when an internet-research request spans multiple stages, requires evidence-grounded longitudinal and cross-sectional synthesis, the correct child route is unclear, or the user explicitly invokes $yichen-web-research.
highlights: 多阶段深度研究路由
证据门禁与范围控制
只读安全边界与限速

name: modlens

description_zh: 为纯文本模型提供视觉能力，通过 modlens CLI 将图片转换为结构化 JSON 证据。
description_original: Plug-in vision for text-only models. Hard rule: when a file path or URL with an image extension (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .heic, .heif) appears anywhere in the conversation (typed by the user, injected as a `[Image: source: <path>]` line, or inside a tag) and you cannot see that image's content, run this skill on it before any other approach: no self-built OCR, no PIL, no tesseract. Also triggers on pasted-image placeholders such as `[Image #1]` and `[Unsupported Image]`. If you can actually see the image, do not use this skill. When unsure, run `modlens guard` before the first read of a session: a deny verdict means the active model has native vision and must read the image itself. Runs the modlens CLI to convert the image into structured JSON evidence: every word transcribed, layout regions, semantics, visual clues. Also use when the user asks how to install, configure, or switch modlens providers (Gemini API key, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Claude API or Claude Code CLI).
highlights: 为纯文本模型提供图片视觉能力
结构化 JSON 输出 OCR/布局/语义
支持 Gemini/OpenAI/Claude 多提供商

npx 包管理器拉取远程包（如 @agentclientprotocol/*）
各 AI 厂商 API 端点（OpenAI、Anthropic 等）
commands: npx pi-acp、openclaw acp、npx -y @agentclientprotocol/codex-acp 等内置代理命令

flow 中 action 节点可执行 shell 命令

security.summary: acpx 是一个多代理编排 CLI 工具，本身功能合法但权限面较广：支持执行任意代理命令、自动批准权限、存储凭据、flow 中可执行 shell，需用户了解风险后谨慎使用。

flow 中的 action 节点应审查具体命令内容后再执行
定期使用 sessions prune 清理过期会话数据

security.summary: 该插件为澳大利亚政府合规文档生成工具，包含8个命令，均用于生成合规评估文档（如E8、ISM、DSS、PIA等），仅在本地项目目录写入Markdown文件，无网络传输或敏感数据访问行为。

description_zh: 用于 Supabase 的 MCP 服务器，支持通过 AI 聊天接口安全执行 SQL、管理数据库和访问管理 API。

red_flags: 要求用户提供多个敏感凭据（数据库密码、Service Role Key、Access Token）
env 中包含 SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY 可绕过 Row Level Security 直接操作数据库
command 指向用户本地绝对路径，来源和完整性无法验证
security.summary: Supabase 官方 MCP 服务器，需要用户提供数据库密码和服务角色密钥等高权限凭据，功能合理但 Service Role Key 权限极大，建议最小化授权。
recommendations: 确认 supabase-mcp-server 二进制来源可信（官方渠道下载）
避免使用 service_role key，优先使用 anon key 限制权限范围
定期轮换所使用的 Supabase 凭据
如非必要，不要将真实数据库密码写入配置文件

description_original: Query MCP enables end-to-end management of Supabase via chat interface: read & write query executions, management API support, automatic migration versioning, access to logs and much more.
highlights: 支持 Cursor/Windsurf/Cline 等 IDE 集成
内置三层 SQL 操作安全控制机制
自动数据库迁移版本管理
mcp_installability_reason: 配置模板完整但需要用户提供 API 密钥、项目引用等环境变量，且命令路径需用户本地安装后确定。

name: browser-use-mcp-server
description: An MCP server enabling AI agents to control web browsers via browser-use, supporting SSE and stdio transports.
description_zh: 一个MCP服务器，使AI代理能够通过browser-use控制网络浏览器，支持SSE和stdio传输。

red_flags: 启动本地服务器并开放端口 8000、9000，存在网络暴露风险
环境变量要求提供 OPENAI_API_KEY，涉及敏感凭据
browser-use 类工具通常具备浏览器自动化能力，可能读写网页与本地交互
无文档说明具体访问范围与安全边界

files: 工作目录内文件（browser-use 可能读写本地文件）

security.summary: 该 MCP server 通过浏览器自动化工具启动本地服务并要求 OpenAI API Key，涉及网络端口暴露和敏感凭据，需关注访问范围与安全配置。
recommendations: 确认 browser-use-mcp-server 的实际功能与访问范围，查看其官方文档
不要在共享或生产环境直接使用，建议在隔离的沙箱中运行
妥善管理 OPENAI_API_KEY，避免硬编码或泄露
限制 8000 和 9000 端口的外部访问，确保仅本地可用

description_original: Browse the web, directly from Cursor etc.
highlights: 支持SSE和stdio双传输模式
提供VNC实时流媒体观看
Docker一键部署
mcp_installability_reason: 配置模板有效，但需要用户提供OPENAI_API_KEY，并且需要本地构建和全局安装。

name: Hyperbrowser

red_flags: 通过npx直接远程下载并执行hyperbrowser-mcp包，无本地校验

recommendations: 确认hyperbrowser-mcp包的来源和安全性，检查npm包的维护者和下载量

name: architecture-studio
description:
Description:

Architecture Studio is a Claude plugin system for architects, designers, and AEC professionals. It includes 7 autonomous agents, 36 skills, 6 rules, and 3 hooks organized into 9 installable plugins — covering site research, NYC property due diligence, zoning envelope analysis, workplace programming, CSI specifications, sustainability (EPD parsing and comparison), FF&E product research, and presentation generation.

A single entry point (`/studio`) routes users to the right agent or skill based on natural language. Agents orchestrate multiple skills, exercise judgment, and hand off to each other across the project lifecycle. Skills ship with bundled reference data — NYC Zoning Resolution chapters, IBC occupancy load factors, workplace benchmarks, and Uruguay zoning regulations.

Key features:

- `/studio` smart router — describe your task, get routed automatically
- 7 agents with handoff logic (site planner → zoning expert → workplace strategist → materials researcher → FF&E designer → sustainability specialist → brand manager)
- Modular install — users pick the plugins they need
- 6 always-on rules governing units, code citations, disclaimers, CSI formatting, terminology, and output structure
- MIT licensed, open source

使用 --network=host 让容器直接访问主机网络栈，存在网络隔离绕过风险

recommendations: 在使用前审查容器镜像 ghcr.io/alexei-led/k8s-mcp-server 的源码和构建过程

使用只读挂载 (-v ...:ro) 限制 kubeconfig 的写入权限
考虑使用独立的、权限最小化的 kubeconfig 文件而非完整的 ~/.kube 目录
在隔离环境或专用 CI 机器上运行，避免在开发主机上直接暴露集群凭据

AgentCall turns any AI coding agent into a meeting participant. Install the `join-meeting` command, give your agent a meeting link, and the agent joins the call as a bot with a name and visual presence — it can talk, listen, screenshare, chat, and keep working on your codebase while in the meeting. - Audio-only — voice presence for standups and 1-on-1s
- Webpage-avatar — voice + animated visual presence
- Webpage-avatar-with-screenshare — full presence for presentations and demos

What's included: real-time transcription (English, more languages coming soon), interruption handling, 54 TTS voices across 9 languages, collaborative mode with GetSun voice intelligence for natural multi-party conversations, direct mode with Kokoro TTS for latency-sensitive 1-on-1 interactions.

API key required (free sign-up, no credit card): https://app.agentcall.dev

name: superpowers-optimized
description: Claude Code plugin adding disciplined agent workflows: 3-tier routing, TDD, safety hooks, cross-session memory, and red-teaming.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供三层工作流路由、TDD 强制、安全钩子、跨会话记忆与对抗式红队测试的智能体开发框架。
description_original:
Built on the trusted obra/superpowers workflow and refined through research into LLM agent behavior, it adds automatic 3-tier workflow routing, proactive safety hooks, self-consistency verification at critical decision points, cross-session memory, and adversarial red-teaming — everything the original does, plus the discipline layer it was missing.

Cross-session memory changes the experience fundamentally. Without it, every session starts blind: the AI re-explores structure it already mapped, re-proposes approaches that were already rejected, re-debugs errors that were already solved. With the four-file memory stack, it arrives knowing what was tried, what was decided, and why — and builds forward instead of sideways.

Five research-backed principles run throughout: *less is more* (minimal always-on instructions), *fresh context beats accumulated context* (subagents get clean scoped prompts, not polluted history), *compliance ≠ competence* (instructions must be carefully engineered, not just comprehensive), *verify your own reasoning* (multi-path self-consistency catches confident-but-wrong failures before they become expensive), and *accountability drives accuracy* (agents that know their output has real downstream consequences perform better).
highlights: 三层工作流路由与复杂度分类
跨会话记忆与项目地图自动注入
安全钩子拦截危险命令与密钥泄露

red_flags: 启动 tmux worker 会绕过权限提示直接执行工具调用
读取并中继认证凭据（~/.claude、~/.codex、~/.pi/agent）到 worker 进程

hooks 注册了多种 Claude Code 生命周期事件并执行外部 node 脚本
security.summary: 该插件通过 tmux 启动并驱动多个编码 agent 会话，worker 以 bypassed permissions 模式运行且会中继本地认证凭据，功能强大但存在权限绕过和凭据转发风险，建议仔细评估后使用。
recommendations: 确认 worker 以 bypassed permissions 运行是预期行为，了解这意味着工具调用不会弹出确认
注意凭据会从 ~/.claude、~/.codex 等目录中继到 worker，确保 worker 只运行在可信项目中
监控 /tmp/csd-workers 目录，避免敏感数据泄露
审查 hooks 注册的 emit-event.cjs 脚本源码以确认其行为无隐藏逻辑

description_zh: 可移植的 AI 协作技能，通过对话学习你的编码习惯，并在各智能体中应用情境感知的判断。
description_original:
Imprint creates a portable collaboration profile by learning how you work through natural conversation. On first run, it asks a few casual questions about your background, tools, and preferences. From there, it silently observes your behavior patterns across sessions and encodes them into a compact structured file (.dna.md) under 500 tokens.

This single file replaces eleven specialized skills: memory persistence across sessions, output compression, project onboarding, code review (with cross-model validation), architecture-first debugging, adaptive planning, milestone-based progress tracking, resource-aware testing strategies, SEO-conscious git workflows, and GEO-optimized copywriting.

The profile is a plain text file that works across all 19 SKILL.md-compatible agents. Switch from Claude Code to Cursor to Codex, the file comes with you. No vendor lock-in, no proprietary format, no external API calls.

Imprint gets better every session. User corrections become permanent preferences. Debugging lessons become permanent immunity. The more you use it, the less you need to explain.
highlights: 跨多种 SKILL.md 智能体的可移植配置文件
纠正即永久偏好，会话间持续学习
内置判断层，自动决定执行/确认/停止

description_original:
A causal inference plugin for AI agents. Describe a problem in plain language and it helps you choose a method, check assumptions, write the analysis in R or Python, and stress-test the results.

Who this is for: Anyone who needs to measure whether something actually worked, such as Marketing and growth teams; Product managers and BI analysts; Data scientists; Revenue and operations teams; Policy researchers; Students and self-taught practitioners.

What you get from this plugin
The plugin works in five steps, from refining the question you want to answer, to writing the report. You are free to pick and start from any step you like.

→ Describe your problem
→ Get a method recommendation
→ Check assumptions and structure the analysis
→ Stress-test the results
→ Write the executive report

name: akii-seo-ai-search-optimizer
description:
Free SEO, AEO, and GEO toolkit by Akii. Audit websites, plan content strategy, optimize pages, generate schema markup, cluster keywords, and track AI visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Google AI Overviews — all from your terminal or IDE.

Ships 15 model-invoked skills (auto-trigger from natural language), 5 autonomous agents, and 8 slash commands. Encodes per-engine algorithm signal weights (ChatGPT 41% authoritative lists, Gemini 49% Google lists + 3.5★ review cutoff, Perplexity 64% top-5 lists, Claude 68% trusted business databases) and the Princeton/IIT-Delhi/Allen Institute GEO method (validated +40% AI visibility lift; +97–115% for pages ranked outside top 5).

Auto-detects user's existing Ahrefs, Google Search Console, DataForSEO, and Apify MCPs for richer real-data outputs; falls back to WebFetch and WebSearch when not available. No login. No usage cap. No external dependencies — every skill works standalone via Claude Code's built-in tools.

The /ai-visibility-score command returns a real 0–100 score across four dimensions (Brand Recognition, Brand Understanding, Content Coverage, Brand Sentiment) via the same workflow that powers akii.com — no signup required.

MIT licensed.

The goal is to make Claude Code feel less like a fresh assistant on every launch and more like a continuous agent that remembers context, adapts to the user, and maintains a stable sense of self across sessions.

name: session-orchestrator
description: Claude Code plugin that orchestrates AI coding sessions into typed waves with parallel subagents, inter-wave quality gates, and verified close-out.

args:
# Tier order MIRRORS resolvePluginRoot() — see scripts/lib/plugin-root.mjs § TIER ORDER (the single source of truth). That list is the original, this is the mirror: change both together. The env list, the CODEX_HOME trim, the package.json{name} test and the newest-wins-by-mtime tiebreak are all mirrored EXACTLY; only tier 6 (walk up from import.meta.url) has no shell analogue.
r=""; ch="$CODEX_HOME"; ch="${ch#"${ch%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; ch="${ch%"${ch##*[![:space:]]}"}"; [ -n "$ch" ] || ch="$HOME/.codex"; for c in "$PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$CURSOR_RULES_DIR" "$PI_PLUGIN_ROOT" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)"; do if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -f "$c/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ]; then r="$c"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$r" ]; then r="$(NODE_PATH="$(npm root -g 2>/dev/null)" node -e 'import(require(`node:url`).pathToFileURL(require.resolve(`session-orchestrator/scripts/lib/plugin-root.mjs`))).then(m=>process.stdout.write(m.resolvePluginRoot()))' 2>/dev/null)"; fi; if [ -z "$r" ]; then for b in "$ch" "$HOME/.claude"; do for c in "$b"/plugins/cache/*/session-orchestrator/*; do if [ -f "$c/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ] && node -e 'process.exit(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")).name==="session-orchestrator"?0:1)' "$c/package.json" 2>/dev/null && { [ -z "$r" ] || [ "$c" -nt "$r" ]; }; then r="$c"; fi; done; done; fi; if [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/mcp-server.sh" ]; then exec bash "$r/scripts/mcp-server.sh"; fi; { echo "session-orchestrator: cannot locate the plugin root — the MCP server did not start."; echo "  Tried: PLUGIN_ROOT=${PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT=${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, CURSOR_RULES_DIR=${CURSOR_RULES_DIR:-(unset)}, PI_PLUGIN_ROOT=${PI_PLUGIN_ROOT:-(unset)}, git rev-parse --show-toplevel (cwd=$PWD), node resolve of session-orchestrator/scripts/lib/plugin-root.mjs, plugin caches $ch/plugins/cache/*/session-orchestrator/* and $HOME/.claude/plugins/cache/*/session-orchestrator/*."; echo "  Fix: reinstall the plugin so its cached copy is refreshed (codex plugin marketplace add Kanevry/session-orchestrator), or set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT to the plugin directory in this server's env block."; echo "  Note: CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT is session-orchestrator's own compatibility export, not a variable Codex provides. See docs/codex-setup.md § Troubleshooting."; } >&2; exit 1

name: cc-suite
description: cc-suite turns three CLI tools (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, Google Gemini CLI) into one shared brain. Project context is written once in AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md just `@AGENTS.md` to import it. Skills live in `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/` symlinks to it, so the same skill works in all three CLIs. Hooks defined for Claude Code are mirrored into Codex's hook system. MCP servers in .mcp.json are visible to all three. The Claude↔Codex delegation lane is bidirectional: from Claude, /cc-suite:audit, :implement, :verify, :review, :bug-analyze, and :review-plan all hand work to Codex and return structured results. Supersedes the separate cc-bridge and codex-toolkit plugins.

SkillCheck Free validates Claude Code SKILL.md files against ~25 contract rules covering structure, naming, semantic consistency, and quality patterns. It catches missing frontmatter, weak or ambiguous descriptions, trigger collisions, anti-pattern formatting (prose where tables belong), naming smells, and contradictions before users encounter them.
