name: railguard
description: Claude Code plugin that intercepts tool calls with policy-based allow/block/ask decisions, evasion detection, path fencing, and audit logging.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供安全运行时，拦截工具调用并做允许/阻止/询问决策，含规避检测、路径围栏与审计日志。
description_original:
Railguard is a safer, context-aware alternative to --dangerously-skip-permissions for Claude Code.

Instead of choosing between approving every command manually or giving Claude unrestricted access, Railguard sits in the middle. It intercepts every tool call — Bash, Write, Edit, Read — and makes policy-based decisions: allow safe commands instantly, block dangerous ones automatically, and ask for human approval when it's not sure.

Out of the box, Railguard comes with 29 default rules covering destructive operations like terraform destroy, rm -rf, DROP TABLE, and git force-push. It detects evasion attempts (base64 encoding, chr() construction, variable substitution, shell wrapping), restricts file access with path fencing (blocking ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, /etc), snapshots every file write for one-click rollback, and logs every decision to a structured audit trail.

Everything is customizable through a simple railguard.yaml file in your project directory.
highlights: 策略化允许/阻止/询问决策
规避检测与路径围栏保护
文件快照与结构化审计日志

Automate Dependency Injection framework migrations in Kotlin / Android / KMP
projects. Covers Hilt (+ Dagger), Dagger 2, Toothpick, Kodein, Koin 3.x → 4.x,
classic Koin DSL → Safe DSL, and Koin KSP Annotations → Koin Compiler Plugin.

Produces idiomatic Koin 4 output — annotations (@Singleton, @Factory,
@KoinViewModel, @Module + @Configuration + @ComponentScan) for annotation-based
sources, Safe DSL for Kodein and Koin DSL migrations. Always targets the Koin
Compiler Plugin (no KSP).

Includes an 8-step per-module workflow with leaf-first selection, per-module
validation loop, progressive-migration bridging patterns (Hilt @EntryPoint
co-located in the consumer's @Module, koin-android-dagger library option).
highlights: 支持 Hilt/Dagger/Kodein 等迁移到 Koin 4.x
遵循 8 步渐进式迁移工作流
内置 Kotzilla MCP 辅助配置与调试

Kindex is a persistent knowledge graph for Claude Code. It turns Claude from a session-scoped tool into a project-scoped collaborator — capturing decisions, constraints, and context that survive across sessions, projects, and context resets.
Memory plugins remember what happened. Kindex captures what it means and how it connects. Session 10 is as informed as session 1.
Key features: session lifecycle management (tag_start, tag_resume, tag_end), constraint and watch enforcement across sessions, decision archaeology with reasoning preserved, and graph-structured context that surfaces insights by proximity rather than keyword search.
Git blame tells you what changed. Kindex tells you why.

name: oh-my-obsidian
description: A Claude Code/Codex plugin that links a local Obsidian vault as persistent AI memory for session recording, context recall, and vault management.
description_zh: 将本地 Obsidian 库接入 Claude Code/Codex 的插件，实现会话记录、上下文回忆与知识库管理。
description_original:
Claude Code를 위한 영구적인 '두 번째 뇌(Second Brain)'입니다.

oh-my-obsidian은 로컬 Obsidian Vault와 Claude Code를 직접 연결하여 AI 에이전트의 가장 큰 취약점인 '문맥 단절(Amnesia)'을 해결합니다. 과거의 아키텍처 의사결정 내역을 자동으로 기록(session-save)하고, 유사한 이슈 발생 시 관련 컨텍스트를 즉시 인출(recall)하여 대화에 다시 통합합니다.

소크라테스식 인터뷰를 기반으로 한 초기 폴더 설계(setup)부터 방대해진 문서 트리를 꼬임 없이 안전하게 재구조화하는 리팩토링(refactor) 기능까지, 내장된 특수 서브 에이전트(Vault Architect 등)들이 개발 팀의 완벽한 로컬 지식베이스 구축을 돕습니다. 자동 Git 동기화 스크립트 기능이 포함되어 새로운 팀원의 지식 온보딩도 단 몇 초 만에 완료됩니다.
highlights: 自动将会话记录保存到 Obsidian 库
快速回忆过往决策与排错历史
内置 Git 同步与团队知识库搭建

name: healthclaw-guardrails
description: Security guardrail layer for AI agents accessing FHIR clinical data, with PHI redaction, step-up write auth, and immutable audit trails.
description_zh: 为 AI 代理访问 FHIR 临床数据提供 PHI 脱敏、步进授权与不可篡改审计的安全防护层。
description_original:
HealthClaw Guardrails is the security layer between AI agents and clinical FHIR data. Every agent read passes through PHI redaction (names truncated to initials, DOBs to year, identifiers masked). Every write requires an HMAC-signed step-up token with a 5-minute TTL. Clinical writes (Condition, MedicationRequest, DiagnosticReport) return HTTP 428 until a human confirms. Every access lands in an append-only audit trail scoped by tenant.

Supports FHIR R4 US Core v9 (stable) and FHIR R6 v6.0.0-ballot3 (experimental). Proxies upstream FHIR servers (HAPI, Epic sandbox, Medplum via OAuth2 client-credentials, SMART Health IT) so the same guardrails apply whether you're on local SQLite or production EHRs.

Bundled skills: fhir-r6-guardrails (core MCP + 14 tools), curatr (patient-facing data-quality evaluation and correction), fasten-connect (patient-authorized EHR ingestion + TEFCA), phi-redaction (HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification), fhir-upstream-proxy (vendor-neutral server proxy), healthex-export (portable health record export).
highlights: 14 个 MCP 工具，读取自动 PHI 脱敏
写入需 HMAC 步进授权与人工确认
不可篡改审计与租户隔离

name: aport-guardrails
description: Security guardrails plugin that intercepts AI agent tool calls and enforces Open Agent Passport policy locally before execution.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 提供本地安全护栏，在工具调用前按护照策略拦截并阻止未授权操作。
description_original:
Security guardrails for Claude Code. Intercepts every tool call via PreToolUse hook and evaluates it against your Open Agent Passport (OAP) policy before execution. Blocks unauthorized commands, dangerous file operations, and policy violations. All evaluation runs locally by default - zero network calls, works offline. Open-source (Apache 2.0).

Includes three skills:
- /aport-guardrails:claude-code — Set up guardrails and create a passport
- /aport-guardrails:status — Check guardrail status and recent decisions
- /aport-guardrails:openclaw — Set up guardrails for OpenClaw agents
highlights: 拦截每次工具调用并按护照策略执行
本地评估、零网络调用、可离线运行
同时支持 Claude Code 与 OpenClaw

name: atelier-pipeline
description: Multi-agent orchestration plugin for Claude Code and Cursor with quality gates and a PostgreSQL-backed persistent memory layer.
description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 和 Cursor 的多智能体编排插件，内置质量门禁与 PostgreSQL 持久记忆层。
description_original:
Atelier Pipeline has two core systems:

Multi-Agent Orchestration. Eleven specialized agent personas with clear responsibilities, strict boundaries, and independent quality verification. Eva orchestrates, Robert handles product, Sable designs UX, Sarah architects, Colby builds, Poirot blind-reviews every wave, Agatha documents, Ellis commits, Distillator compresses cross-phase artifacts, Sherlock investigates user-reported bugs, and Sentinel audits security (opt-in). Custom agents can be added via agent discovery. Specs get written, designs get validated, every change passes Eva's mechanical test gate plus Poirot blind review, and nothing ships without review. Works with Claude Code and Cursor.

Atelier Brain. A persistent memory layer backed by PostgreSQL and vector embeddings that gives your agents institutional memory across sessions. Without it, every time you close a terminal you lose the architectural decisions that shaped your implementation, the user corrections that steered scope, the rejected alternatives that explain why you didn't go a different way, and the QA lessons that prevent recurring bugs. The brain captures all of this during pipeline runs and surfaces it automatically when agents need context. It includes write-time conflict detection, TTL-based knowledge decay, and background consolidation that synthesizes raw observations into higher-level insights. The pipeline works without the brain -- but with it, session 12 of a feature build has the same context as session 1.
highlights: 十一个专业智能体角色分工编排
PostgreSQL 向量持久记忆层
机械测试门禁 + Poirot 盲审

name: alloydb
description: A plugin for managing and interacting with Google Cloud AlloyDB for PostgreSQL databases via AI-assisted skills.

red_flags: 插件可执行任意SQL语句（execute_sql脚本），可能对数据库造成破坏或数据泄露
可通过node脚本直接执行JS代码，存在远程代码执行风险
插件自动加载.env文件中的环境变量，可能暴露敏感凭据
支持创建数据库用户并分配权限，涉及权限管理操作
连接远程Google Cloud AlloyDB服务，数据传输至第三方云平台
security.summary: Google官方AlloyDB管理插件，功能包括创建集群/实例、执行SQL、用户管理、监控指标查询等，涉及数据库写操作和云API调用，需用户提供GCP凭据，整体风险可控但需注意SQL注入和凭据安全。
recommendations: 确保.env文件中的数据库密码和GCP凭据安全存储，不要提交到版本控制
使用IAM用户认证而非内置数据库密码认证以提高安全性
限制execute_sql脚本的使用范围，避免执行危险的DDL/DML语句
在生产环境使用前仔细审查各脚本的具体实现代码
建议在隔离的测试环境中先行验证插件行为

description_zh: 用于通过AI辅助技能管理和交互Google Cloud AlloyDB PostgreSQL数据库的插件。

name: socials
description: Official Claude Code plugin for Socials (Brainrot Creations). Ships an MCP server that connects Claude to the Socials browser extension so Claude can work with your logged-in sessions on X, LinkedIn, and Reddit. Claude talks to the extension over a local stdio MCP process and a localhost WebSocket (127.0.0.1:9847); the extension must have Agent Mode enabled. Requires Node.js 18+, the Socials extension, and (where applicable) a Socials plan that includes Agent Mode.

name: llm-dark-patterns
description: Claude Code plugin with 30 lifecycle hooks that block LLM dark patterns such as false success, sycophancy, and fabricated stats at the textual boundar
description_zh: Claude Code 插件，通过 30 个生命周期钩子拦截虚假成功、谄媚、伪造数据等 LLM 暗黑模式。
description_original: A 10-hook suite that suppresses LLM dark-pattern defaults at the textual boundary. Bundles three branches: interaction-style hooks (no-vibes false-success closeouts, time-anchor training-cutoff confusion, no-curfew unsolicited paternalism, no-sycophancy praise-spam at turn open, no-cliffhanger dangling permission-loop endings, honest-eta vibe time estimates plus linear-scaling claims), fact-fabrication hooks (no-fake-recall false-memory claims without quoted prior content, no-fake-stats fabricated percentages without source, no-fake-cite academic citations without verifiable URL), and one continuity hook (no-amnesia, snapshots working state on Stop / PreCompact / PostCompact, rehydrates on SessionStart so context survives auto-compaction). Each hook is conservative on purpose with explicit allow-clauses documented in its RECEIPTS.md. Backed by AbstentionBench, Anthropic's Constitution, AAAI 2026 sycophancy research, the CoT-faithfulness literature, and the Frontiers in AI 2026 paper on LLM-mediated cost drivers. Includes a METHODOLOGY.md harness-engineering playbook for shipping new hooks against newly discovered dark patterns.
highlights: 30 个生命周期钩子拦截 LLM 暗黑模式
确定性判定，无网络调用、无模型参与
覆盖 Stop/Compact/SessionStart 全生命周期

name: slm-agent
description:
SLM Agent scans your codebase for AI API calls and generates a structured migration plan showing exactly where you can swap frontier LLM calls (Opus) for Small Language Models API calls like Haiku or Sonnet.

It performs deep cross-file analysis: tracing prompts to their construction site, following callers across files, and classifying each call by what it actually does. Each finding includes a complexity score, confidence level, estimated savings, and for multi-task calls, a step-by-step decomposition. The output is a saved report.md in your project with a full API reference, so you can migrate.

No source code or codebase data is sent to any external server (except Claude) during analysis.

description_zh: Claude插件，将任意市场信号拆解为6层价值链进行结构化研究，并内置印度代理公司发现代理。
description_original:
Curiosity Stack turns any technology signal, market theme, or global event into a structured 6-layer value chain breakdown — through Socratic conversation, not summaries. Each layer builds on the previous: Signal → Mechanics → Cause Tree → Solution Space → Build Requirements → Value Chain Actors → Research Landscape.

The India Proxy Agent runs a mandatory sourcing checklist across NASSCOM Deep Tech, DPIIT Startup India, GeM portal, BSE SME / NSE Emerge, and 12 curated India VC portfolio pages — surfacing listed, SME-listed, and private Indian companies at each layer before they appear in mainstream coverage.

Includes: Scenario Library (18 pre-built topics), Watchlist with trigger alerts, Thesis Stress Test, Decomposition Library, and Domain Knowledge registry for seeding pre-coverage companies.
highlights: 6层价值链逐层苏格拉底式拆解
印度代理发现，覆盖NASSCOM/DPIIT与12家VC
18个预设场景库与观察列表触发器

name: ai-coding-ok
description: Claude Code plugin that installs a three-tier project memory system and enforces a PDCA loop to prevent AI coding regressions across iterations.
description_zh: Claude Code 的 PDCA 记忆闭环插件，通过三层项目记忆防止 AI 编码跨迭代回归。
description_original:
PDCA memory loop for Claude Code — prevents "AI fixed bug X and broke feature Y" across iterations.

Installs a three-tier memory system in your project (project-memory, decisions-log, task-history) and enforces a closed PDCA loop on every task: Plan (read memory before coding), Do, Check, Act (write memory back after). The Act step is what most tools skip — without it, your context file rots after 10 iterations. With it, iteration 50 has the same context quality as iteration 1.

Complements superpowers: superpowers brings per-session discipline, ai-coding-ok brings cross-session memory. Also works with Copilot, Cursor, and OpenCode via the same templates.
highlights: 三层项目记忆防止跨迭代回归

name: claude-human-review
description: A Claude Code plugin that gates file edits behind human Approve/Undo review, adding one-line doc comments and plain-English change summaries.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 文件编辑添加人工审批门控，自动补充文档注释并生成简明变更评述。
description_original:
claude-human-review adds a human approval gate at the end of every Claude Code turn that edits files. When Claude tries to stop, the plugin
pauses it and has Claude do two things before the turn ends. First, drop a one-line doc comment on any class, function, or non-obvious config
block it created or materially changed, using the right style per language (JSDoc for TS/JS, docstrings for Python, // for Go, and so on).
Second, write a short plain-English review of what changed and why, flagging risks the diff alone won't show.\n

You reply with 1 (Approve) to keep the changes or 2 (Undo) to roll them back. Undo is deterministic: filesystem snapshots are taken before
each edit, so it works in git repos, non-repos, and folders full of untracked files. State lives on disk, so it survives Claude's context
compaction on long sessions.\n

The review is tuned to stay around 60 to 120 words per turn and skips sections when they would be filler, so the extra output-token cost is
small. Inline comments are capped to one line per symbol and skipped entirely for trivial helpers, tests, and already-documented code. The
goal is a short lesson on your own codebase every time Claude edits it, not a wall of text.
highlights: 文件编辑后强制人工审批

description: Git-backed structured memory plugin for Claude Code that preserves decisions, lessons, and context across sessions to prevent context rot.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供基于 git 的结构化记忆插件，跨会话保存决策与上下文，防止压缩导致的上下文流失。
description_original:
If you have ever had AI hallucinate and make things up (and  gaslight you, even): it's because summaries do not preserve nuance.

Each /compact cycle summarises and compresses. Decisions lose their rationale. Lessons lose their context. By Monday, you're re-explaining choices you made on Thursday. That's context rot.

PMM fixes that. Every session, Claude loads what it already knows, then adds to it.

Markdown files, git-backed. No database, no setup. Decisions tracked with rationale: not just what but. git log as your memory audit trail.

Memory that compounds, not rots.
highlights: 基于 git 的 Markdown 记忆文件，可追溯可审计

name: magician
description: A Claude Code plugin delivering an autonomous full SDLC workflow — design, TDD build, review, security, and shipping — via 20+ skills and agents.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供自主全流程 SDLC 的插件：设计、TDD 实现、代码审查、安全扫描到发布。
description_original:
Comprehensive software development lifecycle plugin that takes task from the idea to merged PR autonomously. Core capabilities:

1. Dynamic Project Inspector

On every session start, it scans your project files (package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pom.xml, etc.) and auto-assembles targeted knowledge ("lore") for every detected technology — no manual stack selection needed. Polyglot stacks get full coverage automatically.

2. Full Autonomous SDLC (/manifest)

One command drives the entire flow with only 4 human approval gates:

* /conjure — design dialogue (with an ability to strictly use design) → approved spec
* /blueprint — implementation plan with parallelism map
* /portal — git worktree isolation
* /orchestrate + /ward — parallel agents with TDD
* /certify — tests + types + linter + browser verification
* /scrutinize → /absorb — multi-agent code review + integration
* /seal — PR creation, loops until merged

3. Self-Learning

A Stop hook (chronicle-stop.sh) captures git diffs at session end, writes entries to a chronicle, and detects repeated patterns. After 3 occurrences, it offers to codify the pattern as a reusable skill via /inscribe.

4. Team Memory Workspace

.workspace/shared/ (git-committed, team-visible) holds context, roadmap, specs, and post-mortems. .workspace/local/ (gitignored) holds personal prefs and session state.

5. Security Infrastructure

* Hard deny rules in settings.json blocking pipe-to-shell, eval, credential access
* sentinel-guard.sh PreToolUse hook scanning every Bash command for injection patterns
* magician-scan standalone CLI for CI pipelines
* /sentinel skill for full OWASP Top 10 + credential + injection audits

Skill Set (20 skills)

Covers: debugging (/unravel), performance (/accelerate), incident analysis (/autopsy), CI/CD (/deploy), security (/sentinel), and meta-tooling (/inscribe).
highlights: 4 道人工审批门控贯穿全自主 SDLC 流程

name: total-recall
description: A multi-tier memory and knowledge-base plugin that gives AI coding agents persistent, semantic-searchable context across sessions and hosts.
description_zh: 为 AI 编程助手提供跨会话持久记忆与知识库的插件，支持三层记忆、语义检索与评测。
description_original:
Coding Agents forget everything when a session ends. total-recall fixes that: a shared memory layer that persists across sessions, tools, and devices.

Memory is organized into three tiers (Hot / Warm / Cold) with a 4,000-token budget enforced automatically — so Claude gets relevant context injected at session start without carrying stale noise. Semantic search (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, offline) retrieves the right memories on demand.

A knowledge base lets you ingest READMEs, API docs, and architecture notes that are retrieved semantically when relevant. An eval framework lets you measure retrieval quality, run benchmarks, and compare config changes — so you know memory is actually helping.

All state is local: SQLite + ONNX embeddings, no external services, no API keys required.

Works across Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Cline, and OpenCode — existing memories auto-import on first run.
highlights: 三层记忆（Hot/Warm/Cold）自动管理与压缩
本地 SQLite + ONNX 离线语义检索，无需 API Key
跨 Claude Code、Cursor、Cline 等多种编程助手

name: nova-thesis
description: A Claude Code skill that challenges technical implementations across five risk dimensions, citing real public postmortems to surface failure modes bef
description_zh: 一个 Claude 技能，从五个维度挑战技术实现，并结合真实事故复盘在上线前暴露风险。
description_original:
nova-thesis challenges technical implementations before they ship. Present any implementation — a problem statement, a design sketch, a code snippet, or a full repository — and the skill refuses to accept it at
face value. It scores the work across five dimensions (Correctness, Completeness, Scalability, Security, Maintainability), surfaces a real-world incident from an index of public postmortems that matches the
riskiest gap, and asks hard, specific questions anchored to that incident. It keeps pushing until every dimension scores at least 7/10, or until you consciously name and accept the remaining trade-offs.

Unlike review tools that confirm, nova-thesis is built to find where things break — before production does. Read-only, MIT licensed, no telemetry, no external services required. Ships with 20 test scenarios and
a defended-thesis example that proves the skill also correctly approves strong work.
highlights: 五维度评分：正确性/完整性/可扩展性/安全/可维护性
自动匹配真实事故复盘作为风险证据
只读、MIT 许可、无遥测

name: sema
description: Sema is a Claude plugin and MCP server that provides a content-addressed vocabulary of pattern handles for provably shared meaning among AI agents.
description_zh: Sema 是 Claude 插件与 MCP 服务，提供内容寻址的认知模式词汇表，用哈希句柄确保多个 AI 代理对同一概念的理解一致。
description_original:
Sema adds a content-addressed vocabulary of 452 cognitive patterns to Claude. Each pattern has a handle like StateLock#5602 — a SHA-256 hash of its definition — so two agents using the same handle are provably talking about the same thing. Any divergence in meaning produces a different hash, making silent misalignment impossible.

Key features:

- sema_search — semantic + keyword search across the pattern library
• sema_resolve — full definition, mechanism, invariants, and dependency graph for any handle
• sema_handshake — verify two agents share the exact same definition; halt on mismatch
• sema_tree — browse the taxonomy (Physics / Mind / Society / Infrastructure)
• sema_root — one-hash fingerprint of the whole vocabulary, for fast drift checks
• sema_mint — add project-local patterns (survives pip upgrades)
• sema pull — sync a project DB with upstream, auto-redirecting renamed handles
highlights: 基于 SHA-256 的内容寻址句柄，确保语义一致
支持多代理握手验证与冲突中止
MCP 工具覆盖搜索、解析、铸造与同步

name: make-it-work
description:
Skills that make Claude actually work in your project. Not just generally, but specifically, the way your codebase is built.

Built for engineering teams working on large, complex codebases. Not greenfield side projects. When your codebase has history, domain rules, and legacy decisions baked in, "generally smart" isn't enough. Claude needs to know your project.

go-deep maps your codebase from the inside out and builds a layered documentation system so every Claude session starts grounded in your project's real structure, rules, and use cases. Not generic assumptions.

close-the-gaps acts as a Product Analyst before development begins: it finds every gap in a ticket (unclear language, missing edge cases, conflicting requirements), walks you through them one by one, and outputs a Gherkin-ready refined spec.

The cost of a vague ticket is paid in rework. close-the-gaps makes sure requirements are solid before a single line of code is written.

name: niw-skills
description:
Open-source plugin for U.S. EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) case work. Honest pre-filing legal evaluation of self-petitions under the current USCIS adjudication standard, with the preponderance-of-the-evidence burden applied prong by prong under Matter of Dhanasar. Built for three cohorts: DIY self-petitioners ready to file, prospective applicants 6–24 months out, and master's/PhD students 3–5 years out who want a multi-year roadmap before committing.

Key features:

• Agentic 5-stage conversation — orient → co-design your proposed endeavor → confirm → full evaluation → follow-ups. Adapts to what you know and what you've provided; produces a clean structured memo, not an engineering trace.
• Citation discipline — every legal rule cites authority inline (Dhanasar, Chawathe, Katigbak, USCIS Policy Manual Vol. 6 Pt. F Ch. 5, and curated AAO decisions).
• Verdict floor under preponderance — no inflated assessments. No prong is rated "Strong" without documented evidence clearing preponderance.
• Hard anti-hallucination rules — no invented citation counts, grant roles, employer facts, or AAO decision IDs.
• Achievable case ceiling — beyond the current-state verdict, the plugin produces a roadmap of concrete prerequisite actions and an honest 0–60 month timeline to reach a stronger case.
• AC21 framing for India/China nationals — surfaces the practical reason most backlogged-country petitioners file NIW: an approved I-140 unlocks indefinite H-1B extension under AC21 § 104(c) and § 106(a).
• Written for international, ESL-primary, highly-educated users — short sentences, technical terms explained on first use, citations in standard form, no idioms.

Future skills shipping in this plugin: endeavor-statement drafter, petition-letter drafter, evidence finder, recommendation-letter drafter, RFE/NOID analyzer.

Not legal advice. Not a substitute for licensed immigration counsel. See DISCLAIMER.md.

name: 10x-team
description: A Claude Code plugin offering 12 engineering-role skills plus an orchestrator for end-to-end project delivery with file-based state tracking.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供 12 个工程角色技能与编排器的插件，覆盖从头脑风暴到交付的端到端开发流程。
description_original:
10x-Team gives you an entire engineering team as Claude Code skills. 12 specialized roles — CTO, Product Manager, Principal Architect,
Staff Engineer, Engineering Manager, Senior Engineer, SDE, DBA, Security Engineer, QA Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and SRE — each with
structured decision processes and opinionated guidance.

Key features:

- 12 individual role skills (/cto, /architect, /sde, /security-engineer, etc.) for targeted expertise
- 1 orchestrator skill (/10x-team) that runs all 12 roles end-to-end with hard gates at every phase
- File-based project state (.10x/) so roles share decisions and track progress across conversations
- Discovery protocol that reverse-engineers existing codebases before making changes
- Every role follows a structured process — no generic advice, only actionable recommendations with trade-offs
- Brainstorm-first approach — the orchestrator won't let you write code until the design is validated
highlights: 12 个工程角色技能，覆盖 CTO 到 SRE
编排器硬性门禁，阻止跳过设计直接编码

Optional cross-model review via Codex CLI for teams that want multi-model verification. macOS, Unity 2021.3+.

name: security-sweep
description: A Claude Code plugin/skill that scans codebases for security vulnerabilities, secrets, injection flaws, misconfigurations, and AI/mobile risks.
description_zh: 一个用于代码库安全审计的 Claude Code 插件，可扫描硬编码密钥、注入漏洞、配置错误及 AI/移动端风险。
description_original:
Comprehensive security scanner for codebases. Scans for hardcoded secrets (30+ API key formats), injection flaws (SQLi, XSS, command injection, SSRF), authentication issues (JWT misuse, weak password hashing)misconfigurations  (CORS, debug mode, insecure TLS, Docker/K8s), dependency risks, AI-specific vulnerabilities (prompt injection, API key exposure, excessive agent  permissions), mobile security issues (Android/iOS), and data exposure (PII in logs, weak crypto). Covers OWASP Top 10 (2025), Mobile Top 10 (2024), and LLM Top 10 (2025). Supports Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Go, Ruby, PHP, C#, Swift, and Dart with framework-aware checks that reduce false
positives.
highlights: 支持密钥、注入、配置与依赖等八大扫描模块
覆盖 OWASP、移动端与 LLM 安全风险
可按 secrets/injection/auth 等范围定向扫描

name: tailtest
description: A Claude Code plugin that auto-generates and runs tests whenever Claude edits a file, detecting language and test runner automatically.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，在 Claude 编辑文件时自动生成并运行测试，自动检测语言与测试运行器。
description_original:
tailtest automatically generates and runs tests every time Claude Code edits a file. No commands, no configuration, no reminders needed.

It hooks into Claude's file write event, detects your language and test runner automatically, generates production-like test scenarios for the code that was just written, and runs them immediately. If everything passes, it stays silent. If something breaks, you see it in the same session while the context is still fresh.

Supports Python (pytest), TypeScript and JavaScript (vitest, jest), Go, Rust, Ruby, Java, and PHP. Works on new projects and existing codebases. On first run, a ramp-up scan queues your existing untested files for gradual background coverage.
highlights: 编辑文件即自动生成并运行测试
支持 8+ 语言与多种测试框架
对抗性测试与失败自动分类

name: co-dialectic
description: A prompt-coaching plugin that sharpens prompts, auto-selects expert personas, monitors context health, and compounds lessons into a learning flywheel.
description_zh: 一个实时提示词教练插件，自动优化提示、匹配专家人格、监控上下文健康并积累经验形成学习飞轮。
description_original: Co-Dialectic is a real-time prompt coaching system that activates automatically on every response. It shows a persistent status line tracking your current AI persona, prompt quality, and context window health. When your prompt could be sharper, it suggests an improved version and explains why in one sentence — then waits for your choice. Over days, it tracks your prompt quality percentage (users typically progress from 45% to 91% clear prompts in 10 days). It auto-detects the right expert persona for each question, teaches you prompting techniques by naming them when you use them naturally, and generates context handoff summaries before your conversation degrades. Works as a learning flywheel: you correct the AI, it captures the lesson as a generative principle, applies it going forward, and both sides get sharper. Five protocols, zero configuration — just say "cod" to activate.
highlights: 实时提示词评分与改进建议
自动匹配 10 位专家人格
上下文健康监控与自动交接

name: context-os
description: Claude Code plugin that builds a local repo graph and injects ranked file candidates to reduce context tokens.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件，构建本地仓库图并注入排名文件候选，以减少上下文 token 消耗。
description_original: Context OS helps Claude Code find the right files faster. It builds a local repo graph of paths, symbols, imports, line counts, and hot files, then injects a compact autocontext block with up to five likely file candidates for each prompt. It runs locally with no server, no embeddings, and no telemetry. Live proof in the repo shows 40.9 percent aggregate token reduction across 36 Claude Code calls.
highlights: 本地仓库图注入文件候选，减少 token 消耗
结构切片只读所需代码范围
无服务器、无嵌入、无遥测

Agent skills that teach Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents to read web analytics like a senior analyst.

Five model-invoked skills covering a diagnostic method (MECE hypothesis trees, signal vs noise, Simpson's paradox, Pyramid Principle output), traffic-change diagnosis with fingerprints for common causes, channel and funnel quality analysis, and metric benchmarking by business model.

name: the-pragmatic-pm-toolkit
description: The Pragmatic PM is a Claude Code plugin with 43 PM skills, 5 orchestrator agents, and 4 multi-stage workflows designed for product leadership. It covers the full PM lifecycle: discovery (JTBD, personas), strategy (OKRs, quarterly planning, SWOT), execution (PRDs in 4 modes, pricing with Monetizing Innovation methodology, AI feature pricing), communication (SCQA executive updates, decision docs, board decks), go-to-market (Dunford positioning, competitive battlecards, objection handling, sales decks), and operations (retros, post-mortems, CS playbooks). Every skill enforces problem clarity before solutions, leading and lagging metrics, and explicit non-goals. Domain-agnostic — customize a single file for your company and every skill adapts. Personal-context.md tailors depth to your seniority.

name: agentsatlas
description: Minimal opinionated Claude Code/Codex plugin with 8 slash commands and 16 dev discipline skills for planning, executing, and reviewing code.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code/Codex 提供的极简工作流插件，含 8 个斜杠命令和 16 个开发纪律技能，支持规划、执行与代码审查。
description_original:
AgentsAtlas is a minimal, opinionated end-to-end workflow for Claude Code (also available as Codex skills). Eight slash commands take a project from setup through planning, execution, review, and milestone completion:

/atlas:init, 
/atlas:plan, 
/atlas:execute,
/atlas:status, 
/atlas:sync, 
/atlas:triage, 
/atlas:review, 
/atlas:complete. 
/atlas:execute 

Runs each 3–5-task plan in a fresh subagent (clean ~200k-token context) so quality doesn't degrade across a long run, while a small CLAUDE.md plus .planning/STATE.md and ROADMAP.md keep session continuity without context bloat. 

It also ships 16 development "discipline" skills: debugging, testing,
verifying, refactoring, security-audit, scaffolding, committing, creating-pr, and more enforcing root-cause-first investigation, evidence-before-claims verification, and test-first development. 

# Install globally (available in all projects)
npx agents-atlas --global

# Or install locally (current project only)
npx agents-atlas --local

MIT licensed; no telemetry, no network calls beyond Anthropic, and no bypass-permissions requirement.
highlights: 8 个斜杠命令覆盖开发全流程
16 个开发纪律技能强制规范
全新上下文子智能体执行任务

内置安全、可观测性与部署清单

name: deslop
description: A Claude Code plugin that scans a git change for stale refs, doc drift, duplicates, overgrown functions, and agent-config errors, with model-confirmed
description_zh: Claude 插件：扫描代码变更中的过期引用、文档漂移、重复代码、过长函数与代理配置错误，并由小模型确认修复。
description_original: Detect and remove AI-generated slop with certainty-based findings and safe auto-fixes. AI coding tools leave behind debug `console.log`s, `print` statements, placeholder text ("TODO: implement"), empty `catch` blocks, over-commented code, and dead abstractions. `/deslop` runs a 3-phase detection pipeline (regex patterns → multi-pass analyzers → CLI tools) that categorizes every finding by certainty level: HIGH gets auto-fixed, MEDIUM is flagged for review, LOW is reported without action. Behavior is preserved by construction; diffs are minimal. Supports JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, and Java.
highlights: 基于 git 变更的智能代码清理
小模型逐条确认，只读不修改

GooseWorks gives your coding agent access to 100+ data skills for GTM, sales, and research tasks. Search and scrape Twitter/X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and the web. Find people, emails, and
company info. Enrich contacts, research competitors, build lead lists, and run outbound campaigns — without leaving your coding agent.

Skills are organized into capabilities (atomic tools), composites (multi-step chains), and playbooks (end-to-end workflows) covering lead generation, outreach, competitive
intelligence, SEO, content, ads, and monitoring.

GooseWorks also includes an API gateway to 300+ data APIs (Hunter, Apollo, Clearbit, PDL, and more) — all accessible through a single API key with pay-per-use credit billing.

description_original: Grill runs six specialized agents (recon, architecture, error handling, security, testing, edge cases) in parallel against a codebase, then synthesizes their findings into one report with severity tags, file:line evidence, proposed changes, effort estimates, and explicit tradeoffs. Five review styles let you tune intensity from quick scan to Paranoid Mode. Eight optional add-on pressure tests target specific failure modes (concurrency, observability, dependency hygiene, etc.). Zero-findings is reported explicitly as `[GOOD]` — no padding with manufactured issues.
highlights: 并行运行 6 个专业审查代理
5 档审查风格含偏执模式

description: A Claude Code plugin offering 93 agentic product-management skills spanning discovery, strategy, execution, analytics, GTM, and AI PM.
description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 的插件，提供 93 项产品管理技能，覆盖发现、战略、执行、分析与 GTM。
description_original:
The most comprehensive PM skills plugin available — 83 structured workflows across 9 domains, built natively for Claude Code and compatible with Cursor, Windsurf, and Gemini CLI via MCP.

What makes it different:

Interactive learning — 8 Socratic learning modules that teach PM frameworks by doing, not reading. Practice user interviews with a simulated user, negotiate roadmap trade-offs with conflicting executives, apply RICE scoring to a real backlog. Built for PMs who want to get better, not just get things done.

Vibe coding for PMs — a full suite for PM-builders shipping with AI: write specs optimised for Cursor and Claude Code, plan prototypes, make technical architecture decisions without an engineering background, review AI-generated code for spec compliance, and run pre-launch deployment checklists.

Full coverage — product discovery (Teresa Torres's OST), strategy (9-section canvas, Lean Canvas, Porter's, PESTLE), execution (PRDs, OKRs, sprints, retros), go-to-market (GTM strategy, growth loops, ICP), market research, data analytics (A/B tests, SQL, cohort analysis), and AI product management (responsible AI, model evaluation, prompt engineering).
highlights: 93 项 PM 技能覆盖 9 大领域
内置苏格拉底式引导学习模块
支持 vibe coding 与规格撰写

name: guild
description:
Guild turns Claude Code into a self-evolving team of specialist agents for larger software tasks. It plans before execution, selects the right specialists, assembles focused context, preserves durable project memory, and improves its skills over time through evidence-based reflection.

Instead of treating every request as a single long prompt, Guild breaks work into a governed workflow: clarify the goal, compose the right agent team, execute with scoped context, review the results, capture decisions, and only evolve specialists or skills when repeated evidence shows they are useful. When native agent teams are available, Guild coordinates them directly; when they are not, it falls back to sub-agents with the same planning and memory discipline.

Guild is designed for projects where context, quality, and continuity matter: feature work, refactors, documentation, QA, release preparation, research-heavy implementation, and recurring workflows that benefit from reusable specialist knowledge.

description_original:
Ix Memory connects Claude Code to Ix, a structured, persistent memory backend for codebases. Instead of reading raw source files to answer questions about your code, Claude queries a live knowledge graph — dramatically reducing token usage, improving accuracy, and enabling reasoning that scales to large, complex projects.
All analysis runs locally on your machine. No source code is ever transmitted to external servers.
highlights: 基于知识图谱的代码理解，显著降低 token 消耗
内置架构审计、调试、影响分析等多项技能

description_original: Autonomous workflow orchestrator that takes a task from discovery to production through 12 coordinated phases — exploration, planning, implementation, multi-agent review, and shipping. Pick a task from GitHub/GitLab/local sources, approve a plan, and the rest runs autonomously: git worktree creation, code generation, deslop, agnix, audit-project review loop, sync-docs, gate-and-ship. Two-file state management lets you `--resume` from any phase across session boundaries. 8 specialist agents with model selection (opus for exploration/planning, sonnet for review/CI, haiku for mechanical execution) keep token costs predictable. Workflow enforcement gates prevent skipping reviews or tests.
highlights: 12 阶段从任务发现到发布全自动编排

OpenFunnel is built to detect leading indicators of pain in real-time.

red_flags: 插件通过 hooks 在会话启动时自动执行 node 脚本注入指令
执行 shell 命令调用 jf CLI 和 jq 等外部工具
访问 JFrog 平台远程 API 端点进行网络请求
写入临时文件和 ~/.jfrog/ 目录下缓存文件
security.summary: 官方 JFrog 插件，功能明确用于管理制品与安全扫描，通过 jf CLI 访问远程 JFrog API，启动时注入脚本并写入本地缓存，属合理 DevOps 集成但需注意凭证与权限范围。

审查 hooks 中注入的 inject-instructions.mjs 脚本内容是否安全
限制插件对网络和文件系统的访问范围，避免过度授权

提供详细的 CLI 和 API 工作流指南

name: agent-smith
description: Claude Code plugin that audits and scaffolds .claude configurations with a 7-pillar scoring system and an interactive fix workflow.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 配置提供 7 维度审计评分与交互式修复，并可一键脚手架新配置。
description_original: Agent Smith adds two slash commands to Claude Code: /analyze-agent performs a full configuration audit across 7 evaluation pillars (Security, Instruction Clarity, Configuration Quality, Context Efficiency, Command Design, Hook Safety, MCP Integration), scores each area, identifies issues by severity, and walks you through an interactive fix workflow. /create-agent scaffolds a new configuration with security deny rules and best practices. The tool is honest about its scope — it only measures user-configurable components and clearly states what's outside its reach.
highlights: 7 维度配置审计与加权评分
交互式修复工作流，自动分阶段执行
一键脚手架含安全 deny 规则

name: anti-ai-writing
description: Claude Code plugin that edits drafts to strip AI writing tells, returning a clean rewrite plus a diagnosis.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件，清除文本中的 AI 写作痕迹，返回干净改写与问题诊断。
description_original: Edits any draft to remove the words, phrases, and structures that mark writing as AI output. Strips banned words like delve, unlock, leverage, robust, harness, and showcase (plus 50 more). Strips banned phrases like "in today's fast-paced world" and "unlock the potential of." Strips banned structures: em dashes, the default rule of three, bulleted lists with bold titles, formulaic transitions, weak verbs. Returns a clean rewrite plus a diagnosis of what was wrong. Works in English and Spanish.
highlights: 清除 60+ 个 AI 高频词与短语
支持英文与西班牙文改写
提供严格审查模式与诊断报告

Scientific code serves truth, not users. This plugin encodes the principles that follow from that distinction: fail loudly instead of silently, require explicit parameters instead of dangerous defaults, prioritize correctness over convenience.

LLMs overfit on industry code maintaining uptime rather than being truthseeking and this can silently fail your scientific experiments. This skill helps nudge coding agents in the right direction.

name: dash0
description: A Claude Code plugin that captures session events as OpenTelemetry traces for observability and monitoring.

red_flags: 插件在所有会话事件上挂载 shell 脚本，可能捕获敏感对话内容并发送至远端
需要用户提供 OTLP endpoint 和 auth token，会话数据上传到外部服务
默认发送真实用户身份信息，需手动设置 OMIT_USER_INFO 为 true 才匿名化
默认关闭但可开启发送完整 prompt 内容和工具输入输出

network: 用户配置的 OTLP endpoint URL（如 https://ingress.us1.dash0.com:4318）

security.summary: 该插件通过 shell 脚本在 20+ 会话事件上捕获遥测数据并上传至外部 OTLP 端点，涉及用户对话内容和身份信息的外传风险，需用户明确了解数据流向并正确配置隐私选项。
recommendations: 确认已正确设置 OMIT_USER_INFO=true 和 OMIT_IO=true 以保护隐私
仔细审查 OTLP endpoint 是否为可信的 Dash0 官方服务
了解哪些会话数据会被捕获和传输，评估敏感信息泄露风险
建议先在非敏感项目中试用，确认行为符合预期后再正式使用

description_zh: Claude Code 插件，将会话事件捕获为 OpenTelemetry 追踪，用于可观测性监控。
description_original: OpenTelemetry observability for Claude Code sessions. Captures tool calls, LLM invocations, token usage, and errors as OTel traces. Send telemetry to Dash0 or any OpenTelemetry-compatible backend.
highlights: 捕获 Claude Code 会话全部事件
支持 Dash0 及任意 OTel 后端
追踪工具调用、LLM 调用与 Token 用量

name: 16minds
description: A Claude Code plugin that summons 16 MBTI personality agents to debate, decide, vote, write, or question any topic via slash commands and skills.
description_zh: 一款 Claude Code 插件，可召唤 16 种 MBTI 人格智能体，通过斜杠命令与技能进行辩论、决策、投票与写作。
description_original:
16-minds summons agents modeled on 16 distinct personality types — each with its own values, thinking patterns, and tone — to debate, review, or advise on any topic. Each personality is written directly into an independent prompt, so outputs carry visibly different voices instead of the averaged answer a single agent tends to produce.

Three commands cover the range:
  - /mind <type> — a single type's opinion
  - /pair <a> <b> — a two-type debate (open → rebut → reply / synthesize)
  - /minds — fan out to all 16 in parallel, then synthesize

Three modes (light / middle / heavy) trade depth for token cost.

The /minds synthesis follows a fixed 4-section rubric — score distribution, axes of disagreement, easily-overlooked perspectives, and landing-zone candidates with per-candidate "types likely to agree / fit / risk" — to keep 16-voice output structured rather than scattershot. The --save flag writes the full execution log to a file for use as article material or decision logs.

Built for decisions where a single averaged answer would lose the edges: idea generation, design judgment, code review, and life/career questions.
highlights: 16 种 MBTI 人格智能体，多视角辩论与决策
支持 /mind、/pair、/minds、/cast 斜杠命令
四种技能覆盖提问、决策、投票与写作

name: adaptive-agent
description: A Claude Code plugin adding skills for periodic skill auditing and user profiling so AI agents self-improve over time.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供技能定期审查与用户画像功能的插件，让 AI 智能体越用越强。
description_original: Make your AI agent get stronger with use. Includes two skills: /skill-review (periodic audit of all skills for staleness, missing gotchas, and improvements) and /build-user-profile (build user profile from workspace context so the agent knows who you are). Also includes CLAUDE.md behavioral rules for skill self-improvement on friction, memory-to-skill feedback loops, and automatic skill gap detection. Inspired by Hermes Agent's four-layer memory architecture.
highlights: 定期审查并更新技能，保持流程记忆准确
从工作区上下文自动构建用户画像
记忆与技能之间的自动反馈循环

name: compounded
description: Claude Code plugin that graduates agent-authored skills through proposed→verified→trusted→autonomous tiers via verifier replay and cross-project memor
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供技能信任梯度系统的插件，技能经验证从 proposed 逐级晋升到 autonomous。
description_original:
compounded turns Claude Code skills into a trust-gradient system: every skill earns its autonomy through demonstrated reliability. New skills the agent proposes start as .proposed/, get replayed on a real follow-up task by a verifier subagent (Haiku 4.5) to graduate to .verified/, build a track record to reach .trusted/, and finally graduate to .autonomous/ after 10+ uses with a clean recent run. One correction sends a skill back a tier. Three corrections in 30 days drop it to .proposed.

Includes cross-project memory (a user-global USER.md auto-injected into every session) and a portable .tar.gz archive for moving your earned skills across machines. v1.1 adds an auto-proposer hook that scores each turn (tool calls, distinct file edits, recovery from failure) and nudges the agent to save high-signal procedures — so you don't have to remember to ask.

No daemon. No cloud. No telemetry. Python stdlib only. All state in ~/.claude/compounded/ (SQLite + flat files). MIT licensed.
highlights: 技能信任梯度：proposed→verified→trusted→autonomous
验证子代理自动复现任务以晋升技能

name: evolve-loop
description:
A self-learning development pipeline that gets smarter with every cycle. It calibrates itself against your codebase, dynamically selects the highest-impact tasks, implements them in isolated git worktrees, and blocks bad code through eval gates — then learns from each cycle to make better decisions next time.

4 specialized agents (Scout, Builder, Auditor, Operator) work across 5 phases: DISCOVER → BUILD → AUDIT → SHIP → LEARN. The Scout uses multi-armed bandit
scoring and 8-dimension quality benchmarks to target your codebase's weakest areas. The Builder implements in isolation. The Auditor blocks MEDIUM+ severity
issues. After each cycle, the pipeline extracts reusable "instincts" — patterns about what worked and what failed — that compound over time.

Every 5 cycles, a meta-cycle evaluates the pipeline itself and evolves its own agent prompts based on measured performance. It ran 151 cycles on its own
codebase, shipping 67+ improvements and raising its quality score from 83.8 to 94.4 — all autonomously.

No external dependencies. MIT licensed.

description_original:
Give Claude comprehensive German legal knowledge covering 12 practice areas of Bundesrecht with section-level statute citations and 16 interactive calculators. Every § is cited against verified German statutes from gesetze-im-internet.de, with current 2025 values, all 16 Bundesland variations where applicable, and a RDG-compliant disclaimer distinguishing Rechtsinformation from Rechtsberatung.

Practice areas include: contract law (BGB Books 1 and 2, AGB-Kontrolle §§305 to 310), employment law (KSchG, BetrVG, TzBfG, MiLoG, AGG), data protection (DSGVO, BDSG 2018, TTDSG), company law (GmbHG, AktG, HGB, GwG), intellectual property (UrhG, MarkenG, PatG, UWG), property law (BGB, GBO, GrEStG, Mietrecht), financial services (KWG, WpHG, ZAG, MiCAR), competition law (GWB, UWG), consumer law (BGB, ProdHaftG, PAngV), civil procedure (ZPO, GKG, RVG), tax law (EStG, KStG, GewStG, UStG, AO), and regulatory bodies (BaFin, BKartA, BfDI, DPMA).

Includes 16 interactive calculators: AGB clause checker, Verjährungsrechner, Streitwert to GKG and RVG fee calculator, Mindestlohnrechner, Kündigungsfristrechner, KSchG-Prüfer, Kurzarbeitergeld-Rechner, DSGVO-Compliance-Checker, Gewerbesteuerrechner, Grunderwerbsteuer-Rechner across all 16 Bundesländer, ELSTER-Fristenkalender, Transparenzregister-Pflicht-Checker, Insolvenzantragsfrist-Tracker, and beA/ERV-Pflicht-Checker. Built with anti-hallucination protection: the plugin never invents § numbers or BGH Aktenzeichen. 12 skills, 7 slash commands.
highlights: 覆盖12个德国联邦法律领域

name: harness-designing-plugin
description: Claude Code plugin with four skills and sub-agents for building, maintaining, and reviewing a five-layer design harness.
description_zh: 用于构建、维护和审查五层设计架构的 Claude Code 插件，含四个技能与多个子代理。
description_original:
Harness Designing Plugin helps design teams turn their scattered AI setup — Notion prompts, Figma comments, AGENTS.md rules, chat histories — into a five-layer design harness that compounds across sessions and rotations.

Four skills walk you through the assembly:
• /hd:learn — Q&A about the five-layer concept (Context Engineering, Skill Curation, Workflow Orchestration, Rubric Setting, Knowledge Compounding)
• /hd:setup — detects existing harness artifacts, pre-analyzes all five layers in parallel (5× harness-auditor + rubric-recommender), then walks you through link / critique / scaffold / skip per layer
• /hd:maintain — captures lessons and promotes them to team rules in AGENTS.md with SHA-256 plan-hash proof-of-consent
• /hd:review — audits harness health in a 2-batch parallel dispatch (5 layer-specialist agents + 2–3 context agents); critiques harness artifacts against quality rubrics

Ships 9 sub-agents and 14 starter rubrics (distilled from pbakaus/impeccable, Nielsen's 10 heuristics, Material 3, Fluent 2). Each rubric carries a Scope & Grounding section with personas, user stories, realistic scenarios, and anti-scenarios. Validated across a six-repo pilot matrix.

This plug-in is the companion toolkit to Bill Guo's Substack series on design harnessing. Structural inspiration: EveryInc/compound-engineering-plugin.

description: A Claude Code plugin giving AI agents live Flutter app introspection (screenshots, UI interaction) plus accurate Dart package API lookup.
description_zh: 为 AI 编码代理提供 Flutter 应用实时检查（截图、UI 交互）与 Dart 包精确 API 查询的 Claude Code 插件。
description_original:
A tool that makes AI coding agents more effective for Dart and Flutter projects.

AI agents working on Dart and Flutter run into two recurring problems. First, their training data has a cutoff — they'll reach for discontinued packages, pin outdated major versions, or produce subtly wrong API signatures that compile only after a correction loop. Second, Flutter development is inherently visual and stateful, and agents have no way to see a running app: they can't observe a layout failure, verify that a state change took effect, or confirm that a navigation worked.

This tool addresses both. It adds hooks that catch stale package choices before they land in `pubspec.yaml`, an MCP server that retrieves accurate package API signatures directly from the local pub cache, and a suite of MCP commands for launching, inspecting, and interacting with a running Flutter app.
highlights: 截图与控件树检查运行中的 Flutter 应用
从本地 pub 缓存读取精确包 API 签名
拦截过时依赖防止写入 pubspec.yaml

name: superfast
description: Claude Code plugin providing disciplined AI-development skills: brainstorming, TDD, debugging, code review, and subagent-driven execution.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供规范化的 AI 编程技能库，涵盖头脑风暴、TDD、调试、代码审查与子代理驱动开发。
description_original:
You know that moment when you've finally convinced your coding agent to build exactly what you want, only for it to instantly get hopelessly lost hallucinating dependencies in a 5,000-line codebase?

Superfast fixes that. It starts by establishing your Context Memory. Before any brainstorming or planning occurs, it instantly triggers the FastMemory Build-Up Skill, recursively mapping your enterprise repository into a deterministic CBFDAE graph. Once your agent's cognitive map is established, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.

Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest. After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.

Next up, once you say "go", it launches a subagent-driven-development process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward. It's not uncommon for Claude to be able to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.
highlights: 内置 TDD、调试、代码审查等完整开发技能
支持子代理并行开发与两阶段代码评审
基于 CBFDAE 本体的项目记忆管理

description_zh: 德国中小企业法律 Claude Code 插件中集成的 Gmail MCP 服务器，通过 HTTP 连接 Claude 与 Gmail。
description_original: Bundled MCP server gmail from plugin germany-legal
highlights: 通过 HTTP 远程连接 Gmail
源自德国法律 Claude Code 插件
MCP 配置可即写即用
mcp_installability_reason: 目录元数据提供了完整的远程 HTTP MCP 配置（含 URL），无占位符或密钥，可直接写入 Claude 配置使用。

name: google-calendar
description: Google Calendar MCP server bundled with the Germany SMB Legal plugin for Claude Code.
description_zh: 德国中小企业法律 Claude Code 插件内置的 Google 日历 MCP 服务器。
description_original: Bundled MCP server google-calendar from plugin germany-legal
highlights: 德国中小企业法律助手插件（Claude Code）
内置 16+ 法律计算器与合规检查器
通过 MCP 连接日历、邮件等办公工具
mcp_installability_reason: 目录提供了完整的远程 HTTP MCP 地址，无占位符或额外参数，可直接写入 Claude 配置。

name: ms365
description: Microsoft 365 MCP connector bundled with the Germany SMB Legal plugin for Claude Code.
description_zh: 德国中小企业法律插件内置的 Microsoft 365 MCP 连接器。
description_original: Bundled MCP server ms365 from plugin germany-legal
highlights: 接入 Microsoft 365 邮件、日历与文档
随德国法律插件内置的 MCP 服务
HTTP 远程配置，即写即用
mcp_installability_reason: 目录提供了可直接写入的远程 HTTP MCP 地址，无占位符，写入 Claude 配置即可使用。

name: slack
description: Claude Code legal plugin for German SMBs with 16+ law calculators and MCP integrations including Slack.
description_zh: 面向德国中小企业的 Claude Code 法律插件，含 16+ 法律计算器及 Slack 等 MCP 集成
description_original: Bundled MCP server slack from plugin germany-legal
highlights: 16+ 德国法律计算器与检查器
7 个交互式斜杠命令
集成 Slack/MS365/DATEV 等工具
mcp_installability_reason: 配置为远程 HTTP MCP 端点，格式有效，但需用户完成 Slack 授权认证后方可使用。

name: context7
description: A multi-host AI coding plugin that scaffolds a five-layer, version-controlled team design harness.
description_zh: 一个多宿主 AI 编码插件，为团队搭建五层、可版本控制的设计 harness。
description_original: Bundled MCP server context7 from plugin harness-designing-plugin
highlights: 四大技能：/hd:learn、/hd:setup、/hd:maintain、/hd:review
五层设计 harness，随仓库版本控制
17 个内置评审 rubrics，支持多种编码工具
mcp_installability_reason: 远程 HTTP MCP 服务，配置结构有效，但需要用户提供 CONTEXT7_API_KEY 才能使用。

name: mcp-loki
description: MCP server that lets LLMs query and analyze Grafana Loki logs via LogQL, labels, series, and stats tools.
description_zh: 用于查询 Grafana Loki 日志的 MCP 服务器，支持 LogQL 查询、标签发现与多种认证配置。
description_original: Bundled MCP server mcp-loki from plugin loki
highlights: 支持 LogQL 范围查询与日志分析
Basic/Token/多租户多种认证方式
Docker 镜像与 Go 安装,一键接入
mcp_installability_reason: 目录提供了合法的 docker 本地 stdio 配置，但 LOKI_URL 为空占位符且认证信息需用户自行填写，属需配置后运行。

name: optikit
description: Flutter CLI toolkit for building, versioning, and deploying apps, bundled with an MCP server for Claude Code.
description_zh: 面向 Flutter 的 CLI 工具包，支持构建、版本管理与部署，并内置面向 Claude Code 的 MCP 服务器。
description_original: Bundled MCP server optikit from plugin optikit
highlights: 一键构建 APK/IPA/AAB
iOS/Android 双版本号管理
内置 MCP 支持 Claude Code
mcp_installability_reason: 目录配置提供了本地命令 `optikit mcp`，但需先全局安装 optikit 才能运行。

name: planetscale
description: Claude Code plugin bundling the PlanetScale MCP server plus database and PlanetScale skills.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供 PlanetScale MCP 服务器与数据库技能的插件。
description_original: Bundled MCP server planetscale from plugin planetscale
highlights: 一键安装 PlanetScale MCP 服务器
内置数据库技能与 PlanetScale 技能
每周自动同步上游技能
mcp_installability_reason: 远程 MCP 地址已给出，但需要 PlanetScale 账号进行身份认证，用户须完成授权配置后才能使用。

name: inspector
description: MCP server bundled with Flutter Slipstream that enables AI agents to inspect and interact with running Flutter apps and retrieve Dart package APIs.
description_zh: Flutter Slipstream 插件内置的 MCP 服务器，让 AI 代理可实时检查 Flutter 应用界面、进行交互并获取 Dart 包 API。
description_original: Bundled MCP server inspector from plugin slipstream
highlights: 实时检查 Flutter 应用界面与组件树
支持点击、输入、滚动等交互操作
从本地 pub 缓存获取准确的 Dart 包 API
mcp_installability_reason: 配置中包含 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} 占位符，且需在已安装 Slipstream 插件的环境中才能运行。

name: packages
description: Flutter Slipstream MCP plugin giving AI coding agents live Flutter app introspection and Dart package API summaries.
description_zh: Flutter Slipstream 插件为 AI 代理提供 Flutter 应用实时调试与 Dart 包 API 摘要能力。
description_original: Bundled MCP server packages from plugin slipstream
highlights: Flutter 应用实时截图与 widget 树调试
Dart 包 API 摘要与依赖安全检查
支持 Claude Code / Copilot / Gemini
mcp_installability_reason: 配置为本地 stdio 命令，但依赖 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} 插件根路径并在项目内运行，需用户先安装插件并确定路径。

name: sumup
description: Agent Skills plus a hosted MCP server for building and debugging SumUp payment integrations across terminal and online checkout flows.
description_zh: 用于构建与调试 SumUp 支付集成（终端与在线结账）的 Agent Skills 集合及托管 MCP 服务器。
description_original: Bundled MCP server sumup from plugin sumup
highlights: 支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流客户端安装
内置托管 MCP 服务器，浏览器授权即用
覆盖结账、最佳实践、调试、升级与测试
mcp_installability_reason: 目录提供的远程 MCP URL（https://mcp.sumup.com/mcp）配置形状有效，但需用户在浏览器中完成 SumUp 账户授权后方可使用。

name: alloydb-omni
description: A plugin for AI assistants to manage AlloyDB Omni databases via container and Kubernetes deployments with comprehensive administration skills.

red_flags: 包含可执行任意SQL语句的execute_sql脚本，存在SQL注入风险
可通过docker/podman执行容器管理命令（创建、停止、删除容器）
可通过kubectl执行Kubernetes集群操作命令
脚本自动从.env文件加载数据库凭据，可能包含敏感信息
Kubernetes配置示例中包含数据库密码明文（如ChangeMe123）
security.summary: 该插件用于管理AlloyDB Omni数据库，包含执行任意SQL、容器管理、Kubernetes集群操作等能力，需连接数据库并执行shell命令，功能合理但权限范围较广。
recommendations: 使用前确认数据库凭据的安全存储方式，避免明文密码
谨慎使用execute_sql脚本，避免执行未经验证的SQL语句
在Kubernetes操作前务必确认目标集群和命名空间
建议在隔离环境中测试后再用于生产环境
检查.env文件权限，确保仅授权用户可读取

description_zh: AI助手插件，用于管理AlloyDB Omni数据库，支持容器和Kubernetes部署，提供全面的管理功能。
description_original: Create, connect, and interact with an AlloyDB Omni database and data.
highlights: 支持容器和Kubernetes两种部署方式
提供数据库健康监控和性能分析工具
包含访问控制、备份恢复等完整管理功能

name: cockroachdb
description: Claude Code plugin for CockroachDB providing 14 MCP tools, 3 specialized agents, and 32 skills for AI-assisted database development, operations, and s

red_flags: 插件通过 env 读取数据库凭据（COCKROACHDB_PASSWORD 等），存在凭据暴露风险
MCP 后端连接 CockroachDB Cloud 远程服务（cockroachlabs.cloud/mcp）
hooks 执行外部 Python 脚本（validate-sql.py、check-sql-files.py）
提供数据库 SQL 执行工具，可能影响用户数据完整性

files: 用户项目中的 SQL 文件
network: 用户自定义的 COCKROACHDB_HOST 数据库连接
commands: python3（执行 hooks 中的校验脚本）

security.summary: 官方 CockroachDB 插件，功能完整但需读取数据库凭据、连接远程 Cloud 服务、执行外部脚本，属于合理的中等风险范围，建议在可信环境使用。
recommendations: 确认 COCKROACHDB_PASSWORD 等凭据通过安全方式注入，避免硬编码或明文存储
审查 hooks 中的 Python 脚本源码，确认无恶意行为
了解 cockroachlabs.cloud/mcp 端点的数据传输范围，确保无敏感数据泄露
在生产环境使用前先在测试集群验证插件行为
检查 tools.yaml 配置文件，确认工具权限范围符合最小权限原则

description_zh: CockroachDB 的 Claude Code 插件，提供 14 个 MCP 工具、3 个专业代理和 32 项技能，覆盖数据库开发、运维和安全。
description_original: Connect Claude Code directly to your CockroachDB clusters for hands-on database work — explore schemas, write optimized SQL, debug queries, and manage distributed database clusters. This plugin provides 14 tools across two active MCP backends (self-hosted MCP Toolbox and managed CockroachDB Cloud MCP Server), three specialized agents (DBA, Developer, Operator), 32 skills across 6 operational domains, and built-in safety hooks.
highlights: 14 个 MCP 工具直连 CockroachDB 集群
32 项技能覆盖开发、运维、安全六大领域
内置 SQL 安全校验钩子，防止危险操作

Outputs a ranked list of drift items with severity, evidence, and suggested resolution.

集成 Zoho MCP，自然语言管理云基础设施

description: Claude Code plugin for integrating Circleback meeting, email, and calendar context into AI-assisted coding workflows.

集成主流CI/CD平台
漏洞定位到源码行

name: 0x
description: Claude Code plugin with skills and an MCP server for executing ERC-20 token swaps via 0x Swap, Gasless, and x402/MPP APIs.
description_zh: 为 Claude 提供 0x 代币兑换能力的插件，含 Swap/Gasless/x402 技能与 MCP 服务器，附完整代码示例。
description_original: Guide developers through swapping ERC-20 tokens using the 0x API. Covers standard swaps via AllowanceHolder and Permit2 as well as gasless swaps across 20+ EVM chains — walking through price quotes, approvals, EIP-712 signing, and transaction submission. Also helps integrate 0x swaps directly into your app with code samples.
highlights: 覆盖 Swap、Gasless 与 x402 微支付兑换指引
支持 20+ EVM 链，含 Permit2 与 AllowanceHolder
内置 Claude 技能与 MCP 服务器，附可运行代码示例

name: 8-habit-ai-dev
description:
8-habit-ai-dev replaces ad-hoc AI prompting with a structured 7-step workflow: Research →
Requirements → Design → Breakdown → Build Brief → Review → Deploy. Each step maps to one of
Stephen Covey's 8 Habits, providing both practical discipline and principled reasoning.

Key features:
- 17 hand-crafted skills with DAG-validated handoff chain
- 472 automated assertions across 4 validator scripts (structure, skill-graph, content,
verbosity)
- Whole Person Model assessment (Body/Mind/Heart/Spirit scoring)
- Maturity-adaptive verbosity via /calibrate (Dependence → Interdependence)
- /reflect with dream-inspired lesson consolidation
- /cross-verify 17-question checklist covering all 8 Habits
- Composes cleanly with claude-governance plugin for compliance enforcement

Pure markdown plugin — no runtime dependencies, no MCP servers, no external services.

name: aeo-brand-scan
description: A Claude Code plugin that scans how AI engines describe a brand vs competitors for AEO/GEO visibility.
description_zh: 一个在 Claude Code 中运行的 AEO/GEO 品牌可见度插件，对比 AI 如何描述你的品牌与竞品。
description_original: Free AEO / GEO / AI search visibility check. Scores how ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity describe your brand vs competitors. Runs inside Claude Code in 30 seconds.
highlights: 无需账号或 API Key 即可运行
一键生成 AI 品牌提及报告
对比 ChatGPT 与 Claude 描述

name: agent-discussion
description: Claude Code plugin that coordinates multi-agent debates across AI platforms via a shared file protocol.
description_zh: 通过共享文件协议协调多个 AI 平台智能体自主辩论的 Claude Code 插件。
description_original: Coordinate multi-agent debates across different AI platforms (Claude Code, Antigravity, Copilot, Gemini CLI, etc.) using a shared file protocol. Each agent reads one skill and handles everything autonomously — intros, turn-taking, and consensus.
highlights: 共享文件协议实现多智能体协作
自主辩论循环与共识收敛
支持 Claude Code/Copilot 等多平台

name: agent-memory
description: A Claude Code plugin that compresses tool output into structured memory to cut LLM token costs across sessions.
description_zh: 一个通过将工具输出压缩为结构化记忆来降低 LLM token 成本的 Claude Code 插件。
description_original: Save 60-90% on LLM token costs with intelligent memory compression. agent-memory automatically compresses tool output into structured observations, shares context across agents via a memory bus, and injects only relevant memory into each prompt — keeping your token budget under control. Features: auto-compression hooks (PostToolUse), token-budgeted context injection (SessionStart), semantic search via FTS5, cross-session persistence, and a token economics dashboard showing compression ratios and savings.
highlights: 自动将工具输出压缩为结构化记忆
跨会话持久化并支持语义搜索
按 token 预算注入相关记忆

description: A Claude Code plugin that injects project architecture context into subagents and validates code placement and conventions after writes.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 子代理注入项目架构上下文，并在写入后校验代码位置与规范。
description_original: Prevents subagent tech debt by injecting project architectural context (module boundaries, CLAUDE.md rules, conventions) into every subagent's prompt. Validates code placement and conventions after writes with self-correction directives.
highlights: 为子代理注入项目架构与模块边界
写入后自动校验代码位置与规范
基于会话与工具钩子自动执行

name: agentops
description: Claude Code plugin adding enterprise security guardrails, STAR planning, and an 8-phase TDD delivery lifecycle from vision to merged PR.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供企业级安全护栏、STAR 规划方法与 TDD 驱动的八阶段交付生命周期。
description_original: Enterprise guardrails, delivery lifecycle, and self-evolution for Claude Code. Wraps every session in 7 security layers (path validation, command validation, injection scanning, credential redaction, exfiltration detection), structures work with the STAR methodology, and orchestrates full project builds from vision to merged PR through an 8.5-phase lifecycle with TDD enforcement, wave-based parallel execution, and two-stage code review. Includes 37 commands, 44 hooks, 12 specialist agents, 49 templates, and 32+ feature flags.
highlights: 七层会话安全护栏与供应链扫描
八阶段 TDD 交付生命周期编排
44 个钩子与 12 个专家子代理

name: aria
description: A Claude Code plugin of guided music-release skills for the aria/Patchline MCP, from track upload to smart links and fan analytics.

aria.description: Aria MCP server — 23 tools for catalog, playlist targeting, artist intelligence, pitch generation, smart links, roster actions, and release workflows. OAuth via Cognito on first tool call; token persisted by the Claude MCP client.
aria._comment_about_auth: Remote MCP with OAuth 2.0 / RFC 8414 metadata + RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata. No manual credentials required — Claude Code opens the browser to /auth/mcp-callback on first use.

description_zh: Claude Code 音乐发行插件，通过 aria MCP 完成上传、商店上架、智能链接与粉丝数据分析。
description_original: Aria is a guided music-release workflow for artists, managers, and labels. It walks through a complete lifecycle — from raw idea or finished track to pitched, released, and live on a smart link — through nine progressive phase skills and the hosted aria MCP. Every artifact is grounded in your real catalog, streaming intelligence, and sonic analysis (BPM, key, genres, moods). No hallucinated playlists. No invented metrics. Plugin code is open source (MIT); the MCP backend is Patchline-hosted and authenticated via Cognito OAuth.
highlights: 九阶段音乐发行工作流
基于真实数据的智能链接
Claude Code 插件 + MCP 集成

name: auto-research
description: A Claude Code skill that autonomously improves other skills via parallel research agents and an iterative keep/discard loop.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 技能，通过并行研究代理和保持/丢弃实验循环自动改进其他技能。
description_original:
Autonomous skill improvement through parallel research agents. Inspired by Karpathy's autoresearch methodology, it spawns 5 parallel agents (domain expert, quality auditor, competitive analyst, gap analyst, tech scout), synthesizes findings
into ranked proposals, then runs an iterative keep/discard experiment loop to improve any Claude Code skill. Scores skills on 7 quality dimensions and only keeps changes that genuinely improve the composite score.
highlights: 5 个并行研究代理协同分析
保持/丢弃迭代实验循环
7 维质量评分与回滚机制

The Blaxel agent skill lets your agent create cloud sandboxes (microVMs) to run code, start dev servers, and generate live preview URLs.

name: blink
description: A Claude Code plugin with 60+ MCP tools, skills, and subagents for building and hosting full-stack apps on Blink's serverless cloud.
description_zh: Blink 云平台的 Claude Code 插件，提供 MCP 工具、技能与子代理，可在编辑器中构建并托管全栈应用。
description_original:
Blink is serverless cloud infrastructure for agentic coding. Build and host full-stack apps from your editor with managed SQL databases, authentication, file storage, serverless backends (Hono), task queues, custom domains, AI gateway, real-time WebSockets, RAG knowledge bases, 38 OAuth connectors, and production hosting — all zero-config.

62 MCP tools for full platform control. 14 skills that teach agents how to use every feature. 4 specialized subagents (full-stack builder, frontend, backend, verifier). Persistent coding rules for correct SDK usage.

Works with React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Astro, and Expo. Authenticate with a workspace API key from blink.new/settings.
highlights: 62 个 MCP 工具全面控制平台
内置数据库/认证/存储/后端
支持 React、Next.js、Vue 等框架

name: cellcog
description: Any-to-any AI sub-agent — generate images, videos, PDFs, presentations, research reports, music, spreadsheets, 3D models, memes, diagrams, prototypes, game assets, and stickers from natural language prompts. CellCog orchestrates 21+ foundation models so you can produce rich media deliverables without leaving your IDE. Ships with 16 skills, an auto-routing rule, and a setup command. #1 on the DeepResearch Bench.

name: claude-damn
description: A composable Claude Code plugin bundling 38+ SWE skills for TDD, expert code review, subagent dispatch, session memory, checkpoints, and cost tracking
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供 38+ 个软件工程技能，涵盖 TDD、专家代码审查、子代理调度、跨会话记忆、检查点与成本追踪。
description_original:
A SME of SWE: a plugin giving Claude Code the expertise of an Expert Software Engineer across every SWE area, while still inviting novice programmers to make gains on best-practice rails. Layers on top of `obra/superpowers`.

Ships:
- 38+ skills in super/duper/cat/tdd modifier families (20+ combinatoric variants)
- Multi-phase `/expert-review` with language-specific + cloud + security  lenses
- `/sme-test` coaching-driven test authoring
- `/tesseract` cross-session memory via file I/O (anchor + shelf + bulk-beings)
- `/checkpoint-save` + `/checkpoint-resume` for work-state across sessions
- Pre-tool `block-inline-scripts` hook (blocks multiline non-Bash scripts + enforces command length / separator limits)
- Per-session cost tracking (`/cost_`, `/cost-opt`) via JSONL logs
- Opinionated `CLAUDE.md` with model routing, Python/FastAPI style, pytest/behave standards

Post-install, skills are invoked via slash commands: `/tdd`, `/super-duper-cat`, `/expert-review`, `/checkpoint-save`, `/tesseract`, etc. Full combinatoric table in `skills/README.md`.
highlights: 38+ 可组合技能，覆盖 TDD 与专家审查
多阶段 /expert-review 支持多语言与云安全
跨会话记忆、检查点恢复与成本追踪

highlights: 支持 JQL 搜索与工单增删改查
自动生成团队周报/摘要报告
兼容 Jira Cloud 与自建实例

name: claude-notify
description: Cross-platform notifier that shows banners and plays sounds when AI coding agents finish a task or pause for approval.
description_zh: 跨平台通知插件，当 AI 编码代理完成任务或等待批准时显示横幅并播放提示音。

横幅+声音双重提醒

highlights: 读取 JSONL 会话数据，计算六项效能指标
自动诊断并将行为规则写入 CLAUDE.md
支持手动运行与每周定时生成报告

description: Claude Code plugin enforcing documented project architecture and conventions on every file write via a skill, review agent, and startup hook.
description_zh: 通过技能、审查代理与会话启动钩子，在每次写入时强制遵循项目文档中的架构与约定。
description_original: A skill and agent plugin that reads your project's architecture documentation — README.md, architecture.md, and related files — and enforces those documented conventions on every code change Claude makes. Includes a /project-context skill for on-demand rule extraction, an architecture-reviewer subagent that performs deep read-only compliance analysis with structured PASS/WARN/FAIL reports, and a SessionStart hook that automatically loads project context when Claude launches. Ensures file plac...

description: A Claude Code plugin to save, search, load, and manage a persistent personal library of reusable prompts.
description_zh: 一款 Claude Code 插件，用于保存、搜索、加载和管理可复用的个人提示词库。
description_original:
Save, search, load and manage reusable prompts across projects. Build a personal prompt library that persists across sessions and works in any project.

Key features:
- Save prompts with description, category and tags via /prompt save
- Load prompts instantly via /prompt:<name> autocomplete
- Search by name, tag, category or content
- Edit prompts in-place with automatic metadata sync
- Cross-platform: bash (macOS/Linux) and PowerShell (Windows)
- Persistent storage that survives plugin updates
highlights: 保存、搜索、加载与编辑可复用提示词
通过 /prompt:<name> 自动补全快速调用
跨平台支持 bash 与 PowerShell

name: claude-xcindex

name: karellen-jdb-mcp
description: MCP plugin that lets Claude Code debug Java JVMs via JDWP/JDB with breakpoints, stepping, expression evaluation, and thread inspection.
description_zh: 让 Claude Code 通过 JDWP/JDB 调试 Java JVM 的 MCP 插件，支持断点、单步执行、表达式求值和线程检查。
description_original:
JDB (Java Debugger) plugin for Claude Code. Attach to running JVMs via JDWP and debug interactively with breakpoints, watchpoints,
exception breakpoints, stepping, expression evaluation, thread inspection, stack navigation, and class introspection.

### Features

- **Connect & Launch**: Attach to any JVM started with JDWP, or launch one directly with `jdb_launch`
- **Multi-session**: Debug multiple JVMs simultaneously on different ports
- **Breakpoints & Watchpoints**: Line/method breakpoints, field watchpoints, exception breakpoints with caught/uncaught filtering
- **Execution Control**: Step in, step over, step out, continue, suspend/resume threads
- **Inspection**: Evaluate expressions, dump objects, view locals, list loaded classes/methods/fields
- **Stack Navigation**: Walk the call stack, move up/down frames, pop/re-enter frames
- **Concurrency**: Thread listing, lock/monitor inspection for deadlock analysis
- **Tracing & Monitoring**: Trace method entries/exits, auto-execute commands on each stop
- **JDK Compatibility**: Supports JDK 8+ with feature detection (virtual threads on JDK 20+, thread-scoped breakpoints on JDK 13+)

### Prerequisites

- Python 3.10+
- A JDK installation (for the `jdb` executable)

### Installation

pip install karellen-jdb-mcp
highlights: 通过 JDWP 附加运行中的 JVM 进行调试
支持断点、监视点和异常断点
多会话调试与线程死锁分析

name: karellen-lsp-mcp

description_original:

Two interfaces, one shared daemon:
- **Native LSP proxy** (`karellen-lsp`): Transparent code intelligence — no permission prompts, no manual registration. Auto-detects languages and routes to backend LSP servers.
- **MCP interface** (`karellen-lsp-mcp`): Explicit tool calls with structured responses for fine-grained control.

Multiple Claude sessions share a single daemon and single LSP server per project, avoiding duplicate indexing. Supports autodetection of CMake, Meson, Gradle, Maven, and other build systems.
highlights: 多语言 LSP 代码导航与诊断

name: ticket-plugin
description: A Claude Code plugin that autonomously carries tickets from open to merged PR with test-first development and mechanical quality gates.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，以票据为锚、测试先行，自动完成从建单到合并 PR 的全流程并设置质量门禁。
description_original:
A Claude Code plugin that keeps a durable per-ticket plan, findings, and progress log for every ticket you work on — without bloating the ticket itself or polluting the repo. Auto-detects Linear or JIRA as your ticket system at run-time.

The four slash commands form a complete loop around a ticket:

- /ticket-plugin:start <KEY> fetches the ticket, transitions it to "In Progress", and seeds task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. Resuming an existing ticket reads back the tracking files and prints a summary.
- /ticket-plugin:update is a mid-session checkpoint. The ticket stays active.
- /ticket-plugin:pause snapshots state and clears the active-ticket pointer. Local-only.
- /ticket-plugin:archive pushes the final task plan back to the ticket as its description and posts findings as a comment, then archives the local folder. Refuses to run unless the ticket is already in a terminal state on the ticket system — the user controls the state transition.

The aim: fewer wasted tokens re-explaining context between sessions, and a clean ticket-system record of what was actually done by the time you close the ticket.

Requires either the Linear or Atlassian MCP (installable as plugins from anthropics/claude-plugins-official).
highlights: 票据驱动，自动从建单到合并 PR
测试先行并冻结，防止走样

name: ada-pdf-compliance
description: Claude Code plugin that audits and auto-fixes PDF accessibility for ADA/Section 508/PDF-UA, generating alt text, links, structure trees, and metadata.
description_zh: 用于 ADA/Section 508/PDF-UA 合规的 Claude Code 插件，自动审计并修复 PDF 无障碍问题。
description_original:
Audit and fix PDF accessibility for ADA/Section 508/PDF-UA compliance — auto-generates alt text, link descriptions, structure trees, bookmarks, and metadata.

Key features:
- 18-check accessibility audit across Critical/Important/Advisory tiers
AI-generated alt text for every image (Claude reads pages visually — charts get data descriptions, screenshots get content summaries)
- AI-generated link descriptions replacing raw URLs with meaningful text
Structure tree generation for untagged PDFs — headings, paragraphs, lists, figures, tables, BDC/EMC marked content, tagged annotations
- Metadata auto-population — title, language, author, subject, PDF/UA identifier, display-title flag
- Bookmark generation from slide titles
Batch processing — process a whole folder, ask for author once, fix everything
- Two processing paths — Path A (Acrobat structure tree + plugin fixes) or Path B (fully automated, no Acrobat needed)
- Export results as markdown checklists or spreadsheets
highlights: AI 自动为图片生成替代文本
一键生成 PDF 结构树与书签
支持批量处理并导出修复清单

name: agent-trace-triage
description: A Claude Code plugin that triages failed AI agent traces by detecting loops, classifying failures, and scaffolding regression tests.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，用于分析失败的 AI 代理轨迹，检测循环、分类故障并生成回归测试。
description_original:
Agent Trace Triage is a Claude Code plugin for developers building agentic AI systems (LangGraph, CrewAI, custom tool loops, MCP agents).

When an agent run fails, stuck in a loop, wrong tool, or burning tokens. the user runs /agent-trace-triage with a JSON/JSONL trace file. The plugin:

• Parses traces (JSONL, OpenAI tool_calls, partial LangSmith/OTEL-style exports)
• Detects loops deterministically (identical repeat, ping-pong, retry-without-progress) via bundled Node scripts
• Classifies failures into five buckets: tool selection, arguments, execution, orchestration, recovery policy
• Writes a markdown triage report with targeted fix recommendations
• Scaffolds regression tests (pytest / vitest templates)

No MCP servers, no external API calls, no npm dependencies. 

Requires Node.js 18+ for local scripts only. MIT licensed.
highlights: 检测重复、乒乓和重试无进展等代理循环
将失败归类为五类并给出修复建议
自动生成 pytest/vitest 回归测试模板

Supports web (any URL or localhost), Android (emulator/device), and iOS (simulator/device). Finds visual bugs, logical errors, UX issues, and accessibility problems that unit tests and linters miss.

description_zh: 基于钩子强制角色隔离的8角色多智能体代码审查Claude Code插件，支持并行审计与TDD。
description_original:
Multi-agent code review with 8 hook-enforced roles. Each role targets a different failure surface — the skeptic reviews blind without the implementer's narrative, the security auditor can only run approved scan commands, the test writer cannot touch source code, and the implementer cannot run Bash. Scope boundaries are enforced through deterministic Python hooks at the PreToolUse layer, not through prompt instructions.

The 8 roles: implementer (scoped writes, no Bash), test-writer (test directories only), skeptic (blind read-only review), security auditor (read-only + approved scan commands), performance profiler (benchmarks in isolated worktree), accessibility checker (a11y tools + WCAG 2.1 checks), docs writer (doc paths only), and verifier (approved verification commands only).

Features include parallel audit phase (4 review agents run concurrently), TDD mode (hook-level test-first enforcement), custom roles via manifest (--custom-role), REVIEW.md injection for project-specific review criteria, mission timeout and failure tracking.

96 tests. 100% Python stdlib. Zero external dependencies.
highlights: 8个钩子强制隔离的审查角色
并行审计阶段4个审查智能体同时运行
