description_original:
Persistent memory for Claude Code — at ~350 tokens ambient cost, with no Docker, no API keys, and no MCP servers.

Engram captures your sessions structurally on PreCompact (zero LLM cost), extracts atomic memories via a single lightweight LLM digest (preferences, practices, current context), and  detects emergent patterns from your history — files you always edit together, recurring errors, tool usage anomalies — stored as an auditable Obsidian-compatible wiki.


Key features:
• Per-project handoff notes — at session start you get a narrative message from the last session in this project
• Atomic UPSERT memories keyed by topic — latest wins, no drift, no embeddings
• Emergent pattern detection (co-edits, error recurrence, project streaks, tool anomalies)
• Durable preferences stay global; ephemeral context is scoped per project
• 4-flag CLI surface: --stats, --query, --memories, --forget
• Everything local: SQLite at ~/.claude/memory.db, markdown wiki at ~/.claude/patterns/
highlights: 会话开始时自动注入上次任务与下一步
纯文件+钩子实现，无需数据库或 API 密钥
同时支持 Claude Code 与 Codex CLI

• framework — a design-time architect agent plus a progressive-disclosure skill with 15 topic references (actors, supervision,
messages, application, pool, meta processes, node, EDF, cluster, unit testing, and every extension library). Outputs implementable
design documents with bounded contexts, supervision trees, and load analysis.

• devops — a runtime SRE agent plus a skill covering Ergo's MCP diagnostics application. 48-tool catalog, counter semantics, 10
hypothesis-driven playbooks (bottleneck, memory growth, process leak, restart loop, zombies, network issues, event fanout, goroutine
investigation, cluster health), active and passive samplers, and build-tag awareness. Connects to any running Ergo cluster through a
single MCP endpoint that proxies to every node.

All references verified line-by-line against the Ergo Framework v3.3 source. MIT licensed.

Data freshness and endpoint liveness verification for AI agents. Probes external APIs and endpoints before agents act on their data, returning deterministic FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN verdicts
with confidence scores. Analyzes HTTP cache headers, measures latency percentiles (P50/P95/P99), fingerprints content for change detection, checks TLS certificate health, and evaluates
against configurable freshness policies. Exposes three MCP tools (freshprobe_check, freshprobe_batch, freshprobe_policy) and includes a built-in skill and agent for contextual
triggering. NIST AI RMF aligned. Single Go binary, MIT licensed.
highlights: FRESH/STALE/UNKNOWN 确定性判定
内置 MCP 工具、技能与代理

description: Claude plugin for German accounting: SKR 03/04 bookkeeping, USt-Voranmeldung, HGB Jahresabschluss, EÜR, eBilanz and payroll workflows.
description_zh: 为 Claude 提供德国财务与会计能力：SKR03/04 记账、增值税预申报、HGB 年终决算、EÜR、eBilanz 与工资核算。
description_original:
Give Claude deep German accounting knowledge for GmbH, GbR, Einzelunternehmen, and Freiberufler. This plugin replaces the generic finance responses with regulation-aware workflows built for the German market, covering Buchungssätze with SKR 03/04 chart of accounts, USt-Voranmeldung with ELSTER filing, Jahresabschluss under HGB (Bilanz nach §266, GuV nach §275), EÜR for smaller businesses, eBilanz preparation for XBRL/ERiC submission, and Lohnabrechnung with all five social insurance branches.

Built on and derived from Anthropic's official Finance & Accounting Plugin. Every US-specific element has been replaced with verified German equivalents: HGB instead of US GAAP, SKR 03/04 instead of US chart of accounts, Sozialversicherung instead of FICA/FUTA. Four entirely new skills (USt-Voranmeldung, eBilanz, Lohnabrechnung, GoBD-Compliance) cover workflows that have no US equivalent.

Designed for German SMBs, Steuerberater, and bookkeepers. Includes 11 skills across 10 slash commands, references only verified HGB standards and Finanzamt guidance, and ships with 2026 tax year rates. Connects to DATEV, Lexware, sevDesk, and Personio via MCP.
highlights: 覆盖 SKR03/04 记账与增值税预申报
支持 HGB 年终决算与 eBilanz XBRL 申报
完整工资核算与社保五险计算

name: harness-architect
description: Claude Code plugin that builds complete project harnesses (CLAUDE.md, agents, hooks, MCP) via a 9-phase workflow with red-team review and audits.
description_zh: 通过 9 阶段工作流为 Claude Code 项目构建完整 harness（CLAUDE.md、agents、hooks、MCP），并提供红队审查与三类审计。
description_original:
harness-architect is a meta-tool that scans any target project and builds an end-to-end Claude Code harness — CLAUDE.md, settings, rules, agents, playbooks, hooks, and MCP — through a 9-phase orchestrated workflow.

The plugin enforces a strict Agent-Playbook separation (WHO / HOW): agents define identity and hand off methodology to sub-agent-only playbooks, preventing the main session from bypassing guardrails. Every phase is reviewed by an independent red-team advisor that produces BLOCK / ASK / NOTE classifications, and cross-phase state is persisted to `docs/{request}/` so interrupted sessions resume deterministically.

Target users: anyone — including non-developers — who wants a correct-from-day-one Claude Code setup on every new project without re-deriving the same 30-decision matrix each time. The plugin ships a 6-step "strict-coding" preset for complex coding projects and three Phase 1-2 branches (fresh setup / Cursor migration / harness audit).
highlights: 9 阶段自动化构建完整 Claude Code harness
每阶段独立红队审查 BLOCK/ASK/NOTE

description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 的多智能体软件开发框架，编排规划、开发、QA 与缺陷修复全流程。
description_original:
MASH (Multi-Agent Software Harness)  is a structured development framework for Claude Code that manages the full software lifecycle — from idea to tested, committed code. It orchestrates four specialized AI personas (Init, Plan, Dev, QA) that work in sequence with strict boundaries: planning personas interact with you to capture intent, while implementation personas run as isolated sub-agents that write code and tests autonomously.

Features are tracked through a clear lifecycle (CREATED → DEV_READY → WIP → DONE), with automatic retry logic (up to 3 attempts) and failure analysis fed back into subsequent attempts. All specs live in .mash/plan/ as the single source of truth — immutable during development.

Key features:
- Interactive planning that asks clarifying questions before writing specs
- Isolated dev and QA sub-agents with strict read/write boundaries
- Git workflow options: per-feature worktrees or current branch
- Auto-commit after QA pass, or manual git control
- Feature retry with failure context propagation
- Self-updating via /mash update

description_original:
rehydrate is a knowledge-based backup and restore plugin for Mac developers. Instead of copying every byte, it captures only what's truly local — dotfiles, SSH keys, gitignored .env files, sessions, locally-authored projects — and records the rest (apps, packages, git repos) as small inventory files that a future LLM replays on the target machine. The plugin ships two slash commands, /rehydrate:backup and /rehydrate:restore, plus snapshot diff and reachability-based
garbage collection. Every backup is verified end-to-end via a sandboxed test restore.
highlights: 仅备份真正本地内容，其余记录为清单

name: academic-search
description: MCP server bundled in the paper-review-system Claude Code plugin that verifies references and searches academic papers.
description_zh: paper-review-system Claude Code 插件内置的 MCP 服务器，用于参考文献验证与学术搜索。
description_original: Bundled MCP server academic-search from plugin paper-review-system
highlights: CrossRef/DBLP/Semantic Scholar 参考文献验证

mcp_installability_reason: 配置以 python3 启动插件内脚本，但路径与环境变量均为占位符，需用户安装插件并提供 API Key。

name: paper-parser
description: MCP server that parses academic paper PDFs into Markdown and extracts figures, part of the paper-review-system Claude Code plugin.
description_zh: 论文评审插件中的 MCP 服务器，将学术论文 PDF 解析为 Markdown 并提取图表。

5 个 Agent 并行多维度评审
mcp_installability_reason: 配置为本地 stdio 命令（python3 + args），但含 ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} 占位符，需在插件环境中解析为实际路径后才能运行。

name: google-drive
description: A Claude plugin that generates composed Pinterest pins from Google Drive documents and an approved image library, with a performance-driven learning l
description_zh: 从 Google Drive 文档与图片库自动生成 Pinterest 图钉，并通过效果数据形成学习循环的插件。

内置学习循环持续优化后续批次
集成 Drive、Cloudinary 与 Pinterest API

name: promptguard

description_original: Agent Discovery lets developers discover, review, install, and manage AI agent configurations from a curated catalog of 687+ entries — with zero setup. It ships a pre-built SQLite index of agents, skills, and instructions from awesome-copilot and GitHub's Agent Factory, so search is instant and requires no API keys or authentication. The interactive /recommend flow analyzes your project's tech stack, surfaces relevant agents with explanations, then guides you through reviewing content before installing, customizing in your editor, or assembling multiple agents into a coordinated team with an agentic lead. Additional /list and /edit commands let you manage everything you've installed without leaving Claude Code.

name: aight
description: Claude Code channel plugin that bridges your coding session to an iOS app via a Cloudflare relay for remote monitoring and replies.
description_zh: 将 Claude Code 会话通过 Cloudflare 中继桥接到 iOS 应用的频道插件，支持远程收发消息与表情反应。
description_original:
Aight is a channel plugin that bridges Claude Code to an iOS
app via a Cloudflare Workers relay. Users pair with a 6-digit
code — no port forwarding, no LAN requirement. The plugin exposes
reply and react tools so Claude can send messages, markdown, and
file attachments to the phone. It also forwards tool events
(Bash, Read, Edit, etc.) in real-time so users can monitor
Claude's work from their phone. Built with Bun, TypeScript strict
mode, 68 tests. Security: HMAC-SHA256 auth tokens,
session-isolated hook routing, rate limiting, input validation.
search_terms: 手机远程监控 Claude Code
highlights: 手机远程监控 Claude Code 会话
6 位配对码，免端口转发
支持消息回复、表情与文件附件

description_zh: Claude Code 插件，在 Claude 完成响应时发送带焦点感知的桌面通知，显示会话名与最后消息。
description_original:
claude-code-notify sends a desktop notification whenever Claude Code finishes responding, so you never miss a prompt while working across multiple sessions.

Each notification shows your session name (from /rename) and the first 80 characters of Claude's last response, giving you context at a glance. When running in tmux, the notification includes the window index so you know exactly where to switch.

The plugin is focus-aware: if you're already looking at the Claude session (detected via tmux pane, window, and terminal focus state), the notification is suppressed.
On macOS without tmux, it checks whether your terminal app is frontmost.
A 5-second debounce prevents notification spam during rapid tool calls.

Works on Linux (notify-send) and macOS (osascript).
Requires jq and bash 4+.
tmux is optional but recommended for the best experience.

Configuration is zero-config by default, with two optional environment variables: CLAUDE_NOTIFY_CONTEXT (adds a Work/Personal prefix) and CLAUDE_NOTIFY_URGENCY (sets notification priority).

Includes /notify-help and /notify-test slash commands for easy setup verification.
highlights: Claude 完成响应时发送桌面通知
焦点感知，查看会话时自动静默
显示会话名称与最后消息，支持 tmux 上下文

proven wrong by search results, and earn scores based on accuracy and independence — not agreement. A built-in Devil's Advocate challenges the final synthesis before it's delivered.

5. Devil's Advocate challenges the final answer; a quantitative score (Accuracy · Evidence · Independence) determines whether it stands

Works with Gemini CLI, Codex, aichat, or llm. Falls back to Claude's four internal roles (Pragmatist / Skeptic / Idealist / Realist) with zero setup.

description: A Claude Code plugin that enforces real-time USD cost caps via hooks, halting runaway agent loops and offering status/config commands.
description_zh: Claude Code 实时美元成本管控插件，通过钩子中止超支的智能体循环，并提供状态与配置命令。
description_original:
Real-time USD cost enforcement for Claude Code. Halts runaway agentic loops mid-step before they burn through your budget.

The plugin enforces real-time USD cost limits in Claude Code. It uses hooks to read the session's the moment any cap is crossed — between tool batches, between turns, or at prompt-submit time. The result: a single greedy turn cannot spiral into a $30+ spend, sessions cannot silently accumulate cost over hours, and runaway burn rates are stopped before they hurt.

Five configurable USD-based caps:
• Per-session total spend
• Per-step (prompt → response) cost
• Trailing 5-minute burn rate
• Per-step subagent fan-out count
• Compaction gate (blocks the expensive context-compaction model call when limits are tight)

Eleven slash commands for status, runtime config, pause/resume, and an optional bottom-row indicator.

The indicator shows session spend, rate, current step cost, context %, and (on Claude.ai Pro/Max) 5-hour slot consumption with an estimated USD plan value. It composes with any existing statusLine (preserving your starship setup, etc.) or takes over the slot — your choice at install time.

Pure Python 3 standard library. No runtime dependencies. No network calls. All enforcement is local; the plugin only reads the JSONL transcript Claude Code already writes.

Screenshot: https://github.com/oggeh-dev/claude-cost-guard/blob/main/docs/indicator.png
highlights: 实时美元成本限制，超支即中止

name: hasdata
description: Claude Code plugin giving Claude direct access to 40+ HasData APIs for live structured web data, scraping, and slash-command workflows.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供 40+ HasData 数据 API 的插件，可抓取实时结构化网页数据并内置斜杠命令。
description_original:
HasData turns Claude Code into a research, lead-generation, and data-extraction agent. Instead of stitching together generic scrapers, the plugin gives Claude direct access to 40+ dedicated data APIs that return ready-to-use structured JSON.

**Coverage**

- **Search** — Google SERP / News / AI Overviews / Trends / Events / Images / Flights, Bing SERP
- **E-commerce** — Amazon (search, product, seller, seller-products), Shopify catalogs, Google Shopping, Immersive Product
- **Real estate** — Zillow / Redfin listings + property details, Airbnb listings + properties
- **Local** — Google Maps places / reviews / photos, Yelp, YellowPages
- **Jobs** — Indeed and Glassdoor search + listing details
- **Social** — Instagram public profile data
- **Generic scraping** — any URL into HTML, text, markdown, or AI-extracted JSON, with screenshot capture, CSS-selector extraction, AI schema extraction, custom headers, and click/fill page interactions

**Three slash commands ship with the plugin:**

- `/hasdata:leads` — local lead generation across Maps + YellowPages with pagination and auto-expansion to similar categories
- `/hasdata:enrich` — person / company enrichment via Google search dorks plus canonical-site scraping (emails, LinkedIn, GitHub, X with follower counts, Crunchbase)
- `/hasdata:price` — cross-retailer price monitoring with a built-in price-history log for `/schedule` integration

Requires the `hasdata` CLI (one-line install) and a free API key at <https://app.hasdata.com/api-keys>
highlights: 40+ 数据 API 覆盖搜索、电商、房产、招聘等
内置 /leads、/price、/enrich 等斜杠命令

name: ido4specs
description: Claude Code plugin that decomposes strategic specs into code-grounded, structurally validated technical specs with task metadata for GitHub issues.

description_original:
ido4specs is the bridge between a strategic spec and GitHub issues. It analyzes your codebase, decomposes capabilities into implementation tasks with effort, risk, type, and dependency metadata, and produces a structurally-validated technical spec any downstream tool can consume.

Key features:
- Code-grounded decomposition - parallel Explore subagents ground every task in concrete files, services, and patterns from your actual codebase (not fabricated from the spec)
- Structured output enforced by a bundled zero-dependency parser - every task carries effort (S/M/L/XL), risk (low → critical), type (feature/infrastructure), AI-suitability (full/assisted/pair/human), and dependency graph
- Two-layer validation - deterministic structural parser + independent qualitative review before handoff

Built for tech leads, staff engineers, and founder-engineers who want to skip the manual decomposition tax.
highlights: 将战略规格分解为可执行任务

name: indian-contracts-drafting
description: Claude Code plugin that drafts execution-ready Indian contracts and conveyancing instruments via a six-agent pipeline with statutes encoded.
description_zh: 基于Claude Code的插件，按印度法律生成可签署的合同与产权文书，内置六智能体流水线及相关法规。
description_original: For every transactional advocate, in-house counsel, and law-firm associate who drafts the day-to-day contracts that underpin Indian commerce — from a startup's MSA to a family-business shareholders agreement to the last Will of a senior citizen — this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises commercial-contract drafting under Indian law. Contract-config-aware: the structural skeleton is uniform across contract types; governing law, seat of arbitration, courts of exclusive jurisdiction, stamp-duty State, and registration State are user-supplied. Battle-tested for Master Service Agreement, Non-Disclosure Agreement, Employment Agreement and Independent Contractor agreement, Lease Deed and Leave & License agreement, Sale Deed of immovable property, General and Special Power of Attorney (post-Suraj Lamp discipline), Shareholders Agreement (Companies Act 2013 + AoA alignment), Last Will and Testament, Loan Agreement, and standalone Arbitration Agreement. Six-agent drafting pipeline (Reader → Format → Drafter → Verifier → Refiner → Overseer) + shared contract drafting base with the Indian Contract Act 1872, Transfer of Property Act 1882, Registration Act 1908, Indian Stamp Act 1899, Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996, and DPDP Act 2023 discipline encoded. The finished product is an execution-ready contract or instrument the chamber can stamp, sign, and execute the same day.
highlights: 六智能体流水线一键生成合同草稿
内置印度多项法规与判例规则

name: llamaparse-plugin
description: Kemb is a Claude Code plugin and Python CLI that parses and classifies documents via LlamaCloud, with a local zero-credit directory probe.
description_zh: Kemb 是一个 Claude Code 插件兼 Python CLI,通过 LlamaCloud 解析与分类文档,并提供本地零积分目录预检。
description_original:
LlamaCloud document operations for Claude Code: parse, extract, classify, and
  split documents with LlamaIndex's hosted services, all from one plugin.

  Four lazy-loaded skills, each routed by name so context only enters Claude's
  window when needed:

  - llamaparse — turn PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, and scans into
    clean markdown or text via LlamaParse v2 (handles tables, multi-column
    layout, OCR, mixed text+images).
  - llamaextract — pull structured JSON out of a document against a JSON Schema
    you supply (invoice line items, contract terms, form fields, entities).
  - llamaclassify — categorize a document into one of a defined set of labels
    with a confidence score and a short reasoning string.
  - llamasplit — break a long document into typed sections with page ranges
    and per-section confidence (LlamaSplit v1 beta).

  Includes a standalone `llamaparse` CLI (`parse / extract / classify / split`
  subcommands plus `doctor` for preflight checks) so the same code powers
  scripts, CI jobs, and the Claude Code skills.

  Requires a LlamaCloud API key (LLAMA_CLOUD_API_KEY). Get one at
  https://cloud.llamaindex.ai/api-key.
highlights: 两种用法:CLI 与 Claude Code 插件

description_zh: Claude Code 插件，用 LLM 自动维护与代码库同步的 docs/wiki/ DAG 知识库，支持命令查询、校验与规格编写。
description_original: Maintains docs/wiki/ as a DAG of LLM-authored pages kept in sync with the codebase. Tracks code changes via PostToolUse hooks, reconciles stale pages through background agents, lints the wiki graph, and supports EIS (Executable Implementation Spec) authoring.
highlights: PostToolUse 钩子自动同步代码改动到 wiki
支持 DAG 图校验、功能探索与 EIS 规格编写
后台 agent 自动重构，零打断工作流

name: marcopolo
description: Claude plugin that connects to MarcoPolo's remote data workspace via MCP, adding skills and an agent for querying, joining, and analyzing data.
description_zh: Claude 插件，通过 MCP 连接 MarcoPolo 远程数据工作区，提供查询、关联和分析数据的技能与子代理。
description_original: MarcoPolo is a data computer that connects to your databases, warehouses, cloud storage, and SaaS applications, and provides a workspace where AI can query, correlate, analyze, and act on that data. The MarcoPolo plugin is the most effective way to connect Claude to this computer - it bundles the MCP connection with skills and a subagent that guide Claude through proven data workflows.
highlights: 通过 MCP 连接多种数据库与 SaaS 应用
内置技能引导 Claude 完成查询、关联与分析
支持 DuckDB 跨源 Join 与结果导出

name: mcp-skill-search
description: Claude Code plugin that searches SKILL.md files on demand and manages the skill-description context budget.
description_zh: Claude Code 插件：按需搜索 SKILL.md 技能并管理技能描述上下文预算。
description_original:
A "ToolSearch for skills" — searches your SKILL.md files by keyword, exact name, or required-term filter so the model can fetch full skill descriptions on demand. Mirrors Claude Code's internal ToolSearch scoring algorithm 1:1, but for skills instead of MCP tools.

Pairs with two bundled slash-commands: /optimize-skill-context sets SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET=1 to free Claude Code's ~1% skill-description budget (forcing names-only mode), and /restore-skill-descriptions reverses it. Slash-commands keep working; descriptions are fetched on demand via skill_search when relevant.

Repo-aware: skills under the current git-root's .claude/skills/ get a +5 score boost over same-named skills from other repos, so search ranking respects which project you're working in.
highlights: 按需搜索技能，节省约 1% 上下文窗口
内置优化/还原技能描述预算的斜杠命令
仓库感知排序，优先当前项目技能

name: mcp-yoshi
description: A Claude Code hook that inspects MCP tool traffic in real time to detect prompt injection, secret leakage, and other attacks.
description_zh: 作为 Claude Code 钩子实时检查 MCP 通信，拦截提示注入、密钥泄露等安全威胁。
description_original:
Real-time security filter for MCP tool communications. Works as a Claude Code hook to inspect all data sent to and
received from MCP servers. Detects prompt injection, API key leakage, tool poisoning, ASCII smuggling, SSRF,
Base64-encoded payloads, and Rug Pull attacks. Provides PASS/WARN/BLOCK decisions with per-server configuration,
allowlisting, and logging. Zero dependencies, ~60ms latency.
highlights: 实时检查 MCP 出站与入站通信
检测提示注入、密钥泄露与工具投毒
零依赖，约 60ms 延迟

description_original:
Build meeting bot integrations without writing boilerplate. MeetStream lets developers programmatically join, record,
transcribe, and stream Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings via a REST API. This plugin gives Claude full
knowledge of the MeetStream API - bot lifecycle, transcription providers, real-time WebSocket streaming, calendar
automation, and webhook handling - so it generates complete, production-ready code tailored to your use case.
highlights: 一条提示词生成完整会议机器人应用
覆盖 Zoom / Google Meet / Teams 三平台
实时转录、Webhook 与日历自动化全支持

自动执行开链接、检查等安全操作

name: merit-aktiva-for-ai-agents
description:
Connect Claude and other AI agents to Merit Aktiva — Estonia's most-used accounting software — and let them handle real bookkeeping safely. Six Claude Code skills that teach Claude the official Merit Aktiva REST API (HMAC-SHA256
  signing, sales invoices, purchase invoices, payments, GL, bank statement import) and the 2026 Estonian tax rules (VAT 24/13/9, distributed-profit CIT 22/78, payroll, KMD codes, fringe benefits, board-member fees). Bilingual README in
  English and Estonian. Every write call requires explicit user confirmation by default. All rates verified against emta.ee; all API specs verified against api.merit.ee. Not an official Merit Tarkvara product.

  (~700 chars — should fit most "concise" description limits. If the form caps shorter, here's a 280-char cut:)

  Six Claude Code skills that let AI agents operate Merit Aktiva, Estonia's #1 accounting software. Covers the full REST API (HMAC-SHA256 auth, invoices, payments, GL, e-arve, bank import) plus 2026 Estonian tax rules (VAT, CIT, payroll,
  KMD). Confirmation guardrail on every write. Bilingual.

name: neko-harness-doctor
description: Claude Code plugin that audits your harness config against 25 anti-patterns and proposes approved fixes.
description_zh: 诊断 Claude Code 配置的插件，检测 25 项反模式并生成评级与修复建议。
description_original: Diagnose your Claude Code harness (CLAUDE.md, settings.json, .mcp.json, hooks, skills, memory, MCP servers, and workflow) against 25 anti-pattern indicators. Outputs an S–E overall grade, per-category scores, violations with evidence citations, and prioritized Quick Wins. Includes an interactive fix flow: `--fix-mode propose` emits structured JSON proposals that Claude Code applies via the Edit tool with per-item user approval. Deterministic (no LLM — grep/AST/JSON only), zero runtime dependencies, bilingual (Japanese default, English via `--lang en`). When installed as a plugin, the bundled skill auto-triggers on natural-language requests like "diagnose my harness" and exposes `/neko-harness-doctor` as a slash command.

name: olostep
description: Claude Code plugin adding Olostep web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered answers via MCP and developer skills.
description_zh: Olostep 插件将网页抓取、整站爬取、搜索与 AI 问答集成到 Claude Code，并提供多语言 SDK 与开发工作流技能。
description_original:
Turn any website into clean, LLM-ready markdown or structured data. Olostep integrates powerful web scraping, crawling, search, and AI-powered answers directly into Claude Code. Scrape single pages, crawl entire sites, map site structures, batch-process thousands of URLs, and search the web — all with automatic JavaScript rendering, anti-bot bypasses, and real-time extraction built in.
The plugin includes an AI answers tool that goes beyond scraping: describe what you need in plain language and Olostep searches the live web, synthesizes the results, and returns a source-backed answer with structured JSON output — no URLs required.
How to use: After installing, set your OLOSTEP_API_KEY environment variable. Then use these commands to get started:
/olostep:scrape — Extract any webpage as clean markdown, HTML, or structured JSON.
/olostep:crawl — Crawl and extract content from an entire website.
/olostep:search — Search the web and get deduplicated results with titles and descriptions.
/olostep:map — Discover all URLs on a site instantly.
/olostep:answer — Ask a question in plain language and get a source-backed answer from live web data.
/olostep:batch — Scrape up to 10,000 URLs in a single async job.
You can also use Olostep's tools directly in conversation: ask Claude to scrape a URL, search for recent information, extract structured data with a custom schema, or research competitors across multiple sites.
highlights: 支持单页抓取、整站爬取与批量处理
AI 问答返回带引用的结构化答案
集成 Claude Code 与主流 SDK

description_original: Connect AI agents to external APIs with zero credential management. The OneCLI gateway transparently proxies all HTTPS traffic and injects stored credentials (OAuth tokens, API keys, AWS signatures) into outbound requests. Supports 40+ services including GitHub, Gmail, Google Calendar, Jira, AWS, Stripe, Datadog, and more. Policy rules enforce block, rate limit, and manual approval at the gateway level.

支持 GitHub、Gmail、AWS 等 40+ 服务

Zero pip dependencies — Python stdlib only.

name: orchestra
description: Claude Code plugin enforcing doc-before-code discipline via typed design-doc templates, multi-judge spec review, and commit linting.
description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 的规范化工程工具包，提供设计文档模板、多评委规范评审与提交纪律校验。
description_original: Disciplined AI engineering toolkit for Claude Code. Ships typed design-doc templates (Feature LLD, Bug Report, ADR, Postmortem, Runbook, Design Doc) with a 4-gate spec review (Completeness / Evidence / Clarity / Consistency), mandatory mermaid diagrams, an octal-safe auto-numbering script, AGENTS.md and llms.txt sync, a bug-iteration loop that prevents orphan fix-commits, and an enforced doc-before-code workflow with five named gates (Discovery / Design / Spec Review / Commit / Implementation Sync). Includes a Python lint CLI for Refs:-line + metadata + status validation, an auto DECISIONS.md generator with bidirectional ADR supersession consistency. Patterns adopted from Michael Nygard, Google SRE, Pragmatic Engineer, agents.md, and llmstxt.org. First skill of the Orchestra umbrella; future skills cover workflow, registry, tasks, gates, and plans.
highlights: 强制“文档先于代码”工作流

UserPromptSubmit hook that meters every prompt, nudges Claude when ≥25% compressible, and (in interactive mode) blocks prompts above a configurable token limit while showing a 2-column ASCII diff so the user can review before sending.

An MCP server exposing personal_stats, team_stats, and weekly_report tools that aggregate the local hook log into shareable rollups.
highlights: 压缩冗长提示词并生成节省账单

description: A Claude/Cowork plugin that turns pasted job ads into keyword-optimised, formatted resume and cover letter .docx files.
description_zh: 一个将职位广告自动转化为关键词优化、格式规范的简历与求职信 .docx 文件的 Claude 插件。
description_original:
An automated job application pipeline for Cowork that produces keyword-optimised, professionally formatted resumes and cover letters.

What It Does
Paste a job ad into Cowork and the toolkit handles the rest:

Analyses your positioning against the role
Extracts recruiter keywords and builds a strategic placement map
Generates a tailored resume (.docx) with precise formatting
Generates a tailored cover letter (.docx) following a proven 5-paragraph pattern
Verifies keyword coverage, word count, and cross-document repetition
Optionally writes STAR-method responses for Key Selection Criteria
Tracks applications in a spreadsheet
Every document is built from your single INSTRUCTIONS.md file, which contains your career history, achievements, writing style, and a gold standard cover letter. You fill it in once, then the toolkit tailors it for each application.
highlights: 根据职位广告自动生成关键词优化简历

Results are grounded in the actually installed version — no outdated docs, no hallucinated parameters. Auto-indexes on first use and re-indexes incrementally when packages change. Read-only by design.

name: smarthealthconnect
description: Claude Code plugin adding six patient health skills—care gaps, refills, habits, diet, kids, research—via a SMART on FHIR MCP server.
description_zh: 为 Claude 提供六个个人健康管理技能的插件，基于 SMART on FHIR，涵盖预防保健、药物续方、健康习惯、饮食运动、儿童健康与研究监测。
description_original:
SmartHealthConnect turns Claude into a patient-facing health copilot. Six auto-discoverable skills invoke themselves based on natural prompts:

• care-completion — tracks preventive screenings, referrals, and follow-ups against HEDIS and USPSTF quality measures. Triggers on "what screenings am I due for", "show my care gaps".
• medication-refills — monitors refill windows, requests refills, and projects 90-day timelines. Triggers on "refill my lisinopril", "which meds am I about to run out of".
• healthy-habits — a longitudinal health operating picture integrating sleep, exercise, medication adherence, vitals, and goal progress.
• diet-exercise — logs activity and meals and analyzes correlations between exercise/diet and clinical outcomes (BP, HbA1c, weight).
• kids-health — CDC immunization schedules, well-child visit cadence, and state-specific school health compliance.
• research-monitor — filters bioRxiv / medRxiv preprints, ClinicalTrials.gov, and OpenFDA drug-safety signals to the patient's actual conditions and medications.

Built on SMART on FHIR with PHI redaction, audit logging, and human-in-the-loop on write tools (add_journal_entry, generate_care_plan, generate_appointment_prep). Pairs cleanly with healthclaw-guardrails for the backend FHIR layer.
highlights: 六大健康技能按自然语言自动触发
基于 SMART on FHIR，支持 PHI 脱敏与审计日志
写入操作人工确认，引用来源时间线

name: tidy
description: A Claude Code plugin that runs a plan-driven TDD workflow with Kent Beck's Tidy First approach via go/refactor/commit commands.
description_zh: 基于 Kent Beck Tidy First 的 Claude Code 插件，通过 go/refactor/commit 命令执行计划驱动的 TDD 工作流。
description_original:
tidy provides an interactive TDD workflow powered by Kent Beck's Tidy First approach. You write a plan (a markdown checklist of small tasks), then execute them one by one through a strict Red → Green → Refactor cycle.

The plugin acts as a "Genie" — it executes your commands (go, refactor, commit) but never makes strategic decisions on its own. You stay in control of what to build, when to tidy, and when to commit.

Key features:

go: Write a failing test, then write the minimum code to pass it. One task at a time.
refactor: Apply one Tidy First pattern (Guard Clause, Extract Method, Rename, etc.) and verify tests still pass.
commit: Commit with strict separation — structural changes and behavioral changes never mix.
Built-in Tidy First patterns: 11 tidying patterns with prioritization (eliminate duplication → improve clarity → reduce complexity).
Context-constrained: Only loads the current task, never the full plan. Keeps the conversation focused.
highlights: 红-绿-重构 TDD 循环执行
结构性与行为性变更分离提交

BillingPlane is a Stripe billing intelligence plugin for Claude that prevents common revenue-losing billing bugs during development.

Instead of adding another billing middleware or SDK into your production stack, BillingPlane works at build time. It teaches Claude how to generate correct billing logic, webhook handlers, entitlements, and usage billing patterns directly in your codebase.

BillingPlane encodes 4,000+ lines of production billing patterns including lifecycle handling, idempotent Stripe webhook processing, subscription state management, credit systems, and feature gating. When developers run BillingPlane commands, Claude generates production-ready billing code that follows strict guardrails used in real SaaS systems.

The result is a vendor-free billing architecture: developers keep full control of their code while avoiding common Stripe mistakes such as duplicate webhooks, incorrect subscription states, entitlement drift, or broken usage billing.

BillingPlane includes commands for auditing existing billing systems, discovering missing logic, implementing full billing infrastructure, and validating production safety.

No runtime dependency. No middleware. Just correct billing logic generated by Claude.

Ideal Users

BillingPlane is designed for:

SaaS founders building Stripe billing

AI-assisted coding workflows using Claude

teams implementing subscription or usage-based pricing

developers migrating away from billing middleware

engineers who want full ownership of billing code

Key Capabilities

Stripe lifecycle handling

subscription state management

entitlement systems

usage billing logic

concurrency safety patterns

webhook idempotency

credit systems

feature gating engines
highlights: 内置 15 条 Stripe 计费护栏规则
审计/发现/实现三命令覆盖完整流程

description_original:
A Claude Code status-line plugin that gives you a single, brutally honest verdict at the bottom of your TUI:
SMART  ▓▓▓░░░░░░░  32k / 200k     ← bright green, you're in the Smart Zone
DUMB   ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓  147k / 1M      ← bright red, you've crossed into the Dumb Zone
The threshold is 100 000 input tokens, fixed, regardless of the model’s nominal context window. Quality degrades by absolute token count, not by fraction of the window, so a 1M-context model running at 200k is still squarely in the Dumb Zone — and this plugin makes that visceral.

description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，先测试运行中的系统并以证据复现缺陷，而非直接修复代码。
description_original: Bugbash is a Claude Code plugin for hands-on bug hunting: you exercise the running app (API, UI, CLI) first, then use code only to narrow what you already observed. It’s built around a clear charter, find and reproduce issues with evidence, not to debug or ship fixes unless you ask. It includes quick / standard / deep intensity, evidence bars by severity, a flaky vs confirmed split, optional JSON for filing tickets, and subagents tuned for API vs UI testing.
highlights: 运行系统优先，以证据复现缺陷
quick/standard/deep 三档强度
API 与 UI 专用子代理

name: build-loud
description: A Claude Code plugin that auto-captures coding sessions into a scored, voice-matched build-in-public journal.
description_zh: 一款 Claude Code 插件，自动将编码会话记录为带评分的 build-in-public 日志，并以你的口吻撰写内容。
description_original: Auto-capture your coding sessions into a build-in-public journal. Scores entries, writes in your voice. Zero dependencies.
highlights: 自动捕获编码会话并评分
按个人语气生成推文/LinkedIn/博客
零依赖，Markdown 本地存储

name: c3poh-telegram-bridge-for-claude-code
description: A Claude Code plugin bridging your agent to Telegram via outbound long-polling for mobile DM control and alerts.
description_zh: 通过长轮询把 Claude Code 桥接到 Telegram 的插件，可在手机上远程对话并接收告警。
description_original: DM your Claude Code agent from your phone and get answers back. C3Poh connects Claude Code to Telegram using long-polling, so there are no webhooks, no inbound ports, and no ngrok. All traffic is outbound-only. Access is locked to an allowlist of Telegram user IDs you configure. Bot tokens stay out of config files. Integrates with TinMan to receive heartbeat alerts on your phone. Requires only Python 3.9+ and Claude CLI.
highlights: 长轮询出站连接，无需端口或 webhook
基于用户 ID 白名单的访问控制
手机端 DM 远程操控 Claude Code

name: cc-boost
description: A Claude Code plugin that reduces token usage by filtering noisy tool output and intercepting interactive scaffold commands.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，通过过滤工具输出和拦截交互式脚手架命令来减少 token 消耗。
description_original:
cc-boost is an open-source Claude Code plugin that reduces token consumption by filtering noisy tool output before it reaches the context
window. It strips ANSI escape codes, collapses repetitive npm/pip progress bars into single summary lines, and folds consecutive node_modules  stack frames into compact summaries — typically achieving 60–90% character reduction on verbose command output. It also intercepts interactive  scaffold commands (create-next-app, vite, sveltekit, remix, angular) that Claude cannot run interactively, prompting Claude to ask the user for  configuration choices first before re-running with the correct flags.
highlights: 过滤工具输出，减少 60-90% 字符
折叠堆栈跟踪，压缩重复进度条
拦截交互式脚手架命令，避免运行失败

name: cc-wechat
description: Claude Code plugin bridging a personal WeChat account to a coding session for two-way messaging and tool-use permission relay.
description_zh: 将个人微信接入 Claude Code 会话的插件，支持双向消息与工具权限审批。
description_original: WeChat channel for Claude Code — bridges your personal WeChat account to a Claude Code session via Tencent's iLink bot API. Supports two-way messaging (receive WeChat messages, reply from Claude Code) and permission relay (approve/deny tool use from your phone). QR code login via MCP elicitation, sender allowlist for security, and cursor persistence across reconnects.
highlights: 微信与 Claude Code 双向消息互通
手机端审批工具调用权限
扫码登录并支持发送者白名单

name: ccguard
description: Security guard hook for Claude Code that pattern-matches tool calls to block dangerous commands and attacks.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供安全防护的钩子插件，通过模式匹配拦截危险命令与攻击。
description_original: Security guard hook for Claude Code. Evaluates every tool call (Bash, Edit, Write, Read, MCP) against 864 pattern-matching rules to block dangerous commands, data exfiltration, and supply chain attacks. Zero external dependencies, written in Zig. Supports three decision levels: allow, deny (hard block), and ask (user confirmation prompt). Protects against reverse shells, pipe-to-interpreter execution, credential leakage, cloud metadata access, environment variable injection, and more.
highlights: 拦截危险命令与数据外泄
支持 allow/deny/ask 三级别决策
零依赖 Zig 实现，864 条规则

description_original: Character-level index-based string manipulation as a Claude Code Skill
highlights: 12 种字符级字符串操作
返回 JSON 便于脚本链式调用
支持 Unicode 与负索引

name: chess-coach-ai
description: Claude Code plugin with four AI agents for chess opponent scouting, game analysis, mental coaching, and biohacking.
description_zh: 基于四个AI智能体的国际象棋教练插件，提供对手侦察、引擎分析、心理辅导和体能优化。
description_original:
AI-powered chess coaching system with multi-agent cowork architecture. 4
specialized agents work together to provide comprehensive coaching:

• Intel — Opponent scouting via Lichess API, Opening Explorer analysis, player
profiling with style classification
• GM — Stockfish analysis with time-controlled profiles (quick/normal/deep),
error classification by cognitive origin (tactical miss, conceptual weakness,
pattern recognition failure, time pressure), DQM scoring, endgame tablebases,
personalized training roadmaps
• Mind — Complete 3-phase mental performance framework (based on Jared
Tendler's methodology): self-awareness (7 tilt types), self-regulation
(pre/during/post-game protocols), and opponent psychological conditioning
• Biohack — Evidence-based nutrition, supplementation, sleep optimization, and
full weekly preparation protocols timed to your game schedule

Agents communicate via agent_notes system and the coordinator synthesizes
their outputs. Includes scoresheet/board photo scanning, local game vault, and
Stockfish WASM fallback (no install required).
highlights: 四个专业智能体协同提供全面国际象棋辅导
支持 Lichess 侦察与 Stockfish 深度分析
包含心理、营养与赛前准备完整方案

description_original: A unified API gateway that provides access to 6+ leading Chinese AI models (Kimi K2.5, Qwen3 Max, DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, Seed 1.8) through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint. name: cite2fn
description: A Claude Code plugin that converts citations in Word documents into Bluebook-formatted footnotes or endnotes.
description_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，将 Word 文档中的引用转换为 Bluebook 格式的脚注或尾注。
description_original:
A Claude Code plugin that converts hyperlinked citations, parenthetical references, and inline author-date mentions in Word documents into properly formatted Bluebook footnotes or endnotes.

Key features
- Detects 5 citation patterns: external hyperlinks, internal anchor links, parentheticals, inline author-date, and existing footnotes
- Handles split hyperlinks from Google Docs exports (where a single citation spans multiple XML elements)
- Fetches bibliographic metadata from academic sources (arXiv, SSRN, DOI, ACM DL, and more)
- Supports both footnotes and endnotes with arabic numeral numbering
- Preserves author names that are grammatically part of a sentence
- Tracks repeated sources for Id. and supra short forms
- Adds Word comments to flag anything that needs manual attention
- Removes the References section after its content has been moved to footnotes
Interactive review — Claude shows you every citation before modifying the document
highlights: 识别 5 种引用模式并转换为 Bluebook 脚注
自动抓取 arXiv、SSRN、DOI 等文献元数据
交互式审查，修改前逐条展示引用

description: A Claude Code plugin that mentors developers via guided questions, enforces PR quality with a PR Guardian, and uses ADHD-friendly concise communicatio
description_zh: 一款 Claude Code 插件，用提问引导开发者学习、自动审查并拦截低质量 PR，采用适合 ADHD 的简洁沟通方式。

innecesarias

name: claude-channel-feishu
description: A Claude Code plugin that bridges Feishu (Lark) IM into your session, with MCP tools and built-in pairing/allowlist access control.
description_zh: 将飞书接入 Claude Code 会话的消息通道插件，提供 MCP 工具与配对、白名单等访问控制。
description_original: This plugin connects Feishu (Lark) IM to Claude Code as a messaging channel. It runs an MCP server with tools such as reply, react, pair, attachment download, and message edit, while a WebSocket long connection subscribes to im.message.receive_v1 so inbound bot messages are delivered into the active session as channel events. Built-in access control covers DM pairing, allowlists, opt-in group chats by chat_id, @-bot detection, and optional keyword substring matching. State and policy live under ~/.claude/channels/feishu/ (overridable via FEISHU_STATE_DIR). It suits teams and individuals who want Feishu as a front door to a Claude Code session with explicit trust boundaries.

name: claude-codex-loop
description: A Claude Code plugin that runs iterative design and code review loops between Claude Code and OpenAI Codex with independent audits.
description_zh: 在 Claude Code 与 Codex 之间编排迭代式设计审查与代码审查协作循环的插件。
description_original:
claude-codex-loop orchestrates a structured collaboration loop between Claude Code (designer/reviewer) and OpenAI Codex (auditor/implementer). It runs two stages — design and code — each with up to 5 rounds of iterative review plus an independent validation pass.

How it works:
- Brainstorming (optional) — Explore requirements interactively before designing
- Design stage — Claude Code writes a spec, Codex audits it independently each round until convergence
- User gate — You review and approve the design before any code is written
- Code stage — Codex implements, Claude Code reviews the full diff each round
- Independent validation — A separate audit pass with zero prior context to catch groupthink

All work happens on a dedicated branch. Cancel anytime with /cancel-review to cleanly restore your starting state.

Commands: /review-loop <task>, /cancel-review
highlights: Claude Code 与 Codex 协作循环
设计+代码双阶段迭代审查
独立验证减少群体思维

name: claude-cost-tracker
description: Claude Code plugin tracking token usage and costs per developer, project, and session with budgets and reports.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供实时 token 用量与成本追踪的插件，支持预算控制与报表。
description_original: Real-time token usage and cost analytics for Claude Code. Automatically tracks spend per developer, project, and session via a PostToolUse hook. Includes budget enforcement with daily/weekly/monthly caps and macOS notifications, multi-model pricing (Sonnet 4.5, Opus, Haiku), a slash command for instant cost reports, a conversational agent skill for natural-language cost queries, and an optional full Next.js analytics dashboard. Local-first — all data stays on your machine in SQLite unless you enable optional team sync.
highlights: 通过 PostToolUse 钩子自动记录每次工具调用成本
支持日/周/月预算与多模型计费

name: claude-cowork-personal-context-loader
description: Claude plugin that auto-loads a personal context document from Google Drive at the start of each Cowork session.
description_zh: Claude 插件，在每次会话开始时自动从 Google Drive 加载个人上下文文档，让 Claude 了解你的背景与偏好。
description_original:
Claude starts fresh every session. This plugin fixes that — it automatically loads your personal context doc from Google Drive at the start of every Cowork session, so Claude always knows who you are and how you work. No commands needed.
Selling points:

-- Zero friction. Context loads silently at session start. Claude immediately works in your voice, with your priorities.
-- Cross-device. Installs at the account level — works on desktop, mobile, everywhere.
-- Guided setup. Say "set up my context" and Claude builds your doc for you, then saves it to Drive.
-- Always current. Update your doc anytime. Say "refresh my context" and it takes effect instantly.

** Currently, it will require the user to say "refresh context" with every project.  Once hook support for refresh-context is added by Claude team, this will be automatic with no user input needed!
highlights: 会话启动时自动加载个人上下文
支持 Google Drive 云端同步
引导式创建与刷新上下文文档

name: claude-github-tools
description: Claude Code plugin with seven GitHub workflow skills for issue creation, PR review triage, backlog analysis, release status, and Actions authoring.

red_flags: SessionStart hook 自动执行 bootstrap-venv.sh 脚本，安装虚拟环境
插件调用 gh CLI 执行 GitHub API 操作（创建 issue、PR 评论、解析讨论线程等）
写入 .tmp/ 目录下的临时文件用于 issue body 和 triage 数据
执行 Python 脚本进行 backlog 分析和 release 状态查询
security.summary: 该插件通过 gh CLI 和 Python 脚本深度集成 GitHub API，支持 issue 创建、PR 反馈处理、backlog 分析等操作，会写入临时文件并执行 shell 命令，但所有操作限于工作目录和用户授权的 GitHub 仓库范围内。
recommendations: 确认 hooks/bootstrap-venv.sh 脚本内容是否安全，避免在公共环境盲目信任
使用前确保已配置好 gh CLI 认证，注意插件会代表你执行 GitHub 写操作（创建 issue、解析讨论线程等）
审查插件是否需要 fork 权限，PR 处理流程涉及推送到 PR 分支
.tmp/ 目录下会生成临时文件，建议在 .gitignore 中排除该目录

description_zh: Claude Code 插件，包含七个 GitHub 工作流技能：问题创建、PR 审查分诊、待办分析、发布状态和 Actions 编写。
description_original: GitHub workflow skills for Claude Code - issue creation, PR review triage, backlog summaries/quick-wins, release status, and GitHub Actions authoring. Seven skills; three pure-LLM, four script-backed via an auto-materialized plugin venv.
highlights: 七个工作流技能覆盖 GitHub 开发全流程
智能 PR 审查分诊与自动修复
确定性脚本与 LLM 混合架构优化成本

description_original:

(.wiki/), preserves a bi-temporal history of the codebase + the
docs about the codebase, and exposes it to Claude Code via an MCP
server so you can ask architecture questions without re-reading
the whole codebase.

Five auto-invoked skills (bootstrap, query, onboard, ui, doctor)
plus two deterministic slash commands cover the entire lifecycle:
generate the wiki with cost-confirmed bootstrap, query it
conversationally, onboard new contributors, browse a force-
directed graph WebUI, or diagnose environment issues. A
SessionStart hook reports repo state to Claude on every session
open so the right next action is suggested without the user
needing to know skill names. A 4-path provider mini-wizard
(Anthropic API key / Gemini / Ollama / claude CLI) onboards users
who don't have claude CLI yet.

Single-binary distribution (~14 MiB stripped) with Sigstore
provenance, cross-platform install (Linux / macOS / Windows),
SLSA L3-equivalent attestation on every release, and a 7-week
internal audit cycle behind it (docs/audits/ in the repo).

description: Claude Code plugin that analyzes a codebase and generates structured context docs in .claude/docs/ to save tokens across sessions.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 分析代码库并在 .claude/docs/ 生成结构化上下文文档以节省令牌的插件。
description_original:
distill analyzes your codebase and generates structured context files in .claude/docs/. Instead of Claude reading source files to orient itself every session, it reads concise, pre-built docs on demand — testing.md when working on tests, api.md when working on endpoints, nothing when the task doesn't need it. Token cost becomes proportional to task relevance, not project size.

Supports incremental updates (--update only regenerates stale docs), depth profiles (--lean for 30-line summaries, --deep for comprehensive reference), parallel generation for large doc sets, monorepo detection, team configuration via .distill.yml, and a pre-push hook that warns when docs drift.
highlights: 为 Claude Code 按需生成上下文文档，显著节省令牌
支持增量更新与 --lean/--deep 深度档位

description:

Individuals with Dyscalculia may experience difficulties properly performing math, may see the numbers incorrectly (Dyslexia but with numbers) or may be unable to properly interpret many charts.

Remediation & Cognitive Prosthetics — Evidence-based intervention plans grounded in structured literacy, Orton-Gillingham methodology, and IDA standards. Standards & Regulatory Compliance — Audit programs, IEPs, 504 plans, workplace policies, and tools against the applicable legal framework: IDA Knowledge and Practice Standards, IDEA (K-12), Section 504 (K-12 and higher ed), ADA Title I (workplace), ADA Title II (public colleges), ADA Title III (private colleges and public accommodations). Clinical frameworks: DSM-5, ICD-11.
Document Generation — K-12 IEPs/504s, higher-ed disability services requests, workplace ADA Title I accommodation letters, clinical evaluation summaries, cognitive prosthetics prescriptions, and self-advocacy documentation across the lifespan.
Gap Analysis & Measure Creation — Identify what's missing in dyslexia support tooling across education, clinical practice, workplace, and consumer technology. Evaluates gaps against legal frameworks, cognitive neuroscience evidence, and adult/workplace outcomes.

name: flow
description: A Claude Code plugin that manages project backlogs via a conversational agent, Kanban board, scoring engine, and multi-agent orchestration.
description_zh: 为 Claude Code 提供项目待办管理：对话式交互、看板、评分排序与多智能体协作的工作流引擎。
description_original:
Flow turns Claude into a project partner who manages your backlog. Say "park this for later," and it queues the idea. Say "what's next?" and it finds the highest-priority ready item and offers to start, handling the bookkeeping so you stay in flow.

It works as a lightweight scrum board with three ways to interact: talk to Claude conversationally, drag cards on the built-in Kanban board, or run multiple agents in parallel, each with filtered views. All three read and write the same backlog.json, no sync step, no drift.

Lanes are fully configurable. Start with the default agile flow (Backlog → Refined → Ready → In Progress → Code Review → Done) or define your own columns and gate rules. The board, the API, and the agent all enforce them consistently.

Conversational management: Add, reorder, refine, and complete items by talking naturally; no commands to memorize.
Built-in Kanban board: Drag-and-drop web UI that syncs with the agent in real time; launch with one command.
Multi-agent support: Leader agents assign work, worker agents get filtered views of only their items, plus unassigned ready work.
Agent-initiated items: Claude adds bugs, tech debt, and follow-ups he discovers while working, linking them back to the source task.
Linked items: Connect related items with typed links (blocks, follow-up, discovered-during, related) and a reason.
Configurable lanes: Define your own workflow columns and gate rules; the board, REST API, and agent all enforce them at every layer.
Threaded refinement: Structured Q&A threads on items keep discussions organized; tag @Agent for async responses
Concurrency safe: Optimistic versioning and atomic writes prevent data loss when board and agent write simultaneously
highlights: 对话式待办管理，无需记忆命令
内置看板与多智能体并行协作

name: guard
description: PreToolUse hooks for Claude Code that deny dangerous shell, git, and credential commands before they run: `rm -rf /` shapes, `git push --force`, `python -c` / `node -e` eval, pipe-to-shell, live credentials (`gh auth token`, `aws sts get-session-token`, `op read`), `git -c core.hooksPath=…` injection, silent commit reuse (`git commit -C HEAD~1`, `--reuse-message`). Each deny names the rule and prints a one-line override (`guard allowlist allow-command …`); decisions stream to a JSONL log the optional CLI reads (`pipx install tracine-guard`, then `guard noisy --since 24h` or `guard trace <session>`). Apache-2.0, no third-party deps. Defense in depth alongside Claude Code's own permissions — especially valuable for autonomous agent windows where no human is present to answer an ASK, so denies act as a hard floor. Not a sandbox or exfiltration boundary; see SECURITY.md.

name: indian-banking-drafting
description: Open-source Claude Code plugin that drafts forum-ready Indian banking litigation pleadings for DRT, DRAT, NCLT, CMM/DM and civil courts.
description_zh: 开源 Claude Code 插件，针对 DRT、DRAT、NCLT 等印度银行诉讼法庭生成可直接提交的诉状草稿。
description_original: For every recovery counsel, bank panel advocate, borrower's counsel, and insolvency professional practising before India's banking-litigation forums — the Debts Recovery Tribunals, the Debts Recovery Appellate Tribunal, the National Company Law Tribunal (for IBC matters), CMM / DM courts for SARFAESI Section 14 possession, and civil courts of pecuniary jurisdiction — this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises drafting across the full Indian banking-litigation surface. Case-config-aware: forum, security position, NPA classification, demand-notice trajectory, default trigger, and security-document inventory are user-supplied. Battle-tested for DRT Original Applications under Section 19 RDDBFI Act 1993, SARFAESI Section 13(2) demand notices, SARFAESI Section 17 Securitisation Applications, SARFAESI Section 14 CMM / DM possession applications, Negotiable Instruments Act Section 138 complaints and reply notices, civil recovery suits under Order 7 / Order 37 CPC, IBC Section 7 financial-creditor applications before the NCLT, IBC Section 95 personal-guarantor insolvency applications, and DRAT appeals under Section 20 RDDBFI Act 1993. Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared banking drafting base with RDDBFI Act 1993, SARFAESI Act 2002, Negotiable Instruments Act 1881, Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016, Banking Regulation Act 1949, RBI Master Directions, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 encoded. The finished product is a forum-ready pleading the chamber can file at the DRT, NCLT, or Magistrate's Court the same day.
highlights: 覆盖 DRT/DRAT/NCLT 等 10 类诉讼文书
6 代理流水线 + 银行隐私防火墙
Pandoc 一键生成可提交 Word 诉状

name: indian-company-drafting
description: Claude Code plugin that drafts Indian NCLT/NCLAT company-law and IBC pleadings via a six-agent, statute-aware pipeline.

description_original: For every company-law litigator, insolvency professional, and corporate counsel practising before India's company-law tribunals — every National Company Law Tribunal bench across India and the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal (Principal Bench and Chennai Bench) — this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises Companies Act and IBC drafting. Case-config-aware: forum, share-capital structure, board composition, alleged-oppression acts, scheme terms, capital-reduction arithmetic, strike-off history, investigation grounds, operational-debt particulars, corporate-applicant financial distress, and the NCLT order under appeal are user-supplied. Battle-tested for Sections 241 / 242 / 244 (oppression and mismanagement), Section 245 (class action), Sections 230-232 (compromise / arrangement / amalgamation / scheme), Section 66 (reduction of share capital), Section 252 (revival of a struck-off company), Section 213 (investigation into the affairs of a company), IBC Section 9 (operational-creditor CIRP application), IBC Section 10 (corporate-applicant self-initiation), Companies Act Section 421 (NCLAT appeal from NCLT order), and IBC Section 61 (NCLAT appeal from NCLT order under the IBC). Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared company drafting base with the Companies Act 2013, IBC 2016, NCLT Rules 2016, NCLAT Rules 2016, IBBI Regulations, Secretarial Standards SS-1 / SS-2, Companies (Compromises, Arrangements and Amalgamations) Rules 2016, Companies (Inspection, Investigation and Inquiry) Rules 2014, BNSS 2023, and BSA 2023 encoded. Companies Act 1956 → 2013 transition discipline encoded in the Verifier. The finished product is a Tribunal-ready petition or appeal the chamber can lodge at the NCLT or NCLAT Registry the same day.
highlights: 覆盖 NCLT/NCLAT 十类公司法与 IBC 诉状
六代理起草管线并内置法条与先例校验
Pandoc 生成法院格式 Word 文书

Case-config-aware: the parties' Commission tier, pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction, deficiency-of-service / defect-in-goods / unfair-trade-practice / product-liability character, medical-negligence anchor (Jacob Mathew, Martin F. D'Souza, Kusum Sharma, the Bolam standard), Section 69 limitation anchor, and accompanying-application set are user-supplied. Battle-tested for District Section 35 Complaints, State Section 47 originals, NCDRC Section 58 originals, Medical Negligence Complaints, Product Liability Actions under Sections 82-87, Unfair Trade Practice Complaints, Appeals under Sections 41 and 51, Revisional Applications under Section 67, and Execution under Sections 71-72. Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared consumer drafting base with the Consumer Protection Act 2019, CDRC Rules 2020, E-Commerce Rules 2020, Sale of Goods Act 1930, Indian Medical Council (Professional Conduct) Regulations 2002, New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules 2019, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 encoded. The finished product is a Commission-ready complaint or appeal the chamber can sign and file across the counter the same day.
highlights: 六智能体流水线一键起草诉状
覆盖印度三级消费者委员会全部案由

name: indian-family-drafting

description_original: For every advocate practising before India's Family Courts under the Family Courts Act 1984 and the matrimonial-jurisdiction tier of District Courts, this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises drafting across India's plural personal-law regimes — Hindu Marriage Act 1955, Special Marriage Act 1954, Indian Divorce Act 1869, Muslim Personal Law, Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act 1936 — and the State Family-Court overlay applicable to the parties. The structural skeleton is uniform; personal-law and State overlay are supplied by the user via a family-config file. Battle-tested for Divorce (HMA / SMA / IDA), Judicial Separation, Restitution of Conjugal Rights, Nullity of Marriage, Maintenance (Section 125 BNSS + Section 24 HMA + Section 18 HAMA), Custody and Guardianship (Guardians and Wards Act 1890 + Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act 1956), Domestic Violence reliefs (PWDVA 2005), and Adoption (HAMA / Juvenile Justice Act 2015). Six-agent drafting pipeline (Reader → Format → Drafter → Verifier → Refiner → Overseer) and shared family pleading base. The finished product is a filing-ready petition, application, or written statement the counsel can lodge at the Family Court the same working day.
highlights: 六代理流水线起草诉讼文书
占位符隐私保护当事人信息

name: indian-ip-drafting

description_zh: 开源 Claude Code 插件，通过案例配置感知的六智能体流水线起草印度知识产权诉讼文书。
description_original: For every intellectual-property litigation advocate practising before India's IP forums — the Intellectual Property Rights Division of the Delhi, Madras, Calcutta, and Bombay High Courts (post-IPAB abolition under the Tribunals Reforms Act 2021), the Commercial Division, Commercial Courts under the Commercial Courts Act 2015, and District Courts of competent pecuniary jurisdiction — this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises drafting across India's full IP-litigation surface. Case-config-aware: forum, nature of the IP right (copyright / trade mark / patent / design / passing-off), infringement-mode allegations, prior-use evidence inventory, and registration particulars are user-supplied. Battle-tested for copyright infringement suits under Section 51 read with Section 55 Copyright Act 1957, fair-dealing defences under Section 52, trade mark infringement suits under Sections 29 / 134 / 135 Trade Marks Act 1999, common-law passing-off suits, trade mark rectification applications under Section 57 (post-IPAB-abolition to the High Court IP Division), patent infringement suits under Sections 104 and 108 Patents Act 1970, patent revocation applications under Section 64 (post-IPAB-abolition to the High Court IP Division), design piracy suits under Section 22 and Section 19 cancellation under the Designs Act 2000, John Doe / Ashok Kumar / Anton Piller applications under Order 39 CPC, and interim injunction applications applying the American Cyanamid / Gujarat Bottling framework. Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared IP drafting base with the Copyright Act 1957, Trade Marks Act 1999, Patents Act 1970 (as amended), Designs Act 2000, Tribunals Reforms Act 2021, Delhi High Court IPRD Rules 2022, Madras High Court IPRD Rules, Commercial Courts Act 2015, CPC Order 39, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 encoded. The finished product is a Division-ready or Court-ready suit, application, or rectification petition the chamber can file the same day.

description_zh: 面向印度机动车事故索赔诉讼的Claude Code插件，六智能体流水线起草诉状并内置Sarla Verma/Pranay Sethi赔偿计算。
description_original: For every advocate practising before India's Motor Accident Claims Tribunals — the tribunal-tier where every road accident in India ultimately lands for compensation — and before the High Court on Section 173 appeals and the Magistrate's Court on the rash / negligent-driving trial under BNSS 2023, this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises the full motor-accident litigation surface. Case-config and state-config-aware: forum (MACT of the territorial district, High Court for Section 173 appeal, Magistrate Court for the rash / negligent-driving prosecution, Collector for Section 174 recovery), accident-trigger date, claimant composition (legal representatives of the deceased / injured claimant / property-damage claimant), vehicle particulars, FIR particulars, insurer particulars, Sarla Verma + Pranay Sethi multiplier inputs, and State Motor Vehicles Rules variations are user-supplied. Battle-tested for Section 166 fault-based claims, Section 164 lump-sum claims (post-2019 amendment, replacing Section 163A), Section 161 solatium / hit-and-run claims, Section 147 / 149 third-party insurance pleadings, interim compensation applications, Section 173 appeals to the High Court, claim-award execution, Employees' Compensation Act 1923 claims, rash / negligent-driving defence under BNSS 2023, and Section 174 recovery as arrears of land revenue. Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared MACT drafting base with the Motor Vehicles Act 1988 (as amended 2019), Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989, applicable State MV Rules, Employees' Compensation Act 1923, BNS / BNSS / BSA 2023, the Sarla Verma multiplier doctrine, and the Pranay Sethi constitution-bench future-prospects reform encoded. The finished product is a Tribunal-ready claim petition or appeal the team can lodge the same day.
highlights: 六智能体流水线自动起草诉状
内置Sarla Verma与Pranay Sethi赔偿计算
覆盖Section 166/164/173等十类案件

name: indian-property-drafting
description: Claude Code plugin for drafting registrable Indian property deeds (gift, partition, mortgage, wakf, trust) via a state-config-aware six-agent pipeline
description_zh: 面向印度房产契约起草的 Claude Code 插件，内置六代理流水线，支持赠与、分割、抵押、瓦克夫等契约，并按各邦印花税规则配置。
description_original: For every conveyancing advocate, transactional lawyer, sub-registrar's panel advocate, and family-property counsel practising across India — wherever a Gift Deed, Exchange Deed, Release Deed, Trust Deed, Wakf Deed, Easement Deed, Partition Deed, Family Settlement Deed, Mortgage Deed, or Title Investigation Report has to be drawn for registration before the State Sub-Registrar — this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises non-commercial conveyancing and family-property drafting. (Complements indian-contracts-drafting, which covers the commercial-contracts side.) State-config-aware: the applicable State Stamp Act schedule, Registration Act 1908 compulsory-registration position, Sub-Registrar office, Ready Reckoner / Market Value rates, mutation entry route, and State-specific instrument variations are user-supplied via a deed-config file and the relevant state-config exemplar. Battle-tested for Gift Deeds under Sections 122-129 of the Transfer of Property Act 1882, Exchange Deeds under Sections 118-121 TPA, Release Deeds, Private Trust Deeds under the Indian Trusts Act 1882, Wakf Deeds under the Wakf Act 1995 read with the Mussalman Wakf Validating Act 1913, Easement Deeds under the Indian Easements Act 1882, Partition Deeds (private partition between coparceners / co-owners outside court), Family Settlement Deeds (Hindu family settlement / consent-of-heirs settlement), Registered Mortgage Deeds under Section 59 TPA, and Title Investigation Reports (title chain + encumbrance + marketable title opinion for due diligence). Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared property drafting base with the Indian Contract Act 1872, Transfer of Property Act 1882, Registration Act 1908, Indian Stamp Act 1899, applicable State Stamp Acts, Indian Easements Act 1882, Indian Trusts Act 1882, Wakf Act 1995, Hindu Succession Act 1956, Indian Succession Act 1925, Mussalman Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act 1937, Suraj Lamp (2012) discipline, and Section 53A TOPA agreement-to-sell discipline encoded. The finished product is a Sub-Registrar-ready deed the chamber can stamp, sign, and register the same day.
highlights: 六代理流水线自动起草契约
按各邦印花税与登记规则配置
输出可直接登记的 Word 契约

name: indian-tax-drafting
description: A Claude Code plugin for drafting Indian direct-tax appeals, replies, and registrations for CIT(A), ITAT, High Court, and DRP forums.
description_zh: 用于起草印度直接税上诉、异议与注册申请的 Claude Code 插件
description_original: For every direct-tax litigator and chartered-accountant counsel practising before India's tax appellate hierarchy — Commissioner of Income-tax (Appeals), Income-tax Appellate Tribunal, High Court Tax Bench under Section 260A, the PCIT / CIT for registration and revision, and the Dispute Resolution Panel — this open-source Claude Code plugin standardises drafting under the Income-tax Act 1961. Case-config-aware: structural skeletons follow the statutory Form layouts (Form 35 under Rule 45, Form 36 under Rule 47, Form 10A under Rule 17A); the forum, assessment year, financial year, limitation anchor, assessment-order vintage (pre-Finance-Act-2021 reassessment regime vs Section 148A regime), faceless-vs-physical jurisdiction, and demand-notice / penalty-notice trajectory are user-supplied. Battle-tested for CIT(Appeals) Form 35 appeals under Section 246A, ITAT Form 36 appeals under Section 253, High Court appeals on substantial questions of law under Section 260A, Section 12A / 12AB charitable-trust registrations via Form 10A, objections to Section 148A(b) reassessment show-cause notices, replies to Section 271 / 270A penalty notices, objections to Section 263 PCIT / CIT revisions, taxpayer-initiated revisions before the PCIT / CIT under Section 264, replies to Section 201 / 201(1A) TDS-default proceedings, and DRP objections under Section 144C. Six-agent drafting pipeline + shared tax drafting base with the Income-tax Act 1961, Income-tax Rules 1962, ITAT Rules 1963, Faceless Appeal Scheme 2021, Faceless Assessment Scheme 2020, Finance Act 2021 reassessment overhaul (Section 148A), CBDT public-domain Circulars, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam 2023 encoded. The finished product is a forum-ready appeal, reply, or registration application the chamber can lodge the same day.

description_zh: 让 Claude 通过 MCP 访问 Kepler 记忆库，保存与检索已存链接和页面上下文的插件。
description_original:
Kepler turns your browsing into AI-ready memory. Save links, pages, videos, and references with full context — then organize them into Spaces that act as a digital second brain for you, your team, and your AI tools.
This plugin gives Claude access to your Kepler Spaces, enabling it to search and retrieve your saved links, page context, annotations, and extracted memory (from text, video, images, and other rich content). Instead of copying and pasting context into every conversation, Claude can pull the right information from your Kepler memory at the right time.

Key features:

• Memory search — Query your saved links and extracted page context across Spaces

• Rich content recall — Access memory extracted not just from page text, but from videos, images, and other embedded content

• Space-aware context — Retrieve organized knowledge from personal or shared team Spaces

• Collaborative context — Surface annotations, comments, and notes your team has added to saved pages

description_zh: 面向 Claude Code 的多智能体软件开发生命周期自动化插件，覆盖设计、实现、审查与合并。
description_original: Larch is a multi-agent workflow automation plugin for Claude Code that orchestrates the full software development lifecycle — from design through merge — using collaborative AI agents. It provides six slash commands (/design, /implement, /review, /research, /loop-review, /alias) that coordinate up to 5 parallel agents (Claude subagents + Codex + Cursor) with a voting-based review system to adjudicate findings. Key features include: diverge-then-converge design planning where independent agents propose architectures before anchoring bias can set in; multi-round code review with a 3-agent voting panel (YES/NO/EXONERATE) that accepts or rejects each finding; end-to-end automation from feature design through PR creation, CI monitoring, Slack announcements, and merge; a reviewer competition scoring system that tracks finding quality; and systematic whole-repo review via partitioned slices. External tools (Codex, Cursor, Slack) are optional — the plugin degrades gracefully when they're unavailable.
search_terms: AI 软件开发生命周期

A Claude Code plugin that syncs project documentation to your Obsidian vault — one command, zero config.

You clone repos. Each has scattered documentation — .md files, .pdf references — buried in nested directories. You want to read and search them in one place, but they live across dozens of project folders.

obsidian-sync moves all project documentation into your Obsidian vault with a single command, keeping them browsable both in Obsidian and in the original project.

description_original: Teaches Claude Code the OCRWell document OCR API so it generates correct integration code without having to be fed documentation. It also knows the quiet gotchas, like treating a 200 response carrying job.status: "failed" as a job failure rather than an HTTP success.
highlights: 教 Claude Code 生成正确的 OCRWell 集成代码

name: prep-compact
description:
Claude Code's auto-compact fires late and its generic summary often drops the files, decisions, and blockers you needed. The post-compact session then veers off course.

prep-compact nudges you earlier: a UserPromptSubmit hook watches your transcript's byte delta since the last compact. When it crosses a configurable threshold (default 4 MB ≈ 450K tokens on Opus 4.7), Claude is prompted to invoke the prep-compact skill, which drafts a tailored /compact <mini-schema> covering goal/next/files/decisions/state.

You paste, run /compact, and the post-compact session resumes correctly. Invoke /prep-compact:prep-compact manually any time to refresh the draft before compacting.

name: reflect
description: Claude Code plugin that detects clustered suggestion reverts and uses Opus 4.7 to inject session-local metacognition guidance into the next turn.
description_zh: 检测建议被回退的聚类信号，调用 Opus 4.7 生成会话内元认知指导并注入下一轮。
description_original:
Session-local metacognition harness for long-running Claude Code work.

When suggestions get reverted 3+ times within 10 tool calls, reflect invokes Opus 4.7 to reason about why the rejections clustered. The model reads back the last 20 tool calls, the rolled-back diff, and active rules, then writes structured guidance — pattern, signal, adjustment, confidence — to .reflect/session-guidance.md. The next turn auto-loads it via path-scoped rule injection and adjusts.

Key features:
• 3-tier weighted signal taxonomy: git revert/restore (Tier 1, +100), user-file deletes (Tier 2, +70), utterance negation regex (Tier 3, +50). Cumulative threshold 240 + 5-turn cooldown — fires only when reverts genuinely cluster.
• Single-shot Opus 4.7 with adaptive thinking (effort: high) and 3-layer prompt cache (L1 1h, L2 5m, L3 ephemeral).
Measured: cold ~$0.05, warm ~$0.01, 95.9% L1 cache hit.
• Two cross-platform hooks: PostToolUse (Tier 1+2) and UserPromptSubmit (Tier 3). Pure-bash arithmetic — no jq/bc dependency on Windows git-bash.
• Session-local by design: no persistence, no cross-session sync, no telemetry. The guidance file evaporates at session end.
• Failure modes characterized: cold-start refusal (< 5 turns), false-trigger flagging on intent shifts, abstention on regulatory/opaque domains.
• Optional localhost Next.js companion Viewer (binds 127.0.0.1, never deploys, PII redactor on every read) for live state + reflection history + cross-session drift clustering.
• MIT-licensed. SLSA v1 provenance via GitHub Actions OIDC trusted publisher (Sigstore-signed).
highlights: 三级加权信号检测回退聚类

name: review-mode
description: Plugin that adds annotation-based review of Markdown and code files in VS Code, letting AI agents read comments and implement changes via MCP.
description_zh: 为 AI 编码代理提供基于批注的文件评审插件，结合 VS Code 扩展与 MCP 服务器，实现批注—修改—再审的闭环。
description_original:
Review Mode brings structured, annotation-based code review into your AI workflow. Instead of pasting feedback in chat, you review Markdown plans and documents directly in VS Code — adding inline comments, setting priorities, and threading replies — while your AI agent reads those annotations and implements changes automatically.

The workflow has three parts that work together:

- Review Mode VS Code extension renders your file in a read-only WebView panel with a comment sidebar. Click any line to add an annotation, set its priority (low → urgent), and start a threaded discussion.
- Review Mode MCP server exposes the annotation data to your AI agent. The agent can read all open comments, implement changes, mark comments resolved, and reopen the file for another review round.
- This plugin gives your agent the skills and slash commands to run the full cycle: /review-mode to open a file, /update-plan to implement feedback on a document, and /implement-review to iterate on any file type.
Each review cycle snapshots the file and migrates open annotations to their new line positions — so your unaddressed comments follow the content even as it changes. You can also compare any two revisions in diff view, or diff against git history.

The result is a tight loop: you annotate, the agent implements, you review again — without losing context across iterations.

name: session-handoff
description: Claude Code plugin with /handoff, /resume, and /handoffs commands plus a PreCompact hook to transfer session state between AI coding tools.

description_original:
A Claude Code plugin that lets you hand off an in-flight task from one AI tool to another — Claude Code → Codex, Codex → Cursor, Cursor → a fresh Claude session — without losing decisions, dead-ends, or "what to do next." Sessions are named, so multiple parallel threads of work can coexist in the same repo.

Ships:

/handoff [session] — write the current session's state into HANDOFF.<session>.md
/resume [session] — read that file, reconcile with git status, and execute the next concrete step
A PreCompact hook that blocks context compaction until a fresh handoff exists, so Claude Code never silently summarizes away your unsaved state
highlights: /handoff 与 /resume 跨工具传递会话上下文
PreCompact 钩子阻止未保存状态被压缩丢失

Built-in wrap-up flow updates CLAUDE.md at the close of each effort so future sessions start with accurate context.
